incidents.summary: De Kruif refuses to coach in Australia over unpaid salary, BFF pay 70 percent then decide to sack him; on leaving he says officials interfered in team selection and broke promises, and BFF appoint Italy's Fabio Lopez on 15,000 dollars a month.

incidents.title: Australia tour shame: hotel misconduct claims and nameless jerseys
incidents.summary: In Perth the team are accused of misbehaving at their hotel, Tim Cahill refuses Mamunul's jersey because it carries no name, flag or country, and fans find the kit is made by GoalBangladesh with Lotto socks.

incidents.title: Fans question BFF’s money claims as SLI deal worth $1m surfaces
incidents.summary: Fans ask where BFF gets money to corrupt if it is broke, then question why a reported $1 million Soccer League International deal leaves BFF claiming it has no money.

incidents.title: Sheikh Kamal Gold Cup organisation unravels before kick-off
incidents.summary: League runners-up Sheikh Russel are not invited, Mohun Bagan pull out, organisers do not know all the teams days before kick-off, champions Sheikh Jamal and Russel are absent, and Chittagong Abahani field a borrowed team beyond loan limits while fans ask why 8-10 crore taka is spent on it.

incidents.title: Star players quit Abahani and Sheikh Jamal for Sheikh Russel
incidents.summary: Reports that Shahed, Nasir, Komol and Sunday may leave Abahani for Sheikh Russel, and Jamal Bhuyan, Nasir Chowdhury and nine national players may leave Sheikh Jamal, shake the big clubs.

incidents.title: Hemanta Vincent dropped for playing khep matches while injured
incidents.summary: Hemanta plays unauthorised khep matches in Dinajpur while claiming injury and missing national camp; Lopez drops him from the preliminary squad and BFF dither over giving him another chance.

incidents.title: Fans allege a hidden reason for Emily’s omission against Jordan
incidents.summary: With 57 reactions, fans claim some have worked out why Zahid Hassan Emily was not fielded against Jordan and invite comment on the reason.

incidents.title: Eid congregation held on BFF turf, ruining the pitch
incidents.summary: BFF allow an Eid jamaat on the new turf, which fans say ruins the expensive ground they waited years for.

incidents.title: Emily diagnosed with suspected tumour and ruled out of camp
incidents.summary: Sheikh Russel forward Zahid Hassan Emily is diagnosed with a suspected tumour below the chest, needs an immediate operation and misses the national team camp.

incidents.title: FIFA ranking crashes to 182, the worst in years
incidents.summary: Bangladesh fall to 182nd in the FIFA ranking, down from 158 two months earlier, and fans blame BFF mismanagement, club obstruction of the academy and the coaching churn.

incidents.title: Australia’s security withdrawal from Bangladesh dominates fans’ anger
incidents.summary: Australia withdraw their qualifier and cricket tour over security fears, fans call the decision logic-less while others say Australia are right to put safety first, and the saga drags on for two months. Suggested new category: security_concerns.

incidents.title: Lopez's positional experiments unsettle senior players
incidents.summary: New coach Lopez plays Mamunul out of position, Rony in midfield and Faisal Mahmud at right-back; Mamunul says he is uncomfortable and cannot play his best, and players complain publicly instead of to the coach.

incidents.title: Fixing alert: fans demand investigation after Daily Star report
incidents.summary: A Daily Star fixing alert prompts fans to recall the 2009 Bangladesh-Nepal match as possibly fixed and Nepal's players taking 1,000 dollars to fix internationals; one post says a Bangladesh fixing investigation would sink many big club and federation people.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal president Manjur Kader takes on BFF over Cup exclusion
incidents.summary: After Sheikh Jamal are excluded from the Sheikh Kamal Cup, president Manjur Kader calls Salahuddin spineless and incompetent, secret election meetings plot against the president, clubs threaten to force the Super Cup and Independence Cup, and Kader and Lokman Bhuiyan are show-caused for meeting players before a match.

incidents.title: BCB take MA Aziz Stadium for cricket as Chittagong football loses its ground
incidents.summary: Chittagong fans demand a full football ground at MA Aziz Stadium, then BCB take it for the cricket BPL over the better-equipped Zahur Ahmed Chowdhury Stadium; BFF are blamed for letting Bangabandhu Stadium fall into neglect while BCB maintain their grounds.

incidents.title: Zahid Hossain dropped for fitness and discipline as he plays on for Chittagong Abahani
incidents.summary: Lopez says Zahid and Emily are not fit for the national team, yet Zahid scores a hat-trick for Chittagong Abahani; fans accuse him of faking injury and skipping fitness training, and he then declines a late national call-up.

incidents.title: Naturalisation debate revived before SAFF as expatriate route is argued instead
incidents.summary: Fans renew the call to naturalise Bangoura, Kingsley, Wedson and Emeka for SAFF, while a Prothom Alo column argues BFF should scout expatriate Bangladeshis like Jamal Bhuyan and Joseph Nur Rahman instead. Suggested new category: foreign_player_naturalisation.

incidents.title: Franchise league rights sold cheap as Soccer League UK's Tk 100 crore offer is spurned for Saif Powertec
incidents.summary: Fans ask why BFF rejected Soccer League UK's Tk 100 crore five-year franchise project and sold the rights for Tk 2.3 crore to Saif Powertec, then mock the BSL logo launch, its Hindi theme song and promised Maradona/Ronaldo appearances that never happened; the launch concert also damages the Bangabandhu Stadium ground.

incidents.title: Fans demand Lopez sacked after winless start, BFF sack him and appoint Maruful
incidents.summary: After a draw with second-division Arambagh and defeats to a Myanmar club side, a Chinese club and Tajikistan 5-0, fans chant #lopez_out; BFF sack Lopez on 24 November and appoint Maruful Haque, and Wali Faisal says Lopez told him a local coach had told him not to pick him.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal transfer war: dues row, league and AFC boycott threats, president Kader's resignation
incidents.summary: Sheikh Jamal's 1.44-crore dues row escalated into a transfer war with league and AFC Cup boycott threats. Chaos at the team hotel after the Gold Cup semi-final defeat as officials fought over players, with claims an armed man entered Mamunul's room; rival clubs took eleven Jamal players, the club threatened to boycott the AFC Cup, captain Mamunul said he would never play for Jamal again, and president Manjur Kader resigned.

incidents.title: Sylhet Academy closes within a year after FIFA's 700,000 dollars
incidents.summary: The Sylhet Academy, launched with FIFA's 700,000 dollars and costing a crore a year to run, closes within a year with no sponsor or budget.

incidents.title: Age-fraud culture exposed as overage players are sent to U13 tournaments
incidents.summary: Fans ask why 17-18-year-olds are sent in U13 teams and mock the age-fraud culture in which overage sides beat Ronaldinho's Brazil and Dinamo Zagreb at the Mokh Cup yet the same generation fails AFC U16 qualifiers.

incidents.title: National team players get no contract, salary or injury support in camp
incidents.summary: SAFF camp food is worse than under the previous foreign coaches with Jamal in hospital, and fans ask what players get in camp: no central contract, no salary or injury support, poor food and no proper gym despite a reported 6 crore taka spent on the team.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Gold Cup downgraded as teams send youth squads
incidents.summary: Defending champions Malaysia balk at the January Bangabandhu Gold Cup and Bahrain and Maldives send U21 squads instead of national teams.

incidents.title: SAFF 2015 organisation descends into chaos in Kerala
incidents.summary: Mismanagement begins at the SAFF Suzuki Cup in Kerala: no practice grounds or buses, six-hour hotel check-ins, Nepal taken to the wrong Taj hotel, Bangladesh players two to a bed, and a 5,000-rupee charge for a meeting room.

incidents.title: Attack on BFF office halts Championship and third-division leagues
incidents.summary: The Professional League Committee suspend the Championship League until further notice in protest at the attack on the BFF office, then third-division football is stopped too. Suggested new category: attack_on_federation_office. Suggested new category: attacks_on_federation.

incidents.title: Fans plan human-chain protest outside BFF after SAFF exit
incidents.summary: Supporters propose a human chain in front of the BFF building on Saturday 2 January at 3pm with banners from all football groups to save football, ending with a memorandum in English since Salahuddin does not read Bangla.

incidents.title: Fans push the expatriate route after the SAFF exit
incidents.summary: After the SAFF exit fans demand BFF hold fair trials for expatriate Bangladeshis via embassies, pointing to Tottenham academy coach Taff Rahman and the ignored English-based talent pool.

incidents.title: Maruful Haque's future uncertain after SAFF exit
incidents.summary: Fans plead not to sack Maruf after the SAFF exit and ask to keep him till March, then breaking news says he will not stay even after BFF's offer, before BFF keep him for the Bangabandhu Gold Cup with no contract length stated.

incidents.title: SAFF exit exposes grouping and fights inside the national team
incidents.summary: After the SAFF group-stage exit, an Alokito report describes a Sheikh Jamal group and a rising-players group inside the team, Jamal pushing Yeasin who throws punches back in the Bhutan match, and fans demand Babu's sacking, a probe and lifetime bans, while ex-players say Salahuddin should resign. Suggested new category: player_grouping_syndicate. Suggested new category: team_grouping_conflict.

incidents.title: Fans demand BFF publish its audit report amid fabricated-figure claims
incidents.summary: Prothom Alo reports BFF’s three-year audit was approved with amendments, and fans demand it be published, then question an audit claim of Tk 14 crore spent on women’s football.

incidents.title: Jessore stadium chosen for the Gold Cup is slammed as unfit
incidents.summary: Fans criticise the poor Jessore stadium chosen for Bangabandhu Gold Cup matches, and BFF president Salahuddin later says he was shocked by the venue.

incidents.title: SAFF failure: Mamunul's 70% success claim rebutted as fans demand the inquiry report
incidents.summary: Fans rebut captain Mamunul Islam's claim of 70% success in the year, carry a banner reading 'Remove Mamunul and Salahuddin, save Bangladesh football', and mock Mamunul's open letter after the Gold Cup failures.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Gold Cup invites weak sides to whitewash the SAFF failure
incidents.summary: BFF are mocked for inviting weak sides such as a fifth-placed Malaysian league team, Bahrain's youth team and U-20/21/22 Asian sides to the hastily arranged Bangabandhu Gold Cup instead of full national teams, in a bid to whitewash the SAFF failure.

incidents.title: National players play paid 'khep' exhibitions after SAFF failure
incidents.summary: Captain Mamunul Islam and most national players play paid 'khep' exhibition finals in Narayanganj days after the SAFF exit, drawing anger and defences that players need the money.

incidents.title: Clubs offer only one-season contracts as transfer trouble erupts every year
incidents.summary: Fans complain transfer trouble erupts every season and clubs offer only one-season contracts instead of 2-3 year deals for key players, developing neither themselves nor the country's football.

incidents.title: Foreign-player naturalisation debate splits fans
incidents.summary: Fans argue over whether Bangladeshi clubs should sign European players instead of third-class Africans, whether foreign players in the league should be given a chance or citizenship, and warn citizenship for foreigners would ruin football.

incidents.title: Fans turn on interim coach Maruful Haque after Gold Cup failures
incidents.summary: Fans question interim coach Maruful Haque's selections and tactics after the draw with Nepal's youth team and the Gold Cup exit, though Maruful takes the blame himself, the first responsible person to own a failure.

incidents.title: U-23 and Olympic squad selections questioned before the South Asian Games
incidents.summary: Fans ask why Jiya, Rezaul and Arup Baidya play for the U-23 side while Rayhan, Tapu and Liton sit on the senior bench, and question why Mamunul is not among the three seniors named for the Olympic team.

incidents.title: South Asian Games preparation in disarray
incidents.summary: With the South Asian Games days away there is no preparation, footballers face passport and visa dramas while a sprinter is sent without trial, and the team then draws 1-1 with Bhutan and finishes third as Nepal take the gold Bangladesh once won.

incidents.title: Zahid Hossain dropped from Gold Cup squad for midnight hotel breach
incidents.summary: Winger Zahid Hossain is dropped from the team for leaving the hotel at midnight without telling anyone during the Bangabandhu Gold Cup; fans tell him to apologise and leave the national team.

incidents.title: SAFF failure inquiry blames indiscipline; seven players show-caused amid drug and alcohol claims

entities.name: Sheikh Mohammad Aslam
entities.role: former player / BFF executive committee member

incidents.summary: The SAFF failure inquiry committee led by Sheikh Mohammad Aslam blames indiscipline most of all, claiming most players are addicted to alcohol and many smoke; seven footballers are show-caused, Zahid Hossain apologises for drinking before the Nepal match, and fans ask why only players are in the dock when BFF is blamed for the failure.

incidents.title: Sheikh Mohammad Aslam resigns from the BFF executive committee

entities.name: Sheikh Mohammad Aslam
entities.role: former player / BFF executive committee member

incidents.summary: Former national striker Sheikh Mohammad Aslam resigns from the BFF executive committee, saying he joined in 2008 dreaming of working for football's development but felt he could not do any work there.

incidents.title: Mamunul and Zahid banned a year, Sohel and Yeasin six months for indiscipline
incidents.summary: BFF ban captain Mamunul Islam and Zahid Hossain from the national team for one year and Sohel Rana and Yeasin Khan for six months for indiscipline; Mamunul calls it an injustice and fans ask why Zahid, with many precedents, got only a year.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal's AFC Cup and Independence Cup flip-flopping ends in court
incidents.summary: BFF send national players to play in Magura instead of releasing them for Sheikh Jamal's AFC Cup tie with Ceres, Jamal flip-flop over the AFC Cup and Independence Cup, Arambagh officials lock the BFF building, Chittagong Abahani challenge Jamal in the High Court, and Wedson Anselme blames the rented local players' mentality after the 4-3 Selangor loss.

incidents.title: Refereeing row in Sheikh Jamal's 4-3 AFC Cup loss to Selangor
incidents.summary: Fans say the referee denied Sheikh Jamal two clear penalties, including handballs inside the box, as Jamal lose 4-3 at home to Selangor in the AFC Cup after twice leading.

incidents.title: Fans call for Moreno's sacking after UAE defeat; miss de Kruif
incidents.summary: After the UAE friendly defeat coach Gonzalo Sanchez Moreno claims all three goals were offside, fans say his time is up and call for a new coach before the Asian Cup play-offs, missing Lodewijk de Kruif and comparing his profile unfavourably with war-torn Afghanistan's coach.

incidents.title: BFF election 2016: vote-buying, huge costs and fear of a FIFA ban
incidents.summary: The 30 April BFF election is fought with mud-slinging, a 25-point manifesto of undeliverable dreams read out in Salahuddin's absence, claims president and vice-president posts cost Tk 1.5-2 crore to contest and councillors' votes are bought for Tk 10-20 lakh, journalists locked in a meeting room, a stolen phone at the Radisson media centre, and fear of a FIFA ban as Salahuddin alleges threats. After the vote, fans note the federation cannot pay the national coach's Tk 30 lakh salary yet spent over Tk 60 crore on the election, and mock the manifesto promise of an academy in every upazila, which would need one academy every three days.

incidents.title: Refereeing complaints in Jordan's 8-0 World Cup qualifier win
incidents.summary: Fans complain of awful refereeing, a joke penalty and a wrongly awarded corner as Jordan beat Bangladesh 8-0 in the final World Cup qualifier, ending the campaign bottom of the group with one point.

incidents.title: Ex-player Shamsul Alam Manju complains to FIFA over BFF irregularities
incidents.summary: Former national player Shamsul Alam Manju applies to FIFA to act against BFF's irregularities and unethical practices, including alleged looting of football academy funds, and Mamunul Islam says the players' court is FIFA-AFC if the federation gives no solution.

incidents.title: Fikru Teferra and Zahid Hassan Emily fight in the Sheikh Russel dressing room
incidents.summary: After Sheikh Russel's match, Fikru Teferra and Zahid Hassan Emily fight in the dressing room over not passing to each other, leaving Fikru with an injured hand and Emily with a cut lip, both admitted to Apollo Hospital.

incidents.title: De Kruif returns on a one-month contract with banned players recalled
incidents.summary: Lodewijk de Kruif returns as national coach on a one-month contract for the Tajikistan Asian Cup play-off, with the banned footballers to be brought back; banned stopper Yeasin Khan refuses to apply for his punishment to be lifted and says he will not play for the national team.

incidents.title: Tajikistan play-off squad: Abahani bench players picked, in-form Tauhid and Joseph Noor overlooked
incidents.summary: Fans protest the Tajikistan play-off squad: Tauhid, who made five assists in the Independence Cup, is not called up; eleven of the 34-man preliminary squad are from Abahani including reserve-bench players while regulars from smaller clubs are overlooked; expatriate Joseph Noor Rahman fails to satisfy de Kruif in trials; and Rahmatganj bench-warmer Syed Rashed Turjo makes the 23-man squad after one substitute appearance.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal decide not to play the 2017 AFC Cup
incidents.summary: Following the dispute with BFF, Sheikh Jamal take a preliminary decision not to play the next AFC Cup, miss the entry deadline, and Bangladesh's only AFC Cup slot is almost wasted while a Filipino football thread exposes the club's unprofessionalism.

incidents.title: Saif Powertec set to buy BPL rights for five years as Soccer League UK quits Bangladesh
incidents.summary: Saif Powertec are set to buy the BPL rights for five years while BFF cannot meddle, singer MP Momtaz is made BPL brand ambassador, and Soccer League UK say they are no longer working in Bangladesh and to talk to Saif Powertec instead.

incidents.title: No channel shows the Federation Cup as Channel 9 prefers Euro and Copa America
incidents.summary: Channel 9 does not show the Federation Cup, preferring the Euro and Copa America because showing the Federation Cup means a loss, while fans say children would be inspired to play if domestic football were broadcast.

incidents.title: Federation Cup gives an iron as Man of the Match prize
incidents.summary: Fans mock the Federation Cup for giving an iron as the Man of the Match prize instead of a trophy. Suggested new category: farcical_awards.

incidents.title: Shafiqul Islam Manik sacked as Sheikh Jamal coach
incidents.summary: Fans predict Sheikh Jamal coach Shafiqul Islam Manik will lose his job, and a month later he is relieved of the post with Joseph Afusi returning.

incidents.title: Federation Cup: officials and ball boy assault referees after controversial goals
incidents.summary: Federation Cup refereeing collapses: officials enter the field to beat the referee, Rahmatganj are victims of wrong refereeing, Abahani get two controversial goals including a Jewel Rana handball, and the whole Brothers tent rush the referee as ball boy Raju and assistant manager Hashem Molla kick and punch the referee and his assistant.

incidents.title: Saintfiet on Nigeria's coaching shortlist; fans fear he will leave
incidents.summary: Tom Saintfiet appears on the three-coach shortlist for the Nigeria national team job and fans fear BFF will have to find another coach, though Saintfiet says his family and agent did not want him to come to Bangladesh and he is proud to be its coach.

incidents.title: Clubs refuse seven BPL venues and will play at four
incidents.summary: Four or five clubs demand the BPL cut its seven outstation venues to four, BFF bow down and drop Barisal, Rajshahi and Munshiganj despite spending crores to take the league outside Dhaka, and fans say clubs should be given walkovers or the league run without them; a month later fans defend the outstation venues, noting Mymensingh gate money proves spectators come.

incidents.title: Boishakhi TV fails to show the BPL opening ceremony and shows news instead of matches
incidents.summary: Boishakhi TV does not show the BPL opening ceremony for an unexplained unavoidable reason, shows its own news instead of matches, and its replays cover only goals, finished in a second.

incidents.title: BPL matches play to empty galleries for lack of publicity
incidents.summary: BPL matches play to empty galleries despite 8,000 complimentary tickets, and fans say miking from CNGs two days before a match will not bring spectators — publicity must reach people's drawing rooms. Suggested new category: attendance_publicity.

incidents.title: Maruful Haque fails at big-budget Sheikh Russel
incidents.summary: Fans turn on Sheikh Russel coach Maruful Haque as the big-budget side lose four in a row and go five without a win, calling his UEFA licence useless, saying the players do not care about him, and mocking his time-wasting after scoring one goal.

incidents.title: Nepotism alleged in Saintfiet's preliminary squad for Bhutan
incidents.summary: Saintfiet's preliminary squad for Bhutan is alleged to include two reserve-bench players from one club on an official's recommendation, with assistant coach Titu able to get them in; Saintfiet is reported angry at BFF over the squad announcement and fans call it nepotism.

incidents.title: Sheikh Russel humiliated in the AFC Cup as Jamal's withdrawal backfires
incidents.summary: Sheikh Russel, who took the AFC Cup place after Sheikh Jamal withdrew, draw 1-1 with Chinese Taipei's semi-professional Services team and lose to a Bhutan club, with fans saying Jamal's withdrawal was the worst decision and the expensive side cannot get past the pre-qualifying round.

incidents.title: BPL grounds likened to paddy fields
incidents.summary: BPL grounds are likened to paddy fields despite budget and time to improve them, match commentary has to be given standing drenched in the rain, and the Bangabandhu National Stadium ground is slow with long grass.

incidents.title: Fans question whether Abu Nayeem Shohag is suitable as BFF general secretary
incidents.summary: A single high-engagement post (72 reactions and comments) questioning whether Abu Nayeem Shohag is suitable as BFF general secretary after his appearance on Deepto TV's Sports Weekend.

incidents.title: Players pulled from national camp mid-preparation
incidents.summary: Clubs take players out of the national camp at their own pleasure without the coach's permission, and BFF release players mid-camp for Navy duty a week before an international match, which fans say is no different from playing khep.

incidents.title: U-16 girls reach the AFC stage but get Tk 5,000, no guardians, and BFF tries to pad the BCB reception list
incidents.summary: The U-16 girls reach the AFC stage and the Prime Minister contrasts their ten goals with the boys conceding five, but the girls have no kit sponsor, get only Tk 5,000 after a three-month camp, are released from camp without guardians, and BFF try to add employees' names to the BCB reception list while a Kolsindhur girl's father is beaten and her teacher dismissed. Later fans ask why the girls' houses are in poor condition when the Prime Minister gives a house to cricketer Mehidy Miraz, and note women's football is now where boys' football was in the 1980s and 1990s, with no women's league at all.

incidents.title: Maldives hand Bangladesh a 5-0 defeat as players stay up on Facebook and smoke
incidents.summary: Bangladesh lose 5-0 to Maldives in a preparation match that crushes morale before Bhutan; players sent abroad on public money are caught on Facebook and selfies, stay up late online in Maldives, and five footballers smoke cigarettes.

incidents.title: Mamunul 'syndicate' and group politics before the Bhutan tie
incidents.summary: Captain Mamunul Islam announces his retirement in hurt pride after being dropped, fans call him a drunkard, a virus and the head of a syndicate that drives coaches out, then he breaks the retirement and returns before the Bhutan tie amid blackmail claims, and after the 3-1 Bhutan defeat the players hold an apology press conference fans call another drama.

incidents.title: BTV commentators mocked during the Bhutan home leg
incidents.summary: Fans mock the BTV commentators during the Bhutan match, saying they do not even know where the ball was kicked and give upside-down information.

incidents.title: Tom Saintfiet resigns as national coach
incidents.summary: Coach Tom Saintfiet says BFF treat the league as bigger than the national team, no player has the fitness for 90 minutes in Bhutan and no trainer is appointed for budget reasons, then resigns and leaves Dhaka advising BFF to work at the grassroots, saying clubs pay players more than they deserve yet they give nothing to the country.

incidents.title: Bangladesh withdraw from the AFC Solidarity Cup despite a $20,000 fine
incidents.summary: BFF president Salahuddin will not send the team to the AFC Solidarity Cup, preferring to rebuild for the next SAFF Championship, even though withdrawal costs a $20,000 fine, and fans ask why Bangladesh will not play it. Nepal reach the final and then qualify for the Asian Cup as Solidarity Cup champions, rubbing in the decision.

incidents.title: Bhutan 3-1 elimination sparks Salahuddin resignation demands and street protest
incidents.summary: Bangladesh lose 3-1 in Thimphu to Bhutan, ending Asian Cup hopes, and fans demand the whole BFF committee including Kazi Salahuddin resign, hold a placard protest outside BFF House in Motijheel, debate reform demands, and call Salahuddin an iron man no insult touches as former player Abu Yusuf says he and his colleagues came to BFF to do business.

incidents.title: BFF officials alleged to have bought flats worth Tk 1.2 crore
incidents.summary: Fans allege people working in the football federation have bought flats worth Tk 1 crore 20 lakh and made a new booking, and that the Anti-Corruption Commission will say nothing.

incidents.title: FIFA grant suspended and Nepal's Bangabandhu Gold Cup prize money unpaid
incidents.summary: FIFA's financial grant to BFF is suspended and BFF still have not paid the prize money to Nepal, champions of the Bangabandhu Gold Cup.

incidents.title: Over-age players alleged in youth teams as U-14s play the Mock Cup
incidents.summary: The Mock Cup team includes five footballers who played last year's U-16 SAFF Championship, Bangladesh's U-14s beat Manchester City's U-14s though everyone says the Bangladesh players are all above 16, and the U-14 Mock Cup side includes players registered in the Bangladesh Championship League with no more than two true U-14 players.

incidents.title: BFF's four-year plan to 2020 contains no football academy
incidents.summary: Two months after the Bhutan defeat BFF announce a work plan and a long calendar to 2020, but fans note the four-year mega plan contains no plan to build an academy, despite years of discussion and dreams, and doubt the calendar will be implemented.

incidents.title: Anti-Corruption Commission sends evidence of BFF corruption to the Prime Minister
incidents.summary: Jamuna TV reports the Anti-Corruption Commission sent a three-page book with evidence about BFF's corruption to the Prime Minister, and Kazi Salahuddin denies all the allegations brought against him.

incidents.title: Relegation play-off row: BFF accused of trying to save Feni and Uttar Baridhara
incidents.summary: After Feni Soccer beat Muktijoddha 2-0 to finish level on 18 points with Uttar Baridhara, ahead on goal difference, BFF mention a two-legged relegation play-off in their match report, which fans say does not look good.

incidents.title: BFF withdraw from the Women's Asian Cup qualifiers
incidents.summary: BFF withdraw from the Women's Asian Cup qualifiers even as the U-16 girls are the country's only success, spending hugely on the Gold Cup and Sheikh Kamal Cup while withdrawing teams, and officials are too reluctant even to receive the girls at the airport; the AFC confirms Bangladesh is not taking part.

incidents.title: BFF general secretary Shohag accused of harassing an employee
incidents.summary: An Ekattor TV report says a BFF employee was harassed, blaming general secretary Abu Nayeem Shohag, and fans ask whether Shohag is absconding.

incidents.title: Sheikh Kamal Cup exposes how weak the domestic clubs are
incidents.summary: Fans say even begging will not bring spectators to the Sheikh Kamal Cup, and its one success is showing the nation how weak the clubs are, losing to small clubs even after borrowing players.

incidents.title: Refereeing complaints in the Sheikh Kamal Cup
incidents.summary: Fans question why Indian referees are brought in, call a penalty unjustifiable, and blame losses on wrong referee decisions including a denied penalty in the 73rd minute.

incidents.title: Titu's defensive tactics slammed in the Sheikh Kamal Cup
incidents.summary: Chittagong Abahani's tactics are slammed and coach Saiful Bari Titu is attacked for his typical defensive move of a fifth defender after equalising and for Pokhara Cup wins that came only via tie-breakers and extra time.

incidents.title: Clubs accused of poaching Sheikh Jamal players and withholding passports
incidents.summary: Fans accuse three clubs of poaching Sheikh Jamal's players after their Gold Cup exit and then show-causing five players, and slam Abahani for withholding five players' passports.

incidents.title: Drago Mamic's defensive tactics slammed as Abahani lose three straight in the AFC Cup
incidents.summary: Abahani coach Drago Mamic is slammed for fielding six defenders in the 2-0 AFC Cup loss to Bengaluru, the champions' third straight defeat, and for conceding a bad goal despite five defenders.

incidents.title: Abahani's AFC Cup failure blamed on no gym or infrastructure despite crores spent
incidents.summary: Prothom Alo argues football has money but no infrastructure, with clubs spending crores on teams but not lakhs on a gym, and Abahani manager Rupu blames fitness for the AFC Cup failure while the club spends Tk 10 crore on salaries and builds no gymnasium.

incidents.title: Fans mock 100-300 taka Gulistan-quality jerseys
incidents.summary: Fans mock Mohammedan's 250-300 taka jerseys and the national and club teams' 100-200 taka Gulistan-quality jerseys despite Bangladesh being the world's second garment exporter. Suggested new category: kit_quality.

incidents.title: Andrew Ord hiring confusion and salary disagreement
incidents.summary: BFF are close to signing British-Australian Andrew Ord but cannot agree on salary, Prothom Alo runs a feature on the many foreign coaches of the Salahuddin era ending with Ord, and confusion over Ord's coaching experience follows as BFF hold an emergency meeting ignoring the most urgent issue.

incidents.title: National team coach's post called musical chairs
incidents.summary: Fans call the national team coach's post musical chairs and name Lodewijk de Kruif the worst of fifteen foreign coaches in four years, blaming him for wasting a golden generation at the 2013 SAFF.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Stadium press box glass shattered in storm, repairs promised but not done
incidents.summary: A storm breaks Bangabandhu Stadium's press box glass wall, leaving journalists suffering in the heat despite promises of repair, and fans ask when it will be fixed.

incidents.title: BPL shrouded in uncertainty and delayed by 50 days
incidents.summary: The BPL is shrouded in uncertainty and may not happen this month, and the league is then delayed by 50 days.

incidents.title: U-23 humiliated 0-7 by Jordan; renewed calls to remove Salahuddin and the BFF panel
incidents.summary: Bangladesh U-23 lose 0-7 to Jordan in the AFC U-23 qualifiers after BFF still trust coach Andrew Ord despite two straight warm-up defeats; fans repeat the call to remove Salahuddin and the entire BFF panel, Ord says players like Hemanta earn heaps from clubs but run out of steam in 30 minutes internationally, and the team's fitness is called the worst in recent times.

incidents.title: BPL sponsorship collapses from Tk 4 crore to Tk 1.5 crore
incidents.summary: League owner Saif Global Sports struggle to find sponsors, BPL sponsorship falls from Tk 4 crore to Tk 1.5 crore, and the league starts with reduced sponsor money and venues as the Saif Power Battery Premier League.

incidents.title: BPL played on monsoon muddy grounds
incidents.summary: BFF start the league in the monsoon despite bad drainage, with grounds fit for paddy cultivation, and fans ask if there is any point running the league on muddy grounds.

incidents.title: Over-aged players alleged in age-group teams
incidents.summary: BFF are accused of again calling over-aged players to age-group teams, with FIFA warned it could ban Bangladesh if age cheating is proven; fans ask how many of the U-15s are over 15 and whether the U-18s are really U-18, recalling the previous over-aged SAFF U-16 champions, and debate whether Jafar Iqbal and Tutul Badsha are over-aged.

incidents.title: U-16 women's team prepared against school teams, then lost 9-0 to North Korea

entities.name: North Korea U-16 women's national team

incidents.summary: Bangladesh's U-16 girls lose 9-0 to North Korea after BFF arrange preparation matches against Chinese and Korean school teams instead of big teams, with a turf-to-grass switch and morning practice before afternoon matches blamed, and fans appeal to BFF to keep the girls and invest in them instead of throwing them away like the last SAFF-winning girls.

incidents.title: #Salauddin_out and #Save_Bangladesh_Football protest wave
incidents.summary: Fans mock #Vision_200 and launch a #Salauddin_out and #Save_Bangladesh_Football protest wave on BFF's page and TV channels' pages after the U-18 comeback win over India, calling for a social mass awakening and asking what Salahuddin has done to earn such hatred despite age-group successes.

incidents.title: Fans ask whether the BFF committee is approved as a post is deleted and reposted
incidents.summary: A single high-engagement post (194 reactions and comments) asking whether this is an approved BFF committee, reposted after the first post was deleted.

incidents.title: Refereeing row in Bangladesh U-16's 0-2 loss to Yemen
incidents.summary: Fans blame the referee for Bangladesh U-16's 0-2 loss to Yemen in the AFC U-16 Championship, saying the first penalty was a clear dive and the second goal was offside.

incidents.title: Sabina Yasmin dies; U-15 women's camp had no doctor or health checks
incidents.summary: Kolsindur teenage midfielder Sabina Yasmin dies from a slight fever without joining the U-15 camp, and fans ask why there was no doctor or health check at camp and why she could not afford primary treatment. Two fan posts mistakenly call her Sabina Khatun (the senior women's star, who is alive); the player who died was Sabina Yasmin.

incidents.title: Aminul Haque's English league dream shattered by BFF indifference
incidents.summary: The dream of the first Bangladeshi playing in the English league was shattered by BFF officials' indifference and communication problems, in a story about Aminul Haque, who says he was too young then to make contact on his own.

incidents.title: AFC result page error: Bangladesh shown as winners, then deleted
incidents.summary: The AFC's match report claims Maldives won by Sufil's own goal, then shows Bangladesh as winners on the result page and deletes it, which fans call unprecedented, while Nepal's update is available though its match ended later.

incidents.title: Brunei's last-minute withdrawal alleged to be fixing
incidents.summary: A single high-engagement post (122 reactions and comments) saying Brunei, notorious for regularly withdrawing from continental tournaments, withdrew one day before the group games, which the poster will never rule out as fixing.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Stadium ground in terrible state
incidents.summary: A single high-engagement post (102 reactions and comments) complaining about the terrible state of the Bangabandhu Stadium ground, saying even Cambodia and Laos have far better grounds and passing football is impossible there.

incidents.title: Abahani lose coach Drago Mamic to Thai club Chainat Hornbill
incidents.summary: Abahani lose a good coach as Drago Mamic takes leave and joins Thai club Chainat Hornbill.

incidents.title: Emeka Ezeugo's $22,000 dues unpaid; BFF risk FIFA action
incidents.summary: BFF are still reluctant to deduct Mohammedan's three points, and former Mohammedan coach Emeka Ezeugo's $22,000 arrears are not paid by the 18 December deadline, so he may go to FIFA again, with fans accusing BFF of risking the country's football to protect one club.

incidents.title: BFF accused of forgetting Saif after smelling an eight-crore package
incidents.summary: A single high-engagement post (92 reactions and comments) accusing BFF of forgetting Saif after smelling an eight-crore-taka package, saying Abdus Salam Murshedy should have asked Saif first instead of announcing a principled decision.

incidents.title: BFF and AFC corruption alleged in nostalgic essay on 2012-13 Sheikh Russel
incidents.summary: Essay calls 2012-13 Sheikh Russel the century's best Bangladeshi club while accusing BFF and AFC of corruption.

incidents.title: SAFF U-15 champion girls given blankets and 1 lakh taka, then garlands only
incidents.summary: SAFF U-15 women's champions from Kalsindur got only blankets and 1 lakh taka each, then a felicitation of garlands and crests with no money.

incidents.title: Farashganj's shock win over Sheikh Jamal alleged fixed; Kamal Babu accused of asking Saif to concede
incidents.summary: Farashganj's 3-1 win over Sheikh Jamal to escape relegation is called a fixed match, Kamal Babu is accused of asking Saif to concede, and BFF's panel probes suspected fixes as FIFA weighs points deductions.

incidents.title: Vegetable field grown inside Bangabandhu National Stadium for 20 years
incidents.summary: Reports reveal a vegetable field grown inside Bangabandhu National Stadium by the groundsman for 20 years; a follow-up defends him.

incidents.title: Saif-Rahmatganj league match played with no live telecast
incidents.summary: Saif trail Rahmatganj 2-0 with no live telecast or Facebook live, and fans demand an explanation from the club.

incidents.title: Saif's AFC Cup qualifying exit amid heavy defeats to Maldivian sides
incidents.summary: Bangladeshi clubs keep losing heavily to Maldivian sides as Saif exit the AFC Cup qualifiers 4-1 to TC Sports, with questions over fielding loaned players.

incidents.title: Women's football neglected despite success: no league, no pipeline, no funding

entities.name: Mahfuza Akter Kiron
entities.role: BFF women's wing chairperson and FIFA councillor

incidents.summary: Despite the girls' success, BFF runs no women's league or pipeline, drops the women's team from the Asian Games, sends them to futsal with no plan, and pays camp costs from players' own pockets.

incidents.title: CID arrests seven, including five Nigerian footballers, on fraud charges
incidents.summary: CID arrests seven people, including five Nigerian footballers, on fraud charges.

incidents.title: Where do Premier League clubs get 1-8 crore taka a season with no sponsors?
incidents.summary: A fan questions where Premier League clubs get 1-8 crore taka per season from when most have no sponsors, arguing clubs have no real intent to develop football professionally.

incidents.title: Player on 35 lakh taka salary accused of playing unauthorised 'khep' matches
incidents.summary: A Prothom Alo report alleges a player on a 35 lakh taka salary played unauthorised 'khep' matches.

incidents.title: One of the league's best performers left out of the national team
incidents.summary: A Prothom Alo report notes one of the league's best performers is not in the national team.

incidents.title: Monem Munna remembered; BFF and Abahani criticised for forgetting the late legend
incidents.summary: On Monem Munna's 13th death anniversary, fans note BFF and Abahani forgot him while the people of Narayanganj still remember.

incidents.title: AFC unhappy with Bangladeshi professional football; clubs called 'merely a group'
incidents.summary: AFC is unhappy with Bangladesh's professional football, demands at least six venues, calls clubs 'merely a group', and warns BFF over floodlights as licensing rules keep clubs out of the AFC Cup.

incidents.title: Players from a country ranked near 200th get 80 lakh taka in transfers
incidents.summary: A fan reacts incredulously to players from a country ranked near 200th getting 80 lakh taka in transfers.

incidents.title: Expatriate Reasat Islam ignored by BFF despite dearth of quality footballers
incidents.summary: Welsh Premier League player Reasat Islam is argued to be ignored by BFF despite the dearth of quality footballers.

incidents.title: Transfer window row over inflated salaries and pay versus performance
incidents.summary: Fans row over inflated transfer demands, with Matin Mia wanting 50 lakh and Jafar Iqbal 80, Saif's MD calling expensive signings disappointing, and pay held up against performance.

incidents.title: Abahani's AFC Cup failure blamed on coach Saiful Bari Titu's defensive tactics
incidents.summary: Abahani's AFC Cup campaign collapses under coach Saiful Bari Titu's ultra-defensive tactics, from the home loss to New Radiant through Bengaluru and Aizawl to the 5-1 defeat at New Radiant.

incidents.title: 'Footballers don't grow on trees': Bangladesh produces no creative players
incidents.summary: Sharing a Prothom Alo piece headlined 'Footballers don't grow on trees', fans lament that Bangladesh produces no creative players.

incidents.title: March national squad: Mamun Mia picked on 240 league minutes as in-form players are dropped
incidents.summary: The March national squad is attacked for picking injury-hit Mamun Mia, who played only 240 league minutes, and benchwarmer keeper Zico while in-form Faisal, Sushanto and others are dropped, with the Laos draw fallout blamed on the same selections.

incidents.title: Transfer-time syndicates inflate player prices, fans allege
incidents.summary: A fan alleges that at transfer time self-proclaimed world-class players spread syndicates and rumours to inflate their prices, then spin stories when criticised.

incidents.title: Sabina Khatun and Krishna Rani Sarkar denied visas for the Indian Women's League
incidents.summary: Sabina Khatun and Krishna Rani Sarkar are refused Indian visas twice and miss the first Indian Women's League with Sethu FC.

incidents.title: Matin Mia's indiscipline with the national team after 17 months away
incidents.summary: Matin Mia is said to have committed the same offence with the national team returning after 17 months that Mithun and Emily did before the 2011 World Cup qualifiers.

incidents.title: Andrew Ord quits as Bangladesh coach for a Thai club
incidents.summary: Andrew Ord suddenly quits as Bangladesh coach and leaves for a Thai club.

incidents.title: Death of Monir Hossain Monu, the neglected 1980s star
incidents.summary: Monir Hossain Monu, the 1980s star nicknamed 'Black Panther', dies aged 56 after years of neglect, with BFF not even knowing his real name.

incidents.title: Age theft: seven years, so Abahani's 'win'
incidents.summary: A Prothom Alo report headlined on 'age theft' of seven years is linked to Abahani's win.

incidents.title: Married footballers playing in age-level football
incidents.summary: A Prothom Alo report alleges married footballers are playing in age-level football.

incidents.title: BFF joins Saudi-led SWAFF alliance; Bangladesh's share of its money hidden
incidents.summary: BFF joins Saudi Arabia's new SWAFF alliance, Bangladesh's share of its money is hidden by Salahuddin, and the AFC seeks an explanation from BFF.

incidents.title: Badal Roy in conflict with BFF general secretary Abu Nayeem Shohag; wife files police GD
incidents.summary: BFF vice-president Badal Roy's wife files a general diary after general secretary Abu Nayeem Shohag allegedly threatens him by phone, as the family fears for Badal Roy's life.

incidents.title: Qatar camp squad leaves out in-form players
incidents.summary: The 28 footballers taken to the Qatar camp leave out goalkeeper Sohel, Sabuz, Rahmat Mia, Jewel Rana, Sohel Rana, Rubel Mia, Faisal and Rayhan Hasan.

incidents.title: Fans demand Kazi Salahuddin step down
incidents.summary: Fans demand BFF president Kazi Salahuddin step down with honour and be removed to save Bangladesh football.

incidents.title: National team practising in Colombia's jersey; BFF too poor to buy practice kits
incidents.summary: The national team is spotted practising in Qatar in a kit that is basically the Colombia away jersey with a BFF logo, and later BFF is mocked for being too poor to buy practice kits. Suggested new category: kit and equipment failure.

incidents.title: Special Olympics Unified Cup: disqualified over hand-written jersey number; player goes missing in the US
incidents.summary: Bangladesh are disqualified from the Special Olympics Unified Cup in Chicago after reaching the semi-final because a player's jersey number was hand-written, and disabled footballer Rezwanul Haque goes missing in the United States.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu National Stadium renovated in a slapdash, patchwork manner
incidents.summary: Bangabandhu National Stadium is reported to be renovated in a slapdash, patchwork manner.

incidents.title: BFF failure costs Bangladesh an AFC Cup slot
incidents.summary: Due to BFF's failure, only one team from Bangladesh will get a chance in the AFC Cup this time.

incidents.title: Asian Games logistics: return tickets pre-booked, no team doctor
incidents.summary: The Asian Games football team's return ticket is booked for 21 August before the knockouts, and there is no doctor with the team.

incidents.title: Women's team missing from the Asian Games
incidents.summary: Fans ask why Bangladesh is not in the senior national women's football event at the Asian Games when the girls have been playing so well for so long.

incidents.title: Why has BFF never approached Taff Rahman?
incidents.summary: Former Tottenham and England U18 coach Taff Rahman becomes assistant coach of Guyana, and fans ask why BFF has never approached him or offered him an opportunity.

incidents.title: Local match played almost entirely by foreign, mostly Nigerian, players
incidents.summary: A competitive local match is noted to have 90 percent foreign players, truthfully Nigerians, lamenting the state of affairs.

incidents.title: SAFF 2018 squad: Jafar Iqbal and Matin Mia omitted, 'lobbying politics' blamed
incidents.summary: Coach Jamie Day's 20-member SAFF squad leaves out Asian Games performers Jafar Iqbal and Matin Mia, with fans blaming lobbying politics, club quotas and Rupu's influence, and questioning how transparent selection is.

incidents.title: Asian Games: 'baseless' refereeing against North Korea
incidents.summary: Bangladesh's 1-3 Asian Games loss to North Korea is blamed on baseless refereeing, with Bangladesh booked for offences the Koreans were not and North Korean players accused of diving.

incidents.title: SAFF 2018 venue not ready: floodlights, broken galleries and no promotion
incidents.summary: With the SAFF Championship days away, Bangabandhu Stadium's floodlights are not raised to the required level, balls and tickets are stuck at the airport, most gallery chairs are broken, 90 percent of tickets go to organisations, and there is no promotion.

incidents.title: Syndicate, drinking and misconduct caught on hotel CCTV, fan alleges
incidents.summary: A long post alleges a syndicate, drinking and misconduct caught on hotel CCTV, while calling Bangladesh football a cancer.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Gold Cup 2018 organisation failures

entities.name: Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman National Gold Cup

incidents.summary: The Bangabandhu Gold Cup is hit by organisation failures: defending champions Nepal are announced then absent amid a prize-money dispute, Nilphamari is dropped as a venue, there is no promotion in Sylhet, teams practise on a single ground, and matches are played on farmland.

incidents.title: SAFF exit blamed on goalkeeper Sohel; Rupu-Abahani link questioned; Sohel dropped from Gold Cup squad
incidents.summary: After the SAFF exit, goalkeeper Sohel is blamed and his selection is tied to Abahani manager Rupu, who is also national team manager; Sohel is then dropped from the Bangabandhu Gold Cup squad.

incidents.title: After SAFF exit, fans demand Salahuddin and Rupu resign; Rupu threatens a journalist
incidents.summary: After Bangladesh's home SAFF exit, fans demand BFF president Kazi Salahuddin and manager Satyajit Das Rupu resign, call for a movement and government intervention, and report Rupu threatening Ekattor TV journalist Saiful Rupok at the team hotel over a story on his role in picking goalkeeper Sohel.

incidents.title: Women's team success unrewarded; male manager and Paul Smalley questioned
incidents.summary: The women's team's success goes unrewarded, with coach Golam Rabbani Choton left off the financial awards list at a reception, while fans question the male manager in the women's team and technical director Paul Smalley.

incidents.title: AFC Cup slots lost: only one slot, only five licensed clubs
incidents.summary: Bangladesh is set to get only one AFC Cup slot, a qualifier slot, with only five clubs holding an AFC licence, and by November the fear comes true with no representation in the 2019 AFC Cup.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Gold Cup squad rows: Saad dropped after road accident, Matin benched, Jafar still sidelined
incidents.summary: Saad Uddin is dropped from the Bangabandhu Gold Cup squad after a road accident, Matin Mia is benched amid Jamie Day's anger at his 'khep' play, Yasin Khan sits on the bench, and Jafar Iqbal remains sidelined.

incidents.title: Clubs sign other leagues' rejects: Kings' ISL and I-League rejects, Abahani's Belfort and Saighani
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings are criticised for signing ISL reject Belfort, I-League reject Saighani and Maldives league reject Gotor after bringing in World Cupper Colindres, and Abahani are criticised for signing the same rejects as proof of poor scouting.

incidents.title: 2017 Gold Cup hero Shihab Hasan now a van driver while still a school student
incidents.summary: The player who captained the 2017 Bangabandhu Gold Cup runners-up and was man of the tournament is today a van driver while still a class six student.

incidents.title: Cox's Bazar Stadium has hardly any grass and a muddy goalpost area
incidents.summary: Cox's Bazar Stadium is reported to have hardly any grass, uneven soil and a muddy goalpost area, and fans argue international matches should not be held there.

incidents.title: Sirat Jahan Shopna denied the SAFF U-18 top scorer award
incidents.summary: Fans protest that Sirat Jahan Shopna, who scored 8 goals including a double hat-trick against Pakistan, was denied the SAFF U-18 Championship top scorer award.

incidents.title: Mohammedan's decline: bluffers, a group keeping Lokman in charge, no jerseys, relegation fears
incidents.summary: Mohammedan are accused of running on bluffing, with a group keeping Lokman in charge to finish the club, no jerseys for fans, group-stage exits in both cups from 2016 to 2018, and relegation fears after defeat to NoFeL.

incidents.title: Badal Roy demands BFF president Kazi Salahuddin resign
incidents.summary: BFF vice-president Badal Roy demands the resignation of BFF president Kazi Salahuddin.

incidents.title: Nasir's token-money row: clubs appeal, one-year ban threatened
incidents.summary: Dhaka Abahani, Rahmatganj and BJMC appeal to the BPL Players' Status Committee, claiming Nasir took token money from Abahani but plays for Bashundhara, and Nasir faces a one-year ban if no settlement is reached.

incidents.title: Referees 'influenced' by BFF officials standing in dugouts as club managers
incidents.summary: Referees are said to be certainly influenced when people who are simultaneously BFF officials, club managers and national team managers stand in the dugout, with the Federation Cup final incident cited and referees assaulted by club officials.

incidents.title: Federation Cup prize money: champions 5 lakh taka, runners-up 3 lakh
incidents.summary: The Federation Cup champion gets 5 lakh taka and the runners-up 3 lakh, which fans mock as unchanged until Judgment Day, questioning whether teams spend crores for such prize money. Suggested new category: tournament prize money.

incidents.title: Planned tri-nation series collapses; Bangladesh left with no international fixtures
incidents.summary: The planned tri-nation series between Bangladesh, Bhutan and Sri Lanka is not happening as Bhutan and Sri Lanka do not respond positively, leaving Bangladesh asking when it will play an international match again.

incidents.title: Women's football in decline: out of FIFA rankings, player dies of fever, rewards row
incidents.summary: Women's football is said to have fallen to an ordinary level, Bangladesh are out of the women's FIFA rankings after 18 months without a match, a women's team member dies of fever in Kalsindur village without help, and the rewards for SAFF-winning boys and girls are compared.

incidents.title: U-15 team 'really 17-18': age cheating alleged
incidents.summary: Fans allege the U-15 team players look and most probably are 18 and over rather than 14, that the Thailand touring side are really 17-18 and honours students, and call for honesty about age-level teams.

incidents.title: Channel Nine's Federation Cup broadcast and marketing criticised
incidents.summary: Fans criticise Channel Nine's Federation Cup coverage, from giving the tournament 36 seconds on Khelajog to not showing Arambagh's goal, and say there is no trust in the channel, while an Abahani-Sheikh Jamal match is not shown on TV.

incidents.title: Concert at Bangabandhu Stadium stops the Federation Cup
incidents.summary: A concert called In Search of Roots at Bangabandhu Stadium stops the ongoing Federation Cup, with the stadium handed to the ministry by the National Sports Council and Kamal Babu lamenting that football's matches are stopped for concerts.

incidents.title: Titu mocked after moving to Sheikh Russel
incidents.summary: Titu is mocked for having only a handful of tactics after Sheikh Russel beat Abahani, with memes asking what his tactics would be after months of hard work with Sheikh Russel.

incidents.title: Foreign players in the Independence Cup crowd out youngsters
incidents.summary: Fans question registered foreign footballers playing in Independence Cup 2018 as before, asking where youngsters will prove themselves and where the opportunity is for rising players.

incidents.title: BFF takes no action over unsportsmanlike behaviour on the field
incidents.summary: BFF senior vice-president Salam Murshedy says BFF is not taking any action right now against players for unsportsmanlike behaviour on the field, and fans wait to see what punishment BFF gives.

incidents.title: International fraud ring posing as footballers or businessmen
incidents.summary: A statement is quoted that an international circle of 14 people entered Bangladesh posing as footballers or businessmen to run frauds targeting wealthy people.

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings' empty galleries despite free jerseys and reserved buses
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings' matches draw empty galleries despite thousands of free jerseys and reserved buses, and fans criticise the club's marketing.

incidents.title: Independence Cup suffers a spectator drought
incidents.summary: The Independence Cup suffers a spectator drought due to the league committee's negligence and poor scheduling, and fans argue it should have been taken outside Dhaka.

incidents.title: Broken chairs at Bangabandhu Stadium contrasted with Korean galleries
incidents.summary: Photos of a college gallery in South Korea and a private company's own ground are contrasted with the broken chairs at Bangabandhu Stadium.

incidents.title: BFF academy saga: 5.5 crore taka FIFA grant unspent, Sylhet BKSP academy closed
incidents.summary: The Sylhet BKSP academy closed after nearly 5.5 crore taka of FIFA grant was not spent on it, with fans asking where FIFA's money went, and the BFF president's promised academy opening date mocked.

incidents.title: Swadhin Bangla football team again demand recognition
incidents.summary: The Swadhin Bangla football team again demand recognition for their role in the liberation war at a BFF reception, nine years after their last reception, while fans lament the freedom fighters have no place in the pages of history. Suggested new category: recognition of historic teams.

incidents.title: Opposition to naturalisation: Kingsley and Bangura almost arranged to play for Bangladesh
incidents.summary: Fans oppose BFF adopting naturalisation, noting Lee Tuck is shortlisted for Malaysia and that Kingsley and Bangura were almost arranged to play for Bangladesh.

incidents.title: English coach plans FIFA complaint against Mohammedan
incidents.summary: An English coach planned a FIFA complaint against Mohammedan SC, the first sign of the club's contract and pay disputes in 2019.

incidents.title: BPL delayed again as the new season slips from December to January
incidents.summary: Fans attacked the repeated postponement of the Bangladesh Premier League, delayed from December to January with a year since the last match, and called for a smaller league.

incidents.title: Mohammedan staffer Karim earns only 9,500 taka a month
incidents.summary: A post highlighted the hardship of Karim, a Mohammedan staffer earning only 9,500 taka, as an emblem of how poorly club staff are paid.

incidents.title: National team trainer resigns and Jamie Day's return is doubted
incidents.summary: The national team's English trainer resigned in January, raising doubts over whether head coach Jamie Day would return.

incidents.title: Hamza Choudhury: a source of regret as expatriate hopes stall
incidents.summary: Hamza Choudhury was called a source of regret for Bangladesh fans after Jamie Day said he had not responded positively, while other expatriates were named as the talent BFF must attract.

incidents.title: Noakhali pitch so poor Saif should have boycotted the match
incidents.summary: The poor Noakhali pitch drew anger, with fans saying Saif should have boycotted the match and that it would have been better not to play on it.

incidents.title: Offside controversies in the Abahani-Kings match
incidents.summary: Offside decisions in the Dhaka Abahani-Bashundhara Kings match and Abahani's Federation Cup win over Arambagh sparked a refereeing row, with the Kings president's claim disputed.

incidents.title: League and national-team broadcasts poor or absent
incidents.summary: Fans complained the Arambagh-Saif broadcast made players look like ants, sampled the league's poor broadcast quality, and noted no Bangladeshi channel showed national-team matches on Independence Day.

incidents.title: Lokman and Babu accused of finishing Mohammedan
incidents.summary: Mohammedan supporters were urged to protest before Lokman and Babu finished the club, with the pair blamed for the club's decline.

incidents.title: Abahani's 5-1 win claimed to be fixed
incidents.summary: A poster claimed Dhaka Abahani's 5-1 win was fixed and the league farce had begun.

incidents.title: Anti-Corruption Commission summons BFF president Salahuddin
incidents.summary: The Anti-Corruption Commission summoned BFF president Kazi Salahuddin over irregularity and embezzlement allegations, and fans listed his other controversies: unpaid players and coach, Nepal's FIFA complaint over prize money and an unpaid camp food supplier.

incidents.title: Outgoing Mohammedan coach Nasir alleges interference in team selection
incidents.summary: Outgoing Mohammedan head coach Ali Asghar Nasir spoke of interference in team selection and being undermined.

incidents.title: Syndicate claims: 2015 Emily-Babu-Mamunul and talents lost to senior stars
incidents.summary: A post recalled a 2015 claim of an Emily-Babu-Mamunul syndicate in the national team, with Enamul denied key passes in a Singapore friendly, and another feared talents like Taklis, Jewel Rana and Hemanta, lost to a senior stars' syndicate, would repeat with Rabiul and Motin.

incidents.title: BFF breached lease terms on the Motijheel sand field
incidents.summary: A report said BFF breached the lease terms on the Motijheel sand field taken from the National Sports Council.

incidents.title: Kiron corruption row: Ekattor TV report, arrest warrant, jail, bail
incidents.summary: Ekattor TV's five-part report on Mahfuza Akter Kiron's alleged irregularities led to an arrest warrant citing 167 foreign trips costing BFF about 4.5 crore taka while the women's league stayed closed; she was jailed, then bailed, and a protest demanded her expulsion for insulting the Prime Minister.

incidents.title: Kamalapur turf neglected: players cramp and get injured
incidents.summary: Fans criticised BFF's neglect of the Kamalapur turf, where players cramp and get injured while the league is rushed to finish.

incidents.title: Bangamata Gold Cup showpiece while women's football is neglected
incidents.summary: Fans attacked the Bangamata U-19 Gold Cup as a showpiece with weak opponents and lavish promotion while the women's league stayed closed for six years, the girls got 600-taka gloves in a crore-taka tournament, and players who criticised BFF had careers ended; BJMC hinted at closing its team, leaving 21 women footballers without games.

incidents.title: Match-fixing 'in discussion again'
incidents.summary: A shared report said match-fixing was in discussion again in Bangladeshi football.

incidents.title: No academy despite FIFA/AFC funds and a 2009 PM order
incidents.summary: Fans attacked BFF's failure to build an academy despite sponsor and FIFA/AFC funds and a 2009 prime ministerial order allocating Sylhet BKSP for football, mocking the announced 5 April Beraid opening as a possible April Fool joke.

incidents.title: AFC Cup and league matches fans cannot find to watch
incidents.summary: Fans complained they could not find the league champions' AFC Cup match anywhere to watch, that Rabiul's goals were not shown, and that after years no live broadcast could be arranged without begging for links.

incidents.title: Hemanta Vincent: the lost talent on the side bench
incidents.summary: Hemanta Vincent Biswas was traced from a young talent who scored on debut against India in 2013 and trialled in the Netherlands to injury, khep football and the side bench.

incidents.title: Kolsindur village disappearing from the football map
incidents.summary: Prothom Alo asked whether Kolsindur village was disappearing from the football map, and fans said its mentor Mofiz sir should have been valued.

incidents.title: Jersey contest winner Nakib Hasan still unpaid after four years
incidents.summary: BFF finally gave jersey design contest winner Nakib Hasan a certificate after four years but still had not paid the promised prize money.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Stadium drainage fails; pitches waterlogged
incidents.summary: Fans mocked the Bangabandhu National Stadium's sunken drainage, with water removed by spades, foam and broken hardboard, and warned the failure could sink the 11 June World Cup pre-qualifier home leg against Laos after the Bangamata final and a league match were cancelled.

incidents.title: Mohammedan's decline blamed on Babu, Lokman and Emily
incidents.summary: Mohammedan's fading fan base, defeats to Rahmatganj and three jersey changes in a season were blamed on manager Amirul Islam Babu, Lokman Hossain Bhuiyan and Zahid Hasan Emily.

incidents.title: World Cup pre-qualifier neglected: no camp, no squad, Jamie Day absent
incidents.summary: Laos had started camp while Bangladesh planned a late one, Pakistan named a 32-man squad while Jamie Day had not arrived and no Bangladesh squad was announced, and fans later said BFF's lack of foresight forced the pre-qualifier and then ignored the home leg.

incidents.title: Abahani goalkeeper Sohel's repeated errors, yet still selected
incidents.summary: Goalkeeper Shahidul Alam Sohel's AFC Cup mistakes were listed in a video of 11 errors in 10 matches, fans feared he would stand under the post against Laos again, and his place was still questioned after an own goal at Chennaiyin.

incidents.title: U-16 batch that beat Qatar 2-0: where are Miraz, Faisal and Deepak now?
incidents.summary: Fans asked where the U-16 batch of Miraz, Faisal and Deepak, who beat Qatar U-16 2-0 in Qatar in 2018, had gone.

incidents.title: Bangamata final abandoned to cyclone Fani; joint champions declared
incidents.summary: The Bangamata Gold Cup final was abandoned to cyclone Fani and Bangladesh and Laos declared joint champions, which fans called a surrender out of fear of losing, noting finals had been played in worse weather and mud before.

incidents.title: Runaround at BFF for a Laos ticket refund
incidents.summary: A fan described a runaround at the BFF building trying to get a refund for Bangladesh vs Laos match tickets bought at gate 3. Suggested new category: ticketing.

incidents.title: Youngsters Rabbi and Rafi ignored after representing Bangladesh
incidents.summary: Fans recalled young players Rabbi and Rafi ignored after representing Bangladesh at a FIFA tournament, and asked why Bashundhara or Saif could not look after such talents with their youth setups.

incidents.title: Arambagh's jersey has no sponsor name
incidents.summary: Fans noted Arambagh's jersey carried no sponsor name and asked what Bangladeshi sponsors look for. Suggested new category: sponsorship_crisis.

incidents.title: Bangla TV shows none of the BPL matches despite BFF's announcement
incidents.summary: Bangla TV broadcast none of the four second-leg BPL matches despite BFF's press briefing announcing sponsors and media partners, and fans kept complaining about the quality of the broadcasts that did air.

incidents.title: Noakhali field still has no grass after paddy was harvested
incidents.summary: Fans noted people had planted and harvested paddy in the meantime but grass still had not grown on Noakhali's field.

incidents.title: Laos squad: Yasin and Toklis ignored, Mamunul and Sabuz picked
incidents.summary: The Laos preliminary squad announcement drew fury: 19-year-old Yasin Arafat was left out for weaker left-backs, Toklis was ignored while Mamunul returned, Sabuz was picked, and after the matches Emon Mahmud's exclusion was still being questioned.

incidents.title: Championship League matches played at 1:45pm in the heat
incidents.summary: Fans asked whether Championship League matches were played at noon after a player pleaded not to play at 1:45pm in the heat.

incidents.title: Portugal vs Italy in Dhaka: BFF general secretary 'lied'?
incidents.summary: Fans asked whether the BFF general secretary lied or the sports state minister spoke untruth about a planned Portugal vs Italy match in Bangladesh, and mocked general secretary Shohag for changing his story.

incidents.title: BFF employee physically assaulted by Police at Bangabandhu Stadium
incidents.summary: A BFF employee was physically assaulted by Police at Bangabandhu Stadium as the club celebrated promotion. Suggested new category: violence_at_venues.

incidents.title: Bank guarantees proposed so injured juniors are not sent home with 10,000 taka
incidents.summary: A post proposed bank guarantees for Pioneer and lower-division clubs so injured junior players are not sent home with just ten thousand taka.

incidents.title: Jibon labelled a 'Rupu-quota' forward with zero goals in 12 internationals
incidents.summary: Nabib Newaj Jibon was labelled a Rupu-quota forward with zero goals in his last 12 international matches, his missed chances and tap-in goals were analysed, and fans lamented the lack of a quality scorer.

incidents.title: Three British academy coaches appointed, but low-profile
incidents.summary: BFF appointed three British academy coaches, but fans noted the main coach was very low-profile and one had no profile at all.

incidents.title: Two teams wore the same colour jerseys in the AFC Cup
incidents.summary: Fans complained that in an AFC Cup match two teams wore the same colour jerseys, which even school football does not allow.

incidents.title: Clubs' lack of professionalism lets the federation commit irregularities
incidents.summary: A post argued the clubs' lack of professionalism, such as no fixed jerseys, is why the federation gets to commit so many irregularities.

incidents.title: Player speaks of the pain that made him leave the country and football
incidents.summary: A shared video showed a player finally speaking of the pain that made him leave the country and football.

incidents.title: Sylhet stadium's 11-crore expansion a waste; money suspected pocketed
incidents.summary: Fans called the 11-crore Sylhet stadium expansion a waste of money and suspected most of it was pocketed, contrasting it with Bengaluru FC's training facility.

incidents.title: Brothers vs Sheikh Jamal: was it fixed? Relegation fixes feared
incidents.summary: Fans asked whether the Brothers vs Sheikh Jamal match was fixed and warned fixed matches to avoid relegation were highly likely towards the end of the league.

incidents.title: Seven or eight players housed in a room with one toilet
incidents.summary: A post complained that housing seven or eight players in a room with one toilet is unhygienic and youth projects need more care.

incidents.title: Yasin Khan excluded for 15 matches after staying loyal to Sheikh Jamal
incidents.summary: Fans protested Yasin Khan's exclusion from the national squad for 15 matches after he stayed loyal to Sheikh Jamal during the BFF-Monzur Kader rivalry.

incidents.title: Transfers delayed by three or four months at Tarafdar's ask
incidents.summary: Tarafdar reportedly asked to delay transfers by three or four months, and fans mocked 'Football Friend', a BFF president candidate, for postponing transfers instead of negotiating.

incidents.title: Women's football in crisis: ranking at a record-low 130th
incidents.summary: Fans argued women's football was in crisis, with the ranking at a record-low 130th and heavy defeats returning, and noted there is no football for girls in the country after age 19.

incidents.title: Calls for Rupu's removal after Mohammedan thrash Abahani 4-0
incidents.summary: After Mohammedan beat Abahani 4-0 in the derby, fans called for Abahani manager Satyajit Das Rupu's removal.

incidents.title: Abahani lost its best players each season, mainly to money
incidents.summary: A post argued Abahani lost its best players each season, including Lee Tuck and Masih Saighani, mainly to money.

incidents.title: Abahani take players to matches in a broken-down bus
incidents.summary: Fans attacked Abahani for taking players to matches in a broken-down bus while foreign players could earn twice the money in India.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan: referees give Abahani 'special facilities'; BFF show-causes him
incidents.summary: Captain Jamal Bhuyan said referees give special facilities to one team, Abahani, and fans attacked BFF for show-causing him over the criticism while its own referee wrongly named Bablu instead of Rahmat.

incidents.title: Waterlogged, muddy ground and low-quality ball
incidents.summary: Fans congratulated Kings but attacked the waterlogged, muddy ground and low-quality ball, blaming the Salahuddin-Sohag gang.

incidents.title: BFF avoids the Iran friendly and wastes the chance
incidents.summary: Fans attacked BFF for avoiding a preparation match against Iran and playing Timor Leste instead, mocking the federation for fearing a great defeat, and later noted the girls' team camp in Europe was not happening either.

incidents.title: Mohammedan's 50-storey building dream while the club declines
incidents.summary: Fans mocked Mohammedan's dream of a 50-storey building with a 1000-crore budget while the club should build a stadium, practice ground and academy instead, and blamed Babu and Rupu for taking away the club's past, present and future.

incidents.title: Relegation drama: one team to go down, partial matches alleged
incidents.summary: Fans said the drama of relegating one team had started again, questioned why the final-day decider was not played simultaneously, and quoted NoFeL coach Kamal Babu blaming nakedly partial matches and a syndicate for demotion, while ten clubs demanded one relegation instead of two.

incidents.title: Rickshaw pullers forcibly taken to watch Kings matches
incidents.summary: Fans claimed rickshaw pullers in the Bashundhara residential area were being forcibly taken to watch Kings matches, and said there was no need for the forced crowd. Suggested new category: forced_attendance.

incidents.title: Crores spent on school football, yet champions' captains left helpless
incidents.summary: A post shared Jisan's message after Shihab joined Kings' camp, questioning what the crores spent on school football achieve if champions' captains are left helpless.

incidents.title: Mohammedan left out of Sheikh Kamal Cup while Kolkata Mohammedan invited
incidents.summary: Dhaka Mohammedan, the country's most popular club, was left out of the Sheikh Kamal Club Cup while third-tier Kolkata Mohammedan was invited, and the club called it sad; a fake claim about East Bengal's 2015 participation was also called out.

incidents.title: Sylhet United wore the Bangladesh national team jersey with the BFF logo
incidents.summary: Fans criticised Sylhet United for wearing the Bangladesh national team jersey with the BFF logo to play the Independence Cup in India. Suggested new category: unauthorised_kit_use.

incidents.title: National squad analysed: Sohel in, Emon and Toklis out
incidents.summary: Fans questioned the national team selection, asking why Emon Mahmud and Toklis Ahmed were out while Jamal Bhuyan was in, and said Toklis should move to Abahani to guarantee a national team place.

incidents.title: Sohel keeps getting picked despite repeated errors
incidents.summary: Fans kept questioning Shahidul Sohel's inclusion over Himel and Pappu, mocked his indecision against April 25, and noted both Raihan and Sohel were rewarded with national team places despite their AFC Cup errors.

incidents.title: Age cheating in Bangladesh's age-group football
incidents.summary: Fans argued the U-15 squad looked the same age and implied age cheating, cited the 2016 youth SAFF champions who could not play an AFC tournament for excess age, and blamed age cheating for the U-16 qualifiers' failure.

incidents.title: Trials a drama run on nepotism: players wait from 5am, get no minute
incidents.summary: Players reported waiting from 5am at Rahmatganj and Mohammedan trials without getting even a minute to play, and under-18 players returned from trials without playing, blamed on the system and nepotism in selection.

incidents.title: Abahani coach Mario Lemos called the North Korea tour 'a jail'
incidents.summary: Abahani's Portuguese coach Mario Lemos described the North Korea tour as a jail.

incidents.title: BFF delaying buying football technology due to lack of money
incidents.summary: The national team wanted football technology before the World Cup qualifiers, but BFF was delaying buying it due to lack of money.

incidents.title: Jamie Day 'lacks courage to break Rupu's syndicate'
incidents.summary: A fan who met Jamie Day said he lacks the courage to break Rupu's syndicate and takes too much holiday; later posts called him spineless and timid over Abahani-quota selections and criticised his press conferences and exclusion of Emon Mahmud.

incidents.title: National-team fitness divide: some players 'drink alcohol and ganja'
incidents.summary: A post argued a clear division exists in the national team over fitness: some players have world-class six- or eight-packs while others drink alcohol and ganja yet stay in the team.

incidents.title: Why can't Bangladesh add international-born players yet?
incidents.summary: Fans argued importing foreign naturalised players is shameful and only Bangladeshi blood should play, while others asked why Bangladesh cannot add international-born players like Shamit Shome and Tariq Kazi, and suggested giving citizenship to foreigners.

incidents.title: BFF opens academy with 14-year-olds; no gymnasium in 48 years
incidents.summary: Fans mocked BFF for opening an academy with 14-year-olds while talking of playing the World Cup in 2022, and noted even in 48 years of independence BFF could not build a gymnasium despite election promises.

incidents.title: Jibon: fans want to love him but he cannot take their love
incidents.summary: Fans addressed Jibon directly after he missed an open goal, criticised his attitude and finishing, and said Motin should be an automatic choice instead.

incidents.title: BKSP player given a direct national team squad chance
incidents.summary: Fans criticised giving a BKSP player a direct national team squad chance, sharing coach Dido's 2009 AFC Challenge Cup squad for contrast.

incidents.title: U-16 women's team sent to the championship with almost no preparation
incidents.summary: The U-16 women's team lost 1-0 to Thailand and 0-9 to Japan, and fans criticised BFF for promising Chelsea and Manchester training but sending the girls in with almost no preparation, while bought media praised a side with 29 percent possession.

incidents.title: 17 crore taka misappropriated across 2016, 2017 and 2018
incidents.summary: A written complaint alleged 17 crore taka was misappropriated across 2016, 2017 and 2018, fans noted the ACC's letter and Ekattor TV's report went lukewarm, and journalists said the BFF general secretary hid inside and refused to talk about it.

incidents.title: Casino crackdown reaches football: Lokman's Mohammedan casino
incidents.summary: The casino raid exposed Jubo League leader Mominul Haque Saeed and Mohammedan director Lokman Hossain Bhuiyan, who rented the club's place to run a casino; fans demanded Lokman and Babu be thrown out and banned for life, and a raid on BFF's casino too.

incidents.title: Kings may release their junior team, wasting young players
