incidents.summary: A report said Kings may release their junior team due to senior-team commitments, which would waste their young players like past ones.

incidents.title: District association elections: DSA vote fails 18 times in three months
incidents.summary: The DSA election had not happened in 18 attempts over three months, with money blamed, and Sylhet DSA's Kaua Selim was criticised for staying in power for five years and four months after coming for three.

incidents.title: Messi and Argentina coming to play Paraguay: BFF's eyewash
incidents.summary: Fans questioned what Bangladesh football gains from Messi and Argentina coming to play Paraguay and Venezuela, calling it BFF's eyewash.

incidents.title: Only one toilet for spectators in an international football ground
incidents.summary: A fan shared a photo of the only toilet for spectators in an international football ground's gallery, refusing to name the ground for fear of losing his job.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan twice sent back as a failure by a syndicate
incidents.summary: A post said Jamal Bhuyan was twice sent back as a failure by a syndicate still in the team, and argued removing that syndicate, controlled by a club manager, would let the national team sprint.

incidents.title: Ghost bills with the FIFA president coming
incidents.summary: A post sarcastically said with the FIFA president coming, BFF must get into a new scheme and make ghost bills.

incidents.title: Sheikh Kamal Cup broadcast and commentary 'torture' viewers
incidents.summary: Fans criticised the low-quality Sheikh Kamal Cup broadcasting and amateur commentators flattering the bosses, saying they could not see many important attacks.

incidents.title: How much more damage can Salahuddin do? Coaches sacked, nothing built
incidents.summary: A long post doubted how much more damage Salahuddin could do, noting he sacked coaches like Dido and Cruyff and built no stadium, academy or age-group teams since 2008.

incidents.title: Technical director Paul Smalley: contract ends, election trump card
incidents.summary: BFF did not renew technical director Paul Smalley's contract, with Salahuddin saying he would bring Smalley back if he won the next election, and fans claimed the Sallu-Sohag gang would use Smalley as a trump card.

incidents.title: Hemanta Vincent's decline since the Cruyff era
incidents.summary: Fans lamented Hemanta Vincent's decline since Lodewijk de Cruyff's era, despite being the first Bangladeshi to trial at FC Twente and the most complete versatile player.

incidents.title: Kings buy a bagful of national team players and play them out of position
incidents.summary: Fans criticised Kings for buying a bagful of national team players without thinking about positions, playing them out of position and destroying their natural game.

incidents.title: Sheikh Kamal Cup: referee allegedly racially abuses Chennai City player
incidents.summary: A Sri Lankan referee allegedly made a racist comment to Japanese player Katasumi in the Sheikh Kamal Cup game against Bashundhara Kings, and Chennai complained to the match commissioner.

incidents.title: Tarafdar's 10-crore Sheikh Kamal Cup budget questioned
incidents.summary: Fans questioned Tarafdar Ruhul Amin's claim of a 10 crore taka Sheikh Kamal Cup budget, calling him a liar like Salahuddin, and noted he was spending pocketfuls of money on football development.

incidents.title: BFF behaves as if there are no spectators outside Dhaka
incidents.summary: A post quoted BFF's behaviour as suggesting there are no spectators outside Dhaka.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Gold Cup should have invited Qatar, Iran, UAE or India

entities.name: United Arab Emirates national football team

incidents.summary: Fans argued BFF should have invited Qatar, Iran, UAE or India to an eight-team Bangabandhu Gold Cup instead of equal or weaker teams like Sri Lanka.

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings vs BFF: official 'going room to room' in national camp
incidents.summary: Kings president Imrul Hassan said an official was going room to room in the national team camp telling players to play for a specific club, and fans defended Kings' refusal to release players early, arguing no club manager in the world is also national team manager.

incidents.title: Saif appoint a coach whose Maldives U-16 conceded six to Bangladesh
incidents.summary: Saif appointed Mohamed Nizam, coach of the Maldives U-16 team that conceded six goals to Bangladesh U-16, as head coach, and fans questioned whether his AFC A Licence certificate was made overnight.

incidents.title: BFF still cannot bring in football technology due to financial shortage
incidents.summary: BFF still could not bring in a technology due to financial shortage, while Oman and most teams take the game further with it.

incidents.title: Fans chase expatriates while BFF has no news of them
incidents.summary: Fans lamented chasing expatriate footballers like Zidan Mia while BFF officials, busy matching bills and vouchers, had no news of them, and criticised Salahuddin's alleged rule that expatriates must play in the domestic league; Riasat Islam Khatun left without playing due to the coach and BFF's apathy.

incidents.title: Arambagh Club's lock must be opened after the casino crackdown
incidents.summary: Fans demanded Arambagh Club's lock be opened, arguing players and coaches are not involved in the casino business and the club must play in the BPL.

incidents.title: World Cup qualifiers and SA Games: in-form players benched, Jibon stays
incidents.summary: Fans argued credit goes to Jamie Day and Jamal when Bangladesh play well and blame to Rupu and Abahani's players when they lose, asked why Arif, Motin and Sufil are called up only to sit on the bench, and complained Jibon was one of the three senior quota players for the SA Games instead of Rakib and Sufil.

incidents.title: BPL cannot become an Asian threat while buying Nigerian players
incidents.summary: A post argued that as long as the BPL does not stop buying Nigerian players, it cannot become an Asian threat.

incidents.title: Saif miss the 2020 AFC Cup play-off because the Federation Cup was late
incidents.summary: Despite an AFC Cup licence, Saif would not play the 2020 AFC Cup play-off because the Federation Cup was not held on time, so league runners-up Abahani play it instead.

incidents.title: Nepal's Bermuda grass vs Bangladesh's paddy-field stadium
incidents.summary: Fans contrasted Nepal's beautiful modern grounds with Bermuda grass against Bangladesh's one dilapidated stadium that looks like a paddy field, and noted the Manchester United delegation raised questions about five types of grass on the Bangabandhu Stadium field.

incidents.title: Women's team not sent to the SA Games
incidents.summary: Fans criticised the Prime Minister rewarding the youth team for one tournament win while ignoring two big failures, and argued the hole of not sending a women's football team to the SA Games was dug the day Salahuddin did not agree to play the Bangamata final against Laos out of fear of losing.

incidents.title: SA Games failure: Jamie Day's long-ball tactics and love for Jibon mocked
incidents.summary: Bangladesh lost to Bhutan and Nepal at the South Asian Games, and fans mocked Jamie Day's long-ball tactics, his refusal to rotate the always-failing Jibon, and Rupu's grip on the XI, while condemning a TV report that blamed the players' dedication instead of the management.

incidents.title: Sports budget of 1,498 crore looted while football ranks fifth of seven in South Asia
incidents.summary: A post argued thieves were looting the country, citing the 2018-19 National Sports Ministry budget of 1,498 crore taka while Bangladesh ranks fifth among seven South Asian countries.

incidents.title: No investigation, remorse or resignation after losses to Nepal and Bhutan
incidents.summary: Fans asked how much more deception of the nation with the country's football, noting the national team lost to Nepal and Bhutan's age-based teams with no investigation, remorse, sorrow, voluntary resignation or expulsion.

incidents.title: BFF Academy's activities closed after the AFC U-16 and U-19 tournaments
incidents.summary: A Prothom Alo report said BFF Academy's activities closed after the AFC U-16 and U-19 tournaments, with only a seven-day activity for the U-16 players afterwards.

incidents.title: Kiron wants to organise two seasons' leagues at the same time in 2020
incidents.summary: Mahfuza Akter Kiron wanted to organise two seasons' leagues at the same time in 2020, where she had failed to organise one league in six years.

incidents.title: BFF bringing Drogba and Puyol as Gold Cup ambassadors: a new scam?
incidents.summary: Fans noted BFF was trying to bring legends like Didier Drogba and Carles Puyol as ambassadors for the next Bangabandhu Gold Cup, and asked whether BFF suddenly won a lottery, arguing spending on Messi, Argentina and Manchester United is a new scam while irregularities continue.

incidents.title: Federation Cup's first match broadcast of low quality
incidents.summary: Fans criticised the low quality of the Federation Cup's first match broadcast and commentary.

incidents.title: Three national team footballers banned by the High Court in a club tug-of-war
incidents.summary: Three players were under a ban in a tug-of-war between two clubs, and the High Court Division imposed a ban on Raihan Hasan and the two Sohel Ranas over allegations of taking money for one club and registering for another.

incidents.title: Third-class standard grounds make football's improvement impossible
incidents.summary: A post argued that with such third-class standard grounds, football's improvement is not possible, and said shame BFF.

incidents.title: Kiron earns about $3.5 lakh a year from FIFA and AFC roles
incidents.summary: Mahfuza Akter Kiron earns about three and a half lakh dollars a year from her FIFA Council membership and AFC Women's Wing role, over two and a half crore taka, while there has been no women's league in the country for six years.

incidents.title: Salahuddin calls 2019 a successful year for BFF
incidents.summary: Fans sarcastically quoted Salahuddin calling 2019 a successful year for BFF, citing the year ending at 187th in the rankings, the women's team not sent to the SA Games, and Laos and Bangladesh declared joint champions on the excuse of rain.

incidents.title: FIFA fines BFF after spectators invade pitch in World Cup qualifier
incidents.summary: FIFA fines the BFF about 13 lakh taka after spectators climbed the wall and entered the field during a World Cup qualifier.

incidents.title: Saif Sporting Club sack coach Mohammad Nizam after two months
incidents.summary: Saif appoint Maldives coach Mohammad Nizam in November and sack him just two months later.

incidents.title: Bruzon calls league pitch a cow-grazing field
incidents.summary: Kings coach Oscar Bruzon calls a league pitch a cow-grazing field.

incidents.title: Women's football neglected: big clubs shun the league, Sabina gets poor support
incidents.summary: Big clubs shun the women's league while captain Sabina Khatun gets poor support and diet.

incidents.title: Rupu's grip on national-team selection during the Bangabandhu Gold Cup
incidents.summary: Fans accuse team manager Satyajit Das Rupu of keeping favourites Mamunul Islam and Raihan Hasan in the XI while shutting out in-form players, as Bangladesh exit the Bangabandhu Gold Cup.

incidents.title: Poor broadcast and commentary quality for Gold Cup and league matches
incidents.summary: Gold Cup and league broadcasts suffer poor picture quality and commentary that gets players' names wrong.

incidents.title: Non-resident player Jeremy Faruke overlooked for the national team
incidents.summary: German fifth-tier regular Jeremy Faruke, a non-resident player, is overlooked for the national team.

incidents.title: Ameli: football cannot be played comfortably on turf
incidents.summary: Jahid Hasan Ameli says football cannot be played comfortably on turf and belongs on grass.

incidents.title: Talented young player unnoticed for lack of facilities
incidents.summary: A talented young player remains unnoticed for lack of facilities.

incidents.title: Poor grounds across the country: small outfields, no grass, unfit venues
incidents.summary: Grounds across the country are unfit: tiny outfields, no grass, and venues FIFA may not approve.

incidents.title: Abahani have no academy or home venue of their own
incidents.summary: Abahani have no academy of their own and no home venue despite the club founder's sister being prime minister for a dozen years.

incidents.title: Abahani keep playing flop Sunday Chizoba while benching Faisal Shitlu
incidents.summary: Fans demand Abahani drop Sunday Chizoba, goalless in many matches, and give a chance to Faisal Shitlu, who won them an important match last year.

incidents.title: BFF presidential race: Ruhul Amin withdraws, 'Salahuddin Out' calls grow, Badal Roy alleges mafia-style election
incidents.summary: Ruhul Amin withdraws from the presidential race, fans demand Salahuddin out, and Badal Roy alleges the election is run mafia-style.

incidents.title: Calls to sack Saiful Bari Titu
incidents.summary: Fans call for coach Saiful Bari Titu's removal after a run of draws and a slide towards the relegation zone.

incidents.title: Dreams of 23 women footballers who left home for Dhaka under threat
incidents.summary: The dreams of 23 women footballers who left their families for Dhaka are reported to be under threat.

incidents.title: Tariq Kazi, the most high-profile Bangladeshi-origin player, left out of the national team
incidents.summary: Fans ask why Tariq Kazi, with Europa League qualifiers and Finnish top-tier experience, is not in the national team.

incidents.title: Foreigners dominate scoring as local players are crowded out
incidents.summary: Local players are crowded out as foreigners score all the goals; fans say foreigners dominate as always.

incidents.title: Sheikh Kamal Club Cup champions still unpaid months later
incidents.summary: Terengganu FC, champions of last October's Sheikh Kamal International Club Cup, still have not received their prize money, and fans accuse BFF of insulting the tournament's namesake.

incidents.title: Oscar Bruzon plays players out of position at Bashundhara Kings
incidents.summary: Kings coach Oscar Bruzon is accused of playing forwards in defence and defenders in midfield, with the whole team passing only to Daniel Colindres.

incidents.title: Biased refereeing in the league
incidents.summary: Fans accuse referees of deciding matches, including making Abahani win and blowing the whistle in Bashundhara Kings' favour.

incidents.title: Salahuddin dismisses FIFA ranking of 187
incidents.summary: Salahuddin dismisses Bangladesh's FIFA ranking of 187, comparing it with France and Belgium.

incidents.title: Cumilla venue pitch injury-prone ahead of league and AFC Cup matches
incidents.summary: Photos show the Cumilla venue in poor, injury-prone condition the day before Mohammedan face Bashundhara Kings there and Kings play an AFC Cup match.

incidents.title: Emon Mahmud's injury drags on as Kings' account is doubted
incidents.summary: Kings say Emon Mahmud's light injury has not healed after 23 days, though the poster's information suggests otherwise.

incidents.title: Newspapers and broadcasters neglect domestic football coverage
incidents.summary: Newspapers ignore the league and broadcasters bungle coverage of domestic matches.

incidents.title: BFF give top-scorer award to a player seven goals behind the top scorer
incidents.summary: Suggested new category: award irregularity. BFF give the best award to a player who scored seven fewer goals than the top scorer on 20 goals in a pipeline tournament.

incidents.title: Row over hosting the remaining league matches only in Dhaka
incidents.summary: The Professional League Committee wants the remaining league matches in Dhaka; Kings president Imrul Hasan opposes dropping venues outside Dhaka.

incidents.title: Fans demand an audit of BFF officials' assets
incidents.summary: Fans call the BFF leadership the great destroyers of Bangla football and say an audit of all their assets would clear up a lot.

incidents.title: Reasat Islam Khaton: pure class on trial, helpless against the syndicate
incidents.summary: Reasat Islam Khaton, pure class on trial, was helpless against the syndicate and is now ruined by injury.

incidents.title: Youth development failure: clubs drop youth teams, talent never develops
incidents.summary: Clubs have dropped youth teams and promising youngsters like Hemanta Vincent never develop.

incidents.title: Players neglected in the COVID shutdown: starving, unfed, unrecognised
incidents.summary: During the COVID shutdown players and coaches face starvation, cannot afford boots or food, and national players have no official ID.

incidents.title: Sabina Khatun frightened as accused in attack on her home get bail
incidents.summary: Sabina Khatun and her family are newly frightened after the two accused in the attack on her home are released on bail.

incidents.title: Former Rahmatganj player Md Sujon pleads to live with kidney failure
incidents.summary: Former Rahmatganj player Md Sujon, pleading to live with severe kidney complications, wants to see the world's light a few more days.

incidents.title: The syndicate in national-team selection: Jamal's 2011 trial recall and Emily's admissions
incidents.summary: Jamal Bhuyan recalls the syndicate inside the national team at his 2011 trial, and Emily says he picked Mamunul and Jahid when given team-building power.

incidents.title: Over-age players hidden in the Pioneer League
incidents.summary: Nepotism spreads to hiding players' ages in the Pioneer League, where over-15 players escape officials' notice.

incidents.title: Lower divisions barely held: third division last played in 2018
incidents.summary: The third division last played in 2018 after three missing years since 2015, and the second division ran only in 2015, 2017 and 2019.

incidents.title: Turf pitches injuring young players
incidents.summary: Players and fans blame turf pitches for injuries, with BFF citing FIFA research while a defender says the heavy ground hurt his leg muscles and Saif's youth train at Kamalapur's injury mine.

incidents.title: 1980s star Manu could not afford paracetamol and died in 2018
incidents.summary: 1980s star Manu said even with all his love he could not buy a strip of paracetamol, and died in 2018.

incidents.title: Injured Jony: FIFA paid for recovery, BFF never checks on him
incidents.summary: FIFA gave injured Masuk Mia Jony 4 lakh taka for recovery and Bashundhara paid him in full, but he is disappointed BFF does not check on him regularly.

incidents.title: BPL cancelled with no champion, no promotion or relegation, and AFC slots at risk
incidents.summary: Clubs tell BFF they do not want to play the league, which is cancelled with no champion named, no promotion or relegation, players unconsulted, and Bangladesh at risk of losing an AFC slot.

incidents.title: BFF executive committee serves extra time after its term expires
incidents.summary: BFF's executive committee term ends on 30 April, yet the committee led by Kazi Salahuddin keeps serving extra time with FIFA's approval.

incidents.title: FIFA ban Saif Sporting Club from transfers over $130,000 unpaid to foreign players
incidents.summary: FIFA instruct BFF to ban Saif Sporting Club from all transfers for not paying $130,000 to three foreign players.

incidents.title: FIFA and government academy money taken, no academy built in 12 years
incidents.summary: Fans note BFF spent over 100 crore in four years while Salahuddin is accused of taking FIFA and government money for an academy and lying about it for a dozen years, as poorer Nepal builds three academies.

incidents.title: Salahuddin's claim of regular domestic football is challenged with league numbers
incidents.summary: Salahuddin's claim that domestic football became regular in his time is challenged: 12 leagues in 15 years from 1993-2007 versus his tenure from April 2008.

incidents.title: Players cannot afford their mothers' kidney dialysis
incidents.summary: Players struggle to pay for their mothers' kidney dialysis, at 42,000 taka a month, with savings spent.

incidents.title: Foreign-player debate: cut foreigners or build reserves and age-group football
incidents.summary: Fans argue over reducing foreigners versus running a reserve tournament and properly run age-group tournaments.

incidents.title: Warning that foreign footballers may not be registered next season
incidents.summary: There may be no chance to register foreign footballers next season.

incidents.title: Dues owed across football during the shutdown as players face starvation
incidents.summary: Players, referees, gatekeepers and league-winning teams are owed dues during the shutdown, and footballers face starvation.

incidents.title: Age fraud in SAFF age-group football is not new
incidents.summary: Age fraud in age-group football is described as long-running in Bangladesh, driven by hopes of shortcut success, citing recent SAFF age-group tournaments.

incidents.title: Kings' 200-bigha home venue seen as bottling football within Dhaka
incidents.summary: Selecting a modern sports complex on 200 bighas as Bashundhara Kings' home venue is seen as another step to bottle football within Dhaka.

incidents.title: Hamza Choudhury's patriotism and citizenship questioned
incidents.summary: Fans question whether Hamza Choudhury has any patriotism, asking if his country is Bangladesh and whether he is even a citizen.

incidents.title: BFF social media team criticised over fake FIFA 21 vote
incidents.summary: BFF's social media team is criticised over a fake vote to add a team or league in EA Sports FIFA 21. Suggested new category: federation social-media manipulation.

incidents.title: Sabbir never played in the No. 10 shirt after a fallout with Salahuddin
incidents.summary: 'Banglar Maradona' Rumman Bin Wali Sabbir never played an international match in the number 10 jersey due to a fallout with BFF president Kazi Salahuddin.

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings release foreign players and withhold local salaries for three months
incidents.summary: After the BPL is cancelled, Bashundhara Kings bid farewell to Daniel Colindres and other foreign players and have not paid local players a single taka of salary in nearly three months.

incidents.title: Ekattor TV reports on BFF corruption; BFF protest and Shohag at the centre
incidents.summary: Ekattor TV's Khelajog reports on BFF corruption and general secretary Abu Nayeem Shohag, BFF protest the reports, and fans note nearly a hundred earlier letters to FIFA led to no action.

incidents.title: Salahuddin asks the government for 40 crore and gets nothing
incidents.summary: Salahuddin is mocked for wanting 40 crore from the budget and being handed nothing, which gives his election opponents oxygen.

incidents.title: Nigerian footballer Mande beaten for asking for money
incidents.summary: Nigerian footballer Mande was beaten for asking for money, showing the injury on his lip.

incidents.title: Footballer Sohel decided to commit suicide several times despite fame
incidents.summary: Footballer Sohel decided to commit suicide several times despite fame, and teases how he came back stronger to the field.

incidents.title: Jamal and Sabina made grassroots ambassadors with no work to show
incidents.summary: BFF makes Jamal Bhuyan and Sabina Khatun grassroots football brand ambassadors with no news of any work; fans say a grassroots ambassador should come from the grassroots.

incidents.title: Ruhul Amin's Chittagong Abahani skip AFC club licensing
incidents.summary: Tarafder Ruhul Amin's club Chittagong Abahani did not take part in the upcoming AFC club licensing, despite his role as BFF vice-president and election councillor.

incidents.title: BFF fake IDs and a bot army attack critics online
incidents.summary: Fans allege BFF staff run fake IDs, a 'Dog Squad' and a bot army that counter-attack anyone who criticises the federation on Facebook.

incidents.title: Academy could be built by selling 13 cows; hundreds of crores in grants could not
incidents.summary: Honest intent could build an academy by selling 13 cows, while corruption means hundreds of crores in FIFA, AFC and government grants cannot build one.

incidents.title: Daily Star passes off a club as the Myanmar national team
incidents.summary: The Daily Star passes off Hantharwady United, 7th in the 2015 league, as Myanmar in the match Bangladesh lost 2-3. Suggested new category: media misreporting.

incidents.title: Row over a league without foreign players
incidents.summary: Tarafder Ruhul Amin proposes a league without foreigners for four years, seven of ten clubs later agree not to play foreigners, and fans protest that no other league is doing this.

incidents.title: National-team selection rows: the syndicate, interference and the 36-man squad
incidents.summary: Fans ask how Joseph Rahman sat out from 2016 to 2017, why Hamza Choudhury and Emon Mahmud are not called up, and why Rahmatganj players are overlooked while others interfere in selecting the XI.

incidents.title: DBC News BFF coverage challenged: vanishing link, error, fabricated reports
incidents.summary: DBC News coverage of BFF and the election is challenged: a Murshedy link vanishes, a series report carries a mistake, and reports are called fabricated to belittle Ruhul Amin.

incidents.title: Weak U-19 preparation matches questioned as election carrot
incidents.summary: A preparation match against Bhutan U-19 or Sri Lanka U-19 is questioned as World Cup qualifier preparation and a BFF election carrot.

incidents.title: Players unpaid: no match fees, Chittagong Abahani owes Mamunul
incidents.summary: League players often do not even get match fees, and Chittagong Abahani still has not paid Mamunul and others.

incidents.title: Foreign coaches come to do a job, not to develop football
incidents.summary: Apart from Kottan, Dorde and Dido, foreign coaches come to do a job, not to develop the country's football.

incidents.title: COVID-19 outbreak in the national-team camp
incidents.summary: Suggested new category: covid camp outbreak. Seven more players and a coach test COVID positive in the national-team camp, bringing the total to 18 players and one coach, with the Police FC coach questioning the test results.

incidents.title: Demand to ban importing African footballers
incidents.summary: Fans demand banning the import of African footballers, saying they get involved in misdeeds that ruin clubs' image.

incidents.title: Salahuddin promises the 2026 World Cup and faces renewed removal calls
incidents.summary: Salahuddin says Bangladesh cannot play the 2022 World Cup but will definitely play in 2026 if he becomes president again, as fans renew calls to remove him.

incidents.title: Premier League footballer plays the season's first 'khyap'
incidents.summary: A current Premier League footballer who once played for the Bangladesh youth team posts about playing the season's first 'khyap'.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu National Stadium in poor condition, vegetables grown on it
incidents.summary: Fans point out Uganda has better-quality stadiums while Bangladesh has only one stadium in poor condition, and later note vegetables are being grown at Bangabandhu Stadium instead of football.

incidents.title: BFF election: vote-buying, broken 2016 manifesto and intimidation of rivals
incidents.summary: Ahead of the BFF election, fans allege vote-buying with five-star hotel events and cash-or-flat offers, note 20 of 25 promises in the 2016 manifesto went unfulfilled, and report a GD against general secretary Abu Nayeem Shohag for threatening Badal Roy.

incidents.title: Salahuddin Out movement: human chains at the Press Club and across districts
incidents.summary: Fans hold a human chain at the National Press Club on 14 September and in districts across the country, demanding Salahuddin's removal after 12 years, after he calls the protesters street boys.

incidents.title: Post vanishes from BFF's verified page
incidents.summary: A post vanishes from BFF's verified page, with the admin said to have removed it to stop the flood of people's reactions. Suggested new category: online censorship by federation.

incidents.title: Fake and bot IDs flatter BFF on its own page
incidents.summary: Domesticated animals flatter on BFF's page using fake IDs, and BFF is said to use paid bot IDs to get praise in its comment box.

incidents.title: Coach Oscar Bruzon campaigns in Bangla for a BFF election candidate
incidents.summary: Spanish coach Oscar Bruzon, who cannot even speak English well, writes in Bangla on his own timeline asking for votes for a candidate in the BFF election.

incidents.title: BFF spent 120-124 crore on football development with nothing to show
incidents.summary: Per Ekattor TV, BFF spent 120 crore taka on football development from 2016-2020, and fans ask how 124 crore was spent while Salahuddin begs the media for swimming-pool money.

incidents.title: Officials hang around the women's team
incidents.summary: Hogla Babu, declared unwanted by Mohammedan, hangs around the women's team, and Babu, manager in the syndicate era, again likes to stay close to the women's team.

incidents.title: BFF send a legal notice to a protester; later a legal notice against 12 supporters
incidents.summary: BFF send a legal notice against a protester instead of the officials whose deeds damage the country's image, and in November a supporter serves a legal notice against 12 football supporters with Bashundhara Kings as main patron.

incidents.title: BFF election 2020: Salahuddin re-elected to a fourth term amid vote-buying claims
incidents.summary: Salahuddin wins a fourth term with nearly 67 percent of delegates' votes though he gets under 5 percent in public votes, as fans allege councillors were bought with five-star hotel stays and a crore-taka Sonargaon bill and an intelligence report alleges corruption in the Prime Minister's name.

incidents.title: Academies start at 18 while Camavinga scores for France at 17
incidents.summary: Camavinga scored for his national team at 17, while Bangladesh starts academy activities from age 18.

incidents.title: BPL venues exclude the regions as Dhaka clubs dominate
incidents.summary: BPL venues exclude Mymensingh's Rafiq Uddin Bhuiyan Stadium and fans ask if BFF will run the league with only Dhaka clubs forever.

incidents.title: Federation Cup champions' prize money stuck at 5 lakh year after year
incidents.summary: Suggested new category: prize money stagnation. Fans ask whether the Federation Cup champions' prize will again be a beggarly 5 lakh, and mock BFF for keeping it at 5 lakh year after year.

incidents.title: Ataur Rahman Manik's youth projects: the over-8 project and a rented house for 100 age-group players
incidents.summary: Fans mock Ataur Rahman Manik's over-8 football project and his claim of renting a whole house to keep 100 age-group footballers under watch.

incidents.title: Saif Sporting's chronic coach churn
incidents.summary: Saif Sporting change coaches the way the national team does, with an 8th coach confirmed in the club's 4th year; the Oct 27 post does not name the club and Saif is inferred from its founding year and the Nov 9 post.

incidents.title: Injured and unfit players kept in the national squad
incidents.summary: Officials invite injured or bench-warming players to the national-team camp, keep two footballers in the main team though they will not get fit soon against Nepal, and take Mamunul Islam with a cracked hand to Qatar.

incidents.title: COVID-19 in the Nepal camp as quarantine is relaxed for the friendlies
incidents.summary: Suggested new category: covid friendly series. Four Nepal players are infected before the Bangladesh match while quarantine is relaxed for the tour, and eight Nepal players are infected in total.

incidents.title: Bablu Bhattacharya has no coaching licence
incidents.summary: A report that Mohun Bagan legend Bablu Bhattacharya is going somewhere is corrected: he has no licence and failed a B-licence in Bangladesh.

incidents.title: Club grounds and buildings neglected
incidents.summary: Mohammedan's ground is uncut and uneven, Abahani practise on a surface like a Dhanmondi road, Brothers Union's building looks abandoned, and fans say BFF is indifferent about good grounds.

incidents.title: Favouritism in selection: places guaranteed for favourites
incidents.summary: Places are guaranteed for favourites: the No. 10 goes to whoever is in the XI, two legends' places are confirmed for two years, and Toklis Ahmed never gets a chance for not being the powerful leader's favourite.

incidents.title: BFF notice bars comment on its name and logo
incidents.summary: Nothing can be said about BFF's name and logo, as mentioned in a notice.

incidents.title: Ticket black-marketing during the Bangladesh-Nepal series
incidents.summary: Ticket sellers outside Bangabandhu Stadium never run out even when the stadium exceeds capacity, with black marketeers said to work in collusion with federation secretary Barkat and the national captain's social media manager named as a black marketeer.

incidents.title: T Sports broadcast failures: Nepal friendly not streamed, Federation Cup unwatchable
incidents.summary: T Sports will not stream the Bangladesh-Nepal match online, Federation Cup matches are unwatchable for poor broadcast and technical faults, and fans keep complaining into January 2021.

incidents.title: Qatar preparation matches arranged against weak opponents
incidents.summary: Bangladesh are given the Qatar Army team and second-tier Lusail instead of the two Qatar Stars League teams requested, and lose 3-2 to the Army team.

incidents.title: Jamie Day on holiday in England as reports say he is about to be sacked
incidents.summary: Coach Jamie Day is reported to be about to be sacked while he holidays in England, with fans noting he mostly sits in England instead of watching domestic league matches.

incidents.title: Academies accredited without inspection; Academy Cup best player from the federation's own circle
incidents.summary: BFF register most academies without inspection under its accreditation scheme, and the best player of the Academy Cup is selected from the federation's own circle.

incidents.title: Women's league: Sabina Khatun gets 5,000 taka and a dummy cheque as top scorer
incidents.summary: Sabina Khatun gets 5,000 taka and a dummy cheque for scoring the most goals in the women's league, while Bashundhara Kings pay her 3 lakh and Tohura Khatun 2 lakh, and fans demand the league standard be raised.

incidents.title: Top vote-getter Imrul Hasan absent from BFF Victory Day friendly
incidents.summary: Almost all leaders attend BFF's Victory Day friendly, but vice-president Imrul Hasan, who won the most votes, is absent.

incidents.title: Brothers Union collapse: no coach, no transfers, players eat at an unhygienic hotel
incidents.summary: Brothers Union fail to complete transfers in time, have no coach, players warm up themselves for the Federation Cup and eat at a local unhygienic hotel, with darkness inside and outside the club.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu National Stadium still without proper watering
incidents.summary: Fans ask whether the National Sports Council can arrange proper watering at Bangabandhu National Stadium, where the old system is still seen.

incidents.title: Ball boys wear sandals as BFF cannot give them shoes
incidents.summary: Ball boys wear sandals carrying the fair play flag in the country's main league, and BFF cannot even give them a pair of shoes.

incidents.title: Club threatens police action against critics
incidents.summary: A traditional club is about to follow the federation's path, with police involvement if there is any criticism against the club.

incidents.title: Junior division leagues are not regular
incidents.summary: Bangladesh football means the Fed Cup, league and national team matches, while junior division leagues are not regular.

incidents.title: Shahjahan Ahmed Sujon fights for his life after his kidneys fail
incidents.summary: Former Rahmatganj player Shahjahan Ahmed Sujon, who fell ill after playing in 2016-17 and whose kidneys failed, is fighting for his life while teammates run around the field.

incidents.title: T-Sports broadcast and commentary quality attacked by fans
incidents.summary: Fans attack T-Sports' unqualified commentators, bad camera angles, missing replays and uneven coverage.

incidents.title: Lenient bans for abusing referees; Taklis sent off for pushing an opponent
incidents.summary: Fans condemn one-match bans for players who raised hands on referees as encouragement rather than deterrent, after Taklis was sent off for pushing an opponent and Mohammedan were fined when fans threatened a referee.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Stadium pitch ruined; BFF drops Narsingdi venue without inspection
incidents.summary: The Bangabandhu Stadium pitch is ruined with six Federation Cup matches still to play, and BFF drops Narsingdi's Mosleh Uddin Bhuiyan Stadium as a venue without proper inspection.

incidents.title: Mohammedan SC still without an own ground
incidents.summary: Mohammedan still have no own ground, practising on a seven-a-side-sized field until a new committee comes.

incidents.title: Oscar Bruzon accused of unprofessional conduct off the pitch
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings coach Oscar Bruzon is accused of messaging a critical fan on Facebook and attending fan events during Covid instead of focusing on coaching.

incidents.title: BFF schedules Third Division League in 50 days, leaving children idle for 315
incidents.summary: BFF is criticised for scheduling the Third Division League in 50 days, leaving children idle for the other 315 days of the year.

incidents.title: Yasin Arafat overlooked despite finishing better than a former top forward
incidents.summary: Fans claim left-back Yasin Arafat finishes better than a former top forward and ask if national coach Jamie Day is watching.

incidents.title: Federation Cup semi-final refereeing row: Kings beat Abahani amid disputed offside/foul calls
incidents.summary: Kings beat Abahani in the Federation Cup semi-final amid disputed offside and foul calls; fans demand an investigation into the linesman's decisions.

incidents.title: Unequal punishments: Saif fined for skipping press conference, Brothers escape sanction
incidents.summary: Saif are fined 25,000 taka for skipping the pre-final press conference while Brothers Union get no punishment for a late transfer.

incidents.title: BFF men seize archery ground and scold archery officials
incidents.summary: Fans allege BFF men acting like local goons seized the archery ground and scolded archery officials.

incidents.title: Kolkata Mohammedan players boycott practice over unpaid salaries
incidents.summary: Kolkata Mohammedan players boycott practice over salary issues, souring captain Jamal Bhuyan's I-League move.

incidents.title: Nepal's women's league has foreign players while Bangladesh's is a namesake league
incidents.summary: Nepal's women's league has foreign players while Bangladesh's women's league is a namesake league, and the federation is poorer than Nepal's.

incidents.title: BPL matches not televised as T-Sports shows only selected games
incidents.summary: Fans complain the Kings match in Cumilla is televised while the Mohammedan match at the same ground is not, and that important matches cannot be watched on TV at all.

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings bench national-team players, ruining their careers
incidents.summary: Fans accuse Bashundhara Kings of ruining national-team players' careers by benching them, naming Matin Mia, Robiul Hasan and Atiqur Rahman Fahad and calling for loans; Robiul eventually seeks a move to Mohammedan.

incidents.title: Muktijoddha substitute's boot spike cuts Monir's ear, needing 22 stitches
incidents.summary: Muktijoddha substitute Mehedi Hasan's boot spike cut Monir's ear, needing 22 stitches.

incidents.title: Refereeing accused of favouring Bashundhara Kings
incidents.summary: A run of BPL decisions - denied penalties, Topu Barman's dive, referee Jalal's handball call, Saif denied a penalty vs Kings - fuels claims referees favour Bashundhara Kings, with a BFF member seen in the referees' area applauding a Kings goal.

incidents.title: Afghanistan, Oman and India refuse to play home matches in Bangladesh
incidents.summary: Fans call it a farce that Afghanistan, Oman and India will not come to Bangladesh for home matches, while BFF scrambles for March window opponents.

incidents.title: Bashundhara Group builds three cricket stadiums but only a small football one
incidents.summary: Fans complain Bashundhara Group is building three cricket stadiums but only a small football one, though everyone prioritises cricket.

incidents.title: BFF's BPL organisation failures and mocked VAR promise
incidents.summary: Fans mock Salam Murshedy's promise of VAR from next season while the BPL has low-quality replica balls, no coverage of the Championship League and no proper broadcast or promotion.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu pitch among the worst ever; fans demand Bermuda grass at every BPL ground
incidents.summary: Fans call the Bangabandhu Stadium pitch the worst ever seen this season and demand Bermuda grass at every BPL ground, contrasting Nepal's European-style stadiums and Tripura's pitches.

incidents.title: Match-fixing and spot-fixing allegations against Arambagh and Brothers Union
incidents.summary: BFF sends letters to Arambagh and Brothers Union over match-fixing and spot-fixing allegations, including online-betting claims; fans demand punishment, while the match-fixing committee is found to have expired.

incidents.title: Salahuddin's 12 years in power attacked; no academy, no grounds
incidents.summary: Fans lament 12 years of Salahuddin's power with no academy while Nepal builds one, and mock his claim that as cricket-board president he would make Bangladesh a top-two team.

incidents.title: Player pay exploitation: tiny salaries, syndicate cuts, stars forced abroad
incidents.summary: A Championship League scorer gets no team on a season wage of 20,000 taka with syndicate cuts, a U-14 captain leaves to work abroad as a labourer, and Sabbir is offered 3 lakh after 20 lakh the previous season, while a whole Nepal champion squad costs less than Jamal and Matin's combined salaries.

incidents.title: Referees accused of denying Mohammedan a clear penalty
incidents.summary: Fans accuse referees of denying Mohammedan a clear penalty and officiating 'drunk', saying referees are now sold to clubs.

incidents.title: Rimon vs Yasin: selection row over makeshift left-back and 'syndicate' hype
incidents.summary: Fans erupt over Rimon Hossain being picked and started at left-back ahead of experienced Yasin Arafat, alleging a 'syndicate' and a 'Linkon gang' hype him into the national team, contradicting Jamie Day's own rule that bench players will not be called.

incidents.title: National team still without a salaried manager
incidents.summary: Fans ask after how many years the national team will get a salaried manager.

incidents.title: Sri Lanka and Nepal advance while BFF stagnates
incidents.summary: Sri Lanka called 14 foreign-based and naturalised players for trials and revamped their league as Super League; Nepal started a franchise league; BFF must change or Bangladesh rots while others advance.

incidents.title: Expatriate Bangladeshi players overlooked by Jamie Day
incidents.summary: Fans ask why expatriate players - Johnny, Khatan, Joseph Nur Rahman, Das, Karim and Jeremy Faruqi - never get national-team chances, while Afghanistan snaps up diaspora talent and Jamie Day says he has had no time to assess them.

incidents.title: Nepal tri-nation tournament not shown on Bangladeshi TV
incidents.summary: Fans ask if any Bangladeshi TV channel will show the tri-nation tournament in Nepal, while T-Sports shows an India-England ODI instead of the national team's match.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal's 2012 AFC Presidents Cup withdrawal recalled as shameful precedent
incidents.summary: Fans recall Sheikh Jamal setting a shameful precedent by withdrawing from the 2012 AFC Presidents Cup, with Muktijoddha refused as a replacement, alongside an accusation Jamal fixed Muktijoddha out of the title.

incidents.title: Kyrgyzstan send their U23 kids to the Three Nations Cup
incidents.summary: Fans mock that Kyrgyzstan sent their U23 kids' team, who do not even age-cheat, to the Three Nations Cup.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal players ignored by the national team since 2016
incidents.summary: Fans point out no Sheikh Jamal player has been in the national team since 2016, and that Yasin Khan single-handedly held Jamal's defence yet was ignored while discarded players were picked.

incidents.title: Three Nations Cup farce: only goal in 270 minutes is an own goal
incidents.summary: Across the Three Nations Cup's three matches (270 minutes) the only goal is an own goal by Kyrgyzstan U23's Kumar Baj Ulu Baiaman.

incidents.title: Nepal tri-nation final defeat: Jamie Day's selection and tactics blamed
incidents.summary: Bangladesh lose the Nepal tri-nation final 2-1 and fans blame Jamie Day's short-sighted squad, experimental XI and negative approach; he then skips the post-match press conference and is served a show-cause notice.

incidents.title: Covid league-restart chaos: second leg delayed, clubs unready
incidents.summary: With Covid, the league's second leg may not restart before May, the promised seven days after lockdown pass, and several clubs are not ready when the restart is set.

incidents.title: Abahani dropped from AFC Cup; Group D postponed amid Covid-bubble rows
incidents.summary: Abahani are removed from the AFC Cup for failing to host the playoff, then Group D is postponed; Kings allege the postponement was planned to help Covid-hit Indian sides and demand compensation, even asking for Bengaluru and Mohun Bagan to be removed.

incidents.title: FIFA stops funding BFF over spending irregularities
incidents.summary: FIFA stops funding BFF over irregularities in spending FIFA money; the federation claims FIFA only urged more transparency and no suspension happened, while fans ask whether the Corona fund money will be used properly.

incidents.title: Abahani's foreign players attacked as cheap and useless
incidents.summary: Fans say even if Abahani become AFC Cup champions they should remove their cheap foreign footballers, three of whose four are called useless.

incidents.title: BFF's Kamalapur academy: floodlights burn while surroundings stay filthy
incidents.summary: A reshared post notes BFF is building an academy at Kamalapur, but floodlights burn and a giant screen sits while the surroundings are filthy and noisy.

incidents.title: Eleta Kingsley's registration blocked at the last moment
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings learn the night before a match that Eleta Kingsley, newly a Bangladeshi citizen, is not eligible to play despite the Players' Status Committee declaring his registration valid; weeks later his NID and passport status remain unclear.

incidents.title: No proper stadium or practice ground: Brothers Union train on bare ground
incidents.summary: Brothers Union, a professional team, practise on a bare ground, and fans ask why BFF does not have even one proper stadium.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan abused online over 'Original Ronaldo' post
incidents.summary: Locals abuse captain Jamal Bhuyan online for calling Brazilian Ronaldo the 'Original Ronaldo', a description FIFA itself has used; fans defend him as the country's asset.

incidents.title: Sushanth Tripura benched at a big club
incidents.summary: Playing for a big club has benefits and pains, as Sushanth Tripura understands sitting on the side bench.

incidents.title: Fake IDs edit Hamza Choudhury's posts to mislead fans
incidents.summary: Fans warn that fake IDs edit Hamza Choudhury's Instagram posts with the Bangladesh flag to mislead supporters into thinking he wants to play for Bangladesh. Suggested new category: fan_misinformation.

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings delay releasing players to the national camp
incidents.summary: Kings initially refuse to release players to the national camp until quarantine arrangements in Qatar and Bangladesh are clear; BFF implicitly threatens them before the players are released.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Gold Cup 2018 broadcast quality unmatched by the league
incidents.summary: Fans ask whether the league broadcast can ever match the Bangabandhu Gold Cup 2018 broadcast quality.

incidents.title: World Cup qualifier preparation failure: no friendlies, no foreign camp
incidents.summary: Fans condemn BFF for sending Bangladesh into the June World Cup qualifiers with a makeshift 10-day Dhaka camp and no preparation matches while Nepal, Afghanistan, India and Oman all play friendlies abroad; the team even practises without Covid test results.

incidents.title: Qatar squad omissions: Zico, Sufil, Ibrahim and Nobab left out
incidents.summary: Zico is dropped at the last moment, Sufil and Ibrahim are left behind for the Qatar flight, and Obaidur Rahman Nobab gets no place for not yet proving himself in the BPL, while no Abahani or Sheikh Jamal player makes the squad at all.

incidents.title: Overage players in age-group football
incidents.summary: Overage players have been played in the Bangabandhu and Bangamata U-17 National Gold Cup since its first edition, and age-based divisions risk creating a field for age fraud.

incidents.title: World Cup qualifier refereeing: three wrong decisions vs Afghanistan
incidents.summary: Fans say three wrong decisions in 100 minutes, including a denied penalty, marred Bangladesh's World Cup qualifier against Afghanistan.

incidents.title: World Cup qualifiers fallout: fans demand Jamie Day be sacked
incidents.summary: After defeats to Afghanistan, India and Oman, fans demand Jamie Day be sacked over defensive long-ball tactics, wrong substitutions, the Rimon-at-right-back experiment and claims a better coach is needed, while others defend his record and propose Anwar Uddin as successor.

incidents.title: BFF could not bring Afghanistan to Bangladesh for home matches
incidents.summary: Fans ask why BFF could not bring Afghanistan to Bangladesh while the AFC fulfils Bashundhara Kings' wishes without a word.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan stripped of the national-team captaincy
incidents.summary: Jamal Bhuyan is relieved of the captaincy before the Oman match, ending his run as captain through the team's anxious transition period.

incidents.title: Rimon at right-back exposed against Oman
incidents.summary: Fans blame Rimon Hossain's positioning at right-back for goals conceded against Oman, after Tariq Kazi was moved to midfield despite shutting down the right wing in the previous matches.

incidents.title: Zico's mistakes in Qatar under fire
incidents.summary: Fans say goalkeeper Zico's mistakes in the Qatar tour, including a shot that hit his bar before falling to his gloves, show he needs to study top European goalkeepers. Suggested new category: player_performance_criticism.

incidents.title: T-Sports accused of hiding incidents in replays and highlights
incidents.summary: Fans accuse T-Sports of cutting a syndicate player's mistakes from the highlights and of omitting Mohammedan keeper Sujan's red card from the replay.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan quarantine-violation row; fans suspect it was staged
incidents.summary: A poster who criticised Jamal Bhuyan's quarantine violation later suspects the incident was intentionally staged against Jamal for speaking out against BFF over World Cup qualifier preparation.

incidents.title: BFF and syndicates blamed for football's decline: no academy, no ground
incidents.summary: Fans blame BFF and syndicates for having no quality international ground and no academy, saying money for the game will not help while syndicates control it and the league structure keeps district clubs out.

incidents.title: Oscar Bruzon benches Tariq and Nawab at Bashundhara Kings
incidents.summary: Fans accused Kings coach Oscar Bruzon of benching expatriates Tariq Kazi and Obaidur Rahman Nawab despite their national-team form, playing Bishwanath Ghosh instead; the benching row ran from June into September 2021 as supporters said even a banana tree could coach Kings to the title.

incidents.title: Tariq Kazi red card: referee Jalal Uddin accused of covering his own errors
incidents.summary: Tariq Kazi is sent off in the 87th minute vs Rahmatganj and fans say referee Jalal Uddin made him the scapegoat for his own errors, also depriving Sheikh Jamal of a win; Rahmatganj formally protest to BFF.

incidents.title: Journalist's racist 'Africans fight' remark condemned
incidents.summary: Fans demand a journalist be judged and banned from journalism for a racist remark about Africans, in a row also targeting Oscar Bruzon's defender. Suggested new category: racist_remarks.

incidents.title: Post deleted by 'invisible influence' after a player's relative sent a friend request
incidents.summary: A poster says their post was deleted due to 'invisible influence' and that a named player's relative sent a friend request minutes later, warning that screenshots will follow any inbox approach. Suggested new category: suppression_of_criticism.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Stadium turns into a swimming pool in the rain
incidents.summary: A top-level league match looks like a village rain-soaked game, and Police vs Brothers Union players clear water by hand before a free kick as Bangabandhu Stadium floods.

incidents.title: BPL refereeing rows: denied penalties, bad calls and a red card
incidents.summary: Fans catalogue a run of BPL refereeing errors through July and mid-August, from a denied penalty and a non-call on a hit to Nixon's face to Mohammedan's arguments with officials.

incidents.title: BPL suspended amid muddy pitches
incidents.summary: Rain turns BPL grounds to mud and the league is suspended on 1 July, with fans contrasting Bangladesh's pitches with India and East Bengal playing through heavy rain in Kolkata.

incidents.title: False report claims Zico is leaving Bashundhara Kings
incidents.summary: A page reports without a reliable source that goalkeeper Anisur Rahman Zico is leaving Bashundhara Kings while under contract; fans question the report's truth and propriety. Suggested new category: transfer rumour / false report.

incidents.title: AFC cancels the 2022 U17 and U20 Women's Asian Cups
incidents.summary: AFC cancels the 2022 AFC U17 and U20 Women's Asian Cups along with their qualifiers, drawing fan anger.

incidents.title: AFC Cup postponed to August at Kings' demand
incidents.summary: After Bashundhara Kings' demand the AFC Cup is moved to August, which fans say benefits Indian clubs whose transfer window has opened.

incidents.title: Fans demand Salahuddin resign
incidents.summary: A July wave of posts mocks and demands the resignation of BFF president Kazi Salahuddin and league committee chairman Salam Murshedi over 12 years of failure.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan trolls Raheem Sterling on social media
incidents.summary: Captain Jamal Bhuyan is criticised for trolling Raheem Sterling on social media on the day of the Euro final.

incidents.title: Syndicate and commission allegations in signings
incidents.summary: Fans allege a syndicate and commission business around signings, saying Saif Sporting should sign foreigners on merit as Bashundhara Kings did and stop any commission deals.

incidents.title: Stadiums and facilities: BFF gym, Bangabandhu renovation and Spain's gifted stadium
incidents.summary: Fans track BFF's infrastructure promises and failures: a long-promised gym finally built, a 98-crore Bangabandhu renovation, Spain's reported gifted stadium, and the venue shortage that leaves football sharing grounds while cricket keeps getting stadiums.

incidents.title: Mohammedan expel Robiul for repeated indiscipline
incidents.summary: Mohammedan expel Robiul after three warnings for indiscipline, and he then fails to find a place in the side either.

incidents.title: Oscar Bruzon's tactics questioned after Kings lose to Chittagong Abahani
incidents.summary: After Bashundhara Kings lose to Chittagong Abahani, fans question Oscar Bruzon's selections and tactics, noting a third loss to Maruful Haque's side.

incidents.title: T-Sports broadcast blunder: wrong XI graphic
incidents.summary: T-Sports show Chittagong's XI and Baridhara's bench in a broadcast graphics error.

incidents.title: AFC chooses Maldives over Bangladesh to host
incidents.summary: AFC chooses Maldives ahead of Bangladesh as a host, to fans' frustration.

incidents.title: Fortis accuse Swadhinata of match-fixing
incidents.summary: Fortis FC complain in writing to BFF accusing Swadhinata Krira Sangha of fixing matches against Youngmen's and Dhaka City to deny Fortis the title.

incidents.title: League suspended two hours before kick-off
incidents.summary: BFF suspends the BPL two hours before matches on 30 July after teams had already reached the ground, over the Kamalapur turf row, and fans call the on-off league a circus.

incidents.title: Unpaid wages: Ariful Islam's ordeal and clubs not paying players
incidents.summary: Former national captain Ariful Islam's unpaid-wages ordeal ends in a suicide attempt; Sheikh Jamal players went unpaid in 2018-19 and Muktijoddha fail to pay Japanese footballer Yusuke Kato salary and facilities.

incidents.title: Elita Kingsley's naturalisation and clearance saga
incidents.summary: Nigerian-born Elita Kingsley's clearance to play for Bangladesh stalls for months: FIFA asks for immigration papers, BFF does not chase clearance after his June passport, and he misses the SAFF despite making the preliminary squad and training with the team.

incidents.title: Women's football grants questioned
incidents.summary: Fans question why the women's sector does not get its due despite FIFA granting it the maximum allocation of 1 crore 20 lakh taka.

incidents.title: BFF deletes fan comments and turns off its comment box
incidents.summary: Fans allege BFF deletes critical comments and keeps its comment section off, including on the president's birthday post, while FIFA and AFC pages stay open to fans.

incidents.title: Salam Murshedi under fire from supporters and Ekattor TV
incidents.summary: Supporters and Ekattor TV turn on league committee chairman Salam Murshedi over the professional league's state, with calls to boycott him and free BFF from him.

incidents.title: Six nations reject BFF friendly proposals
incidents.summary: Afghanistan, Bhutan, Laos, Cambodia, Maldives and Macau reject BFF's September FIFA friendly proposals, and fans contrast it with Bangladesh rejecting Iran's 2019 friendly offer.

incidents.title: BPL broadcast failures: 240p streams, lag and wrong graphics
incidents.summary: Fans slam BPL and national-team broadcasting: 240p handycam streams, low-FPS lag on T-Sports, mislabelled matches, and TV channels ignoring football for cricket days before the SAFF.

incidents.title: Matin Mia's AFC Cup in doubt over expired passport
incidents.summary: Matin Mia's AFC Cup participation is uncertain because his passport has expired.

incidents.title: Uttar Baridhara accused of match-fixing
incidents.summary: After releasing all foreigners once relegation was avoided, Uttar Baridhara's performances draw match-fixing accusations, with fans saying the goals give it away.

incidents.title: Oscar Bruzon's Kings flop out of the AFC Cup
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings crash out of the AFC Cup group stage in the Maldives, drawing with Bengaluru and losing to ATK Mohun Bagan, as fans blame Oscar Bruzon's defensive tactics, selections and failure to use squad depth.

incidents.title: Syndicate and commission allegations: Rupu, Abahani and BFF
incidents.summary: Fans allege a syndicate runs selections and signings, from Oscar Bruzon's Kings signings to Rupu's influence at Abahani and age-group teams, and say expatriates must prove themselves in the league while locals are automatic picks.

incidents.title: Match-day ambulance and medical facilities condemned
incidents.summary: Fans ask whether the match-day ambulance will ever change, condemning poor medical facilities at matches.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal sack coach Manik hours before a match
incidents.summary: Sheikh Jamal sack Shafiqul Islam Manik before a big match at Bangabandhu Stadium, continuing the club's history of sacking coaches at the top of the league; Manik then speaks out against the club's management.

incidents.title: Stadium and pitch neglect: Kamalapur turf and Bangabandhu
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings are made to play their last league match before the AFC Cup on Kamalapur's injury-prone turf, and the Bangabandhu pitch is condemned as the worst an Iranian player has seen, with Nawab slipping six or seven times in 18 minutes.

incidents.title: Jamie Day's squad snubs in-form players
incidents.summary: Jamie Day's national squad leaves out in-form players including Faisal Ahmed Fahim, Mohammad Jewel and Sumon Reza, while expatriate call-ups Shoron Khan and Rahbar Khan divide opinion.

incidents.title: Bangladesh Super League proposal blocked by officials
incidents.summary: Fans blame power-hungry officials for blocking the proposed Bangladesh Super League, after crores were spent unveiling its logo and trophy and a 200-crore venue budget was passed.

incidents.title: Arambagh relegated and banned for match-fixing
incidents.summary: Arambagh lose 18 of 21 matches and are relegated, then officials and players are banned after a match-fixing investigation, a fall fans trace back to the club's casino raid.

incidents.title: Brothers Union collapse while its officials run BFF
incidents.summary: Brothers Union suffer relegation for the first time in their 46-year history and end the league with a loss, as fans blame officials who used the club while running BFF.

incidents.title: Abahani kicked out of AFC playoffs while Kings collect AFC dues
incidents.summary: Fans contrast Bashundhara Kings collecting their AFC dues after two years on the international stage with Abahani being kicked out of the AFC playoffs. Suggested new category: AFC licensing failure.

incidents.title: Former captain Aminul Islam attacked
incidents.summary: Fans condemn and protest an attack on former national captain and gold-winning goalkeeper Aminul Islam.

incidents.title: Journalists afraid to criticise players' mistakes
incidents.summary: Fans accuse Bangladesh's football journalists of being too afraid to discuss players' mistakes on air and instead buttering them up. Suggested new category: sports media accountability.

incidents.title: AFC Cup refereeing row: disallowed goal and Sushanto's red card
incidents.summary: Kings' AFC Cup exit is blamed in part on refereeing: a ball hitting the bar is ruled no goal against Bengaluru, and Sushanto Tripura's red card against ATK Mohun Bagan is called over-enthusiastic and motivated.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal players fight spectators and get banned
incidents.summary: Sheikh Jamal players fight Brothers Union supporters after a draw on 21 August with no police in the stadium, and two players are later banned.

incidents.title: Jamuna TV accused of smearing expatriate Shoron Khan
incidents.summary: Fans condemn a Jamuna Television report about Canada-expatriate footballer Shoron Khan getting a national team chance as a conspiratorial smear.

incidents.title: Clubs play hide-and-seek with injuries
incidents.summary: Fans accuse clubs including Saif and Bashundhara Kings of hiding injury information, noting Arifur Rahman has been out for six months for unknown reasons.

incidents.title: Independence Cup dangled for a year with no date
incidents.summary: Fans ask where the Independence Cup is after BFF spent a year dangling a 17-team FA Cup-style format with qualifiers.

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings warned over following a betting firm
incidents.summary: Fans warn Bashundhara Kings after the club follows a Tajik betting firm on Instagram and urge caution.

incidents.title: Women's team decline and Kiran's travel spending
incidents.summary: The women's team slide to heavy defeats against Jordan and Iran while fans question coaching under Paul Smalley and Choton, the manager's reappointment, and Mahfuza Akhter Kiran's foreign trips and spending as the women's league stays shut.

incidents.title: Ex-Kings official Minhaz accused of fixing and betting
incidents.summary: Fans allege former Bashundhara Kings general secretary Minhazul Minhaz fixed 12-13 Championship League matches and was involved in betting, and say BFF never investigated him despite a life ban.

incidents.title: Fans' sit-in and protest movement against Salahuddin
incidents.summary: After the coaching change and SAFF squad, fans organise a boycott-Salahuddin movement with sit-ins at the BFF building and the PM's office, human chains, hashtags and calls for cases in every police station. The movement carried into October: fans noted the promised protesters were nowhere to be seen, and one fan tried to organise a protest at the BFF building on 25 October.

incidents.title: Friendlies expose Jamie Day: Tariq out of position, expatriates frozen out
incidents.summary: Bangladesh lose 2-0 to Palestine and 4-1 to Kyrgyzstan as fans blast Jamie Day for playing Tariq Kazi at centre-back, persisting with Bishwanath Ghosh at wing-back, and freezing out expatriates while locals are automatic picks.

incidents.title: Promising talent Al Amin's career under threat from officials
incidents.summary: Fans say promising talent Al Amin's career is under threat because of dishonest officials, noting his training opportunity at Manchester City.

incidents.title: Bangladesh should leave SAFF for ASEAN or CAFA
incidents.summary: Fans argue Bangladesh should join ASEAN as Afghanistan and India move toward CAFA, saying the BFF president staying SAFF president keeps Bangladesh in SAFF. Suggested new category: regional affiliation.

incidents.title: Bangladesh fall to 189th in the FIFA ranking
incidents.summary: Bangladesh fall to 189th in the FIFA ranking after the Palestine and Kyrgyzstan defeats, and fans joke about the slide toward 200th. Suggested new category: FIFA ranking decline.

incidents.title: SAFF squad: expatriates frozen out
incidents.summary: The SAFF preliminary and final squads leave out Yusuf, Nawab, Mahdi, Rahbar, Fahim and Jewel while keeping Biplu, Matin and Bishwanath, as fans blame an Abahani-Kings syndicate and predict failure in the Maldives.

incidents.title: Players accused of fake IDs and arguing with fans
incidents.summary: Fans accuse so-called professional players of arguing with supporters and running fake IDs to oppose expatriate players, and urge admins to kick them out.

incidents.title: Oscar Bruzon handed the national team; Rupu made manager
incidents.summary: BFF sack Jamie Day without informing him 15 days before the SAFF and hand the national team to Bashundhara Kings coach Oscar Bruzon, with Satyajit Das Rupu back as manager, as fans mock the appointment and predict a fifth-place finish.

incidents.title: BPL awards snub: no award for the top scorer
incidents.summary: Fans complain the league committee gives only three individual awards, with none even for the top scorer, and the same trophy for every competition. Suggested new category: league awards.

incidents.title: Commission deals for trialists and Rupu's transfer pressure
incidents.summary: Fans allege a syndicate profits from bringing unfit expatriate trialists, that Bishwanath and Biplu play after commission deals with Oscar, and that Rupu pressures Mohammedan players to join Abahani.

incidents.title: Age fraud alleged across youth and national teams
incidents.summary: Fans allege age fraud across youth and national teams, citing long-serving youth captains and claiming national players are far older than listed, and accuse a journalist of hiding Nawab's age ineligibility.

incidents.title: Salahuddin's promised VAR in the BPL never arrives
incidents.summary: Fans ask whether anyone remembers Salahuddin promising VAR in the Bangladesh Premier League. Suggested new category: VAR promise.

incidents.title: Expatriates frozen out: passports, benches and the Kings hoard
incidents.summary: From October to December fans kept demanding Nawab, Rahbar, Mahdi, Yousuf, Tariq, Elita and Riasat be picked or played, blaming passport excuses, quota selection and Bashundhara Kings' bench-hoarding while the syndicate's favourites played.

incidents.title: Media accused of ignoring football for cricket and going soft on BFF
incidents.summary: Fans accused TV and newspapers of giving football seconds after cricket, getting basic facts wrong, and never pressing BFF's syndicate the way they pressed cricket's board. [Suggested new category: media_neglect.]

incidents.title: SAFF 2021: group-stage exit with no open-play goal
incidents.summary: Bangladesh exited the SAFF group stage scoring only three set-piece goals in four matches, and fans blamed Salahuddin and the BFF for a sixth straight group-stage exit under him.

incidents.title: SAFF commentary slated as incomprehensible
incidents.summary: Fans slated the SAFF commentary as incomprehensible and factually wrong, singling out commentator Momin Ruhn.

incidents.title: T Sports accused of Kings-only biased coverage
incidents.summary: Fans accused T Sports of broadcasting only on Bashundhara Kings' match days with commentary that only talked about Kings and Robinho, and of skipping Bangladesh football for cricket instead. [Suggested new category: media_bias.]

incidents.title: Igor Stimac's 'funny' remarks mocked after India drop points
incidents.summary: Fans mocked India coach Igor Stimac for repeatedly calling results funny, after India conceded a funny header and a funny penalty and drew with Sri Lanka. [Suggested new category: cross_border_banter.]

incidents.title: Elita's clearance still pending, nine months after his passport
incidents.summary: Nine months after Elita Kingsley got his passport in March, BFF still had not secured his international clearance, and fans kept demanding the naturalised striker for the four-nation tournament and the January friendlies.

incidents.title: Maldives SAFF tickets: Bangladeshis shut out, black market at three times the price
incidents.summary: Maldives gave Bangladeshi spectators only a 10% ticket quota for the SAFF match against Bangladesh, fans said the rest went to the black market at three times the price, and BFF was pressed to act.

incidents.title: BFF mocked for lavish Tariq birthday cake
incidents.summary: Fans mocked the national team celebrating Tariq Kazi's birthday with an unnecessarily big cake as BFF waste while football starved.

incidents.title: Refereeing rows at the SAFF and in the league
incidents.summary: Fans protested a cancelled onside Sri Lanka goal, a biased SAFF referee, and Zico's red card for handling outside the box.

incidents.title: Stadiums and academies: Zimbabwe and Myanmar ahead
incidents.summary: Fans contrasted Zimbabwe's stadiums and Myanmar's three football academies with Bangladesh, asking how far BFF's FIFA-funded academy work had gone, and noted clubs run no youth teams or U18 league.

incidents.title: Coaching carousel: Oscar under fire, Lemos in, and the search for the next coach
incidents.summary: Oscar Bruzon's SAFF tactics and Kings selections drew months of sack calls, Mario Lemos took the national team for the four-nation tournament amid claims the Rupu loop had simply changed names, and by December fans debated de Kruif, Constantine and Maruful as the next coach.

incidents.title: SAFF logistics shambles: no team bus, practice-kit photoshoot, goalkeeper kit
incidents.summary: The SAFF squad walked back to the hotel when no team bus came and did the official photoshoot in practice kits, and in November a player wore a goalkeeper kit, which fans read as BFF kit and logistics failure. [Suggested new category: team_logistics.]

incidents.title: Player publicly calls a teammate brainless
incidents.summary: Fans attacked a player who publicly called a teammate brainless, reminding him of his own mistakes that let Sunil Chhetri score twice.

incidents.title: Topu Barman's ISL move falls through
incidents.summary: Topu Barman was accused of rejecting communication and lying about an Indian Super League offer, and by late October fans noted he would not play in the ISL this time. [Suggested new category: transfer_saga.]

incidents.title: Captain Jamal's team-of-the-tournament post questioned
incidents.summary: Fans questioned a team-of-the-tournament post shared by captain Jamal Bhuyan, saying it was not on SAFF's page and asking if he made it himself. [Suggested new category: fabricated_social_media_post.]

incidents.title: National players play khep exhibition matches
incidents.summary: Fans mocked national players for playing paid local exhibition (khep) matches on rest days, while one player did it to pay for his sick mother's treatment after the club refused to pay. [Suggested new category: khep_exhibition_matches.]

incidents.title: Players stay away from camp as BFF's relentless camps bite
incidents.summary: Players were slow to join camp and fans read it as a silent protest at BFF's relentless camps, with barely any rest in a year and 15-day camps without international matches.

incidents.title: U23 Asian Cup qualifiers: heavy defeats and a goalkeeping crisis
incidents.summary: The U23s lost to Kuwait and 6-0 to Uzbekistan in Asian Cup qualifying, fans blamed the goalkeeping crisis around Pappu and the absence of expatriates, and the debate over Mitul Marma's readiness ran into December.

incidents.title: Goalkeeping coach Nayan beaten in Mirpur
incidents.summary: Goalkeeping coach Nuruzzaman Nayan was badly beaten by a motorcyclist and five or six others in Mirpur, and fans demanded justice and punishment for the attackers. [Suggested new category: assault_on_team_staff.]

incidents.title: Contract chaos: double signings, verbal deals and the Yasin Khan saga
incidents.summary: Players took advance money from two or three clubs, clubs relied on verbal deals with no written contracts, and the Yasin Khan tug-of-war between Bashundhara Kings and Sheikh Jamal ended with Kings' legal notice and Yasin leaving with a grievance.

incidents.title: Mohammedan's foreign recruitment mess
incidents.summary: Fans claimed Mohammedan could not sign good foreigners because the coach, backed by committee ex-players, blocked deals amid commission business, while the club's own foreign signings disappointed and officials later said foreigners were told to come later.

incidents.title: Four-nation tournament failure in Sri Lanka
incidents.summary: Bangladesh's four-nation campaign in Sri Lanka ended in defeat to Sri Lanka and a draw with Seychelles, which fans called poetic justice for the syndicate.

incidents.title: Muktijoddha Sangsad's decline: poor foreigners and a threadbare squad
incidents.summary: Fans criticised low-quality Japanese signings and Malaysian trainers profiting off struggling Muktijoddha, and by December called its squad threadbare.

incidents.title: Independence Cup warned to slip over the delayed Sri Lanka tour
incidents.summary: Fans warned the delayed Sri Lanka tour and quarantine would push the Independence Cup back and hoped BFF would not postpone it further.

incidents.title: Journalist: Salahuddin asks for money, football will never rise
incidents.summary: A post quoted Ekattor TV journalist Upal Nandi saying Bangladesh football will never rise above this level, with Salahuddin asking for money.

incidents.title: National team has no salary or match fee
incidents.summary: Fans asked why players go to play when clubs splash money but the national team has no salary or match fee.

incidents.title: Bashundhara's Brazilian signing Andre Felipe falls through
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings had signed Brazil's Andre Felipe as a surprise, but he did not come, with fans citing personal reasons and his wife's objection.

incidents.title: Only 2 of 9 clubs get AFC licences
incidents.summary: Nepal and Bhutan got 4 AFC licences each while Bangladesh got only 2 of 9 applicants, with fans arguing most of the money goes out through various holes.

incidents.title: Heavy defeats expose the state of football
incidents.summary: After heavy defeats including a six-goal loss, fans said the days of beating Sri Lanka to save face were over and services teams exposed the national game's state. [Suggested new category: on_field_decline.]

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings lawyer notice and BFF verdict questioned
incidents.summary: Fans asked what happened to the lawyer notice and BFF's verdict, or whether Bashundhara Kings quietly settled after joking in newspapers.

incidents.title: Dorielton's clearance still missing, then doubts over the final
incidents.summary: Abahani's Brazilian forward Dorielton could not play in late November as his ITC or international clearance had still not come, and by the final fans worried he would be unavailable.

incidents.title: Kings accused of buying referees in the Independence Cup
incidents.summary: Fans accused Bashundhara Kings of buying the league committee and referees after a denied Sheikh Jamal penalty, a wrongly flagged Sharifi offside, and Sharifi gesturing about money to the referee.

incidents.title: Former women's midfielder Suinu Ching now a mere employee
incidents.summary: Fans lamented that former women's national midfielder Suinu Ching, once a celebrated player, now works as a mere employee despite her achievements.

incidents.title: Kamalapur turf blamed for player injuries
incidents.summary: Fans blamed Kamalapur's discarded turf for ligament injuries to Topu, Tariq, Elita and Nawab, and backed Kings refusing to play on it.

incidents.title: Kings' paid fans and biryani-eaters under fire
incidents.summary: Fans accused Bashundhara Kings of fielding paid fans and biryani-eaters who drown out criticism, and mocked their yes-saying defence of the club. [Suggested new category: paid_fans.]

incidents.title: Rabiul's talent destroyed by drug addiction
incidents.summary: Fans traced Rabiul's fall from Arambagh to Kings' bench to expulsion from Mohammedan, asking why drug addiction destroys such talent.

incidents.title: Fake-ID smear calls Arefin Zeesan an expatriate broker
incidents.summary: A fake-ID post in another group accused group admin Arefin Zeesan of taking commission as a broker on expatriate players, and fans defended him, saying the syndicate's supporters post from fake IDs.

incidents.title: Begging clubs with no fans should be allowed to close
incidents.summary: Fans argued begging clubs with no fans or professionalism, naming Muktijoddha, should be allowed to close and make way for new clubs like Fortis.

incidents.title: Club domination of the federation and the power balance
incidents.summary: Fans argued club domination of federation posts and corruption drag football back, and that Abahani's Independence Cup final win over Kings shifted the power balance.

incidents.title: Sheikh Russel keep faith with Titu despite poor returns
