incidents.summary: Fans mocked Sheikh Russel for keeping Saiful Bari Titu as management's favourite despite little success in three years, after the second-most expensive club could not beat seventh-ranked Police FC.

incidents.title: U-17 age discrepancy: Anik Deb
incidents.summary: Fans pointed out an age discrepancy: viral Sylhet goalscorer Anik Deb was said to be over 18 yet played in an U-17 tournament.

incidents.title: BFF vice-president sits with a club's flag
incidents.summary: Fans asked in which country's federation a vice-president sits with a specific team's flag and supporters watching a domestic match.

incidents.title: Abahani accused of hijacking World Cupper Colindres from Kings
incidents.summary: Fans questioned a Khelajog report claiming Abahani hijacked World Cup player Daniel Colindres from Bashundhara Kings' home, while Lemos later credited Colindres with changing Abahani against Kings. [Suggested new category: transfer_dispute.]

incidents.title: 'Salahuddin out' protest movement: SYNDICATE OUT banners seized, then placard campaigns and boycotts
incidents.summary: Police snatched fans' SYNDICATE OUT banners at the stadium in Dec 2021; the protest grew into a running movement demanding Kazi Salahuddin, Abdus Salam Murshedy and Abu Nayeem Shohag out, with shoe-thrashing jibes, placard campaigns, hashtag boycotts and Barrister Sumon's attacks through Oct 2022.

incidents.title: Saif and Bashundhara urged to defy BFF with a Super League
incidents.summary: Fans said Saif and Bashundhara should defy BFF and implement the dream Bangladesh Super League, as UEFA defied FIFA.

incidents.title: Mohammedan and Swadhinata called back from buses for a tie-breaker
incidents.summary: Mohammedan and Swadhinata were called back from their buses for a tie-breaker after a 1-1 draw, with Mohammedan winning 4-3.

incidents.title: Titu's Sheikh Russel collapse and sacking (#TituThakbe fails)
incidents.summary: Saiful Bari Titu's ultra-defensive Sheikh Russel, the league's second-highest spenders, sink towards relegation amid the #TituThakbe campaign; Titu is sacked on 13 March.

incidents.title: BFF Elite Academy vs Bhutan's CG7: academy works with 20-year-olds
incidents.summary: Fans contrast the BFF Elite Academy working with 20-year-olds against Bhutan's CG7 Academy working with 8- to 10-year-old kids.

incidents.title: Federation Cup shambles: lost glamour, trophy chaos, torn Kamalapur turf
incidents.summary: The Federation Cup loses its glamour under BFF: a chaotic trophy ceremony, fixtures changed for one club, withdrawals, and matches on Kamalapur's torn turf.

incidents.title: Pioneer League age fraud: bribes, medical tests and 2-of-44 pass
incidents.summary: Fans report Pioneer League trials are passed with bribes, then BFF medical tests expose mass age cheating (one club: 2 of 44 pass) and charge clubs 800 taka per unfit player; later tests wrongly exclude genuine U-13 to U-15 boys.

incidents.title: Abahani keeper Shahidul's fans attack Saif supporters in the gallery
incidents.summary: Eyewitnesses say Abahani goalkeeper Shahidul Alam instructed supporters who abused Saif fans, stripped their jerseys, tore their flags and threw them out of the gallery; the admin demands justice from Abahani and BFF.

incidents.title: Federation Cup semi-finals: Saif's cancelled penalty and refereeing rows
incidents.summary: Saif's penalty is cancelled against Abahani in the Federation Cup semi-final, sparking protests, a press briefing, a show-cause, demands for foreign referees and claims of rigged fixtures and bought referees.

incidents.title: Middlemen profit from transfers while BFF stays hostage to votes
incidents.summary: A long post contrasts Cambodia's licensing shake-up and the Philippines' expatriate-led rise with Bangladesh, where middlemen profit from transfers and BFF is hostage to votes.

incidents.title: Expatriates frozen out of Cabrera's first squads: Elita, Nawab, Mahdi, Yusuf
incidents.summary: Elita Kingsley, Obaidur Nawab, Mahdi Yusuf Khan and Yusuf Zulkarnain are repeatedly left out of Cabrera's squads while out-of-form 'lords' stay; Elita's clearance is demanded, his loan to Mohammedan is blocked by the Kings, and fans call it syndicate scheming.

incidents.title: Javier Cabrera appointed: academy-CV coach mocked as 'Bruzon Lite'
incidents.summary: BFF appoint 37-year-old Javier Cabrera, whose CV is amateur academies and youth jobs, after semi-pro Jamie Day; fans call him Oscar Bruzon Lite, recall past failed foreign coaches and hope he stays syndicate-free.

incidents.title: Shahidul's 2019 Messenger threats to a fan over a haha reaction
incidents.summary: A fan shares 2019 Messenger screenshots of goalkeeper Shahidul messaging him over a haha reaction, calling it proof of Bangladeshi players' unprofessionalism.

incidents.title: BPL venue crisis: Kings Arena dropped, league confined to Munshiganj and Tongi
incidents.summary: BFF drop the Bashundhara Kings Arena and run the BPL only in Munshiganj and Tongi, with dressing rooms so poor Chittagong Abahani bring their own quilts; BFF even take the archery federation's ground without discussion.

incidents.title: Brothers Union: historic club skips the Championship League and fades

entities.name: Amer Khan
entities.role: Brothers Union director and football manager

incidents.summary: Brothers Union, once the third force after Abahani and Mohammedan, are relegated from the BPL and do not even play in the Championship League, with directors dodging questions about the club's plight.

incidents.title: Abahani's 75-lakh bonus for trophies worth 10 lakh mocked
incidents.summary: Fans sarcastically note two trophies worth 10 lakh taka won a 75 lakh taka bonus, calling it a rich federation.

incidents.title: No training ground: Laos build one while Bangladesh clubs rent fields
incidents.summary: Laos, one FIFA rank below Bangladesh, have built a training ground since 2020 while Bangladesh have no specific training ground, a worn astro turf beside the BFF building, and most clubs without even a practice ground.

incidents.title: Indonesia tour cancelled: unvaccinated players, no NIDs, fake birth certificates

entities.name: Kazi Nabil Ahmed
entities.role: BFF vice-president and national team committee chairman

incidents.summary: The Indonesia tour is cancelled because only 15 of 28 players are double-vaccinated and six are unvaccinated, many lacking NIDs; one post traces it to BFF issuing passports with fake birth certificates that cut players' ages.

incidents.title: Stadium grass scandal: durba instead of Bermuda at Bangabandhu and Kings Arena
incidents.summary: Bangabandhu Stadium's 100-crore renovation lays durba grass again instead of Bermuda, the Kings Arena pitch is durba too, and Kamalapur's turf is blamed for wrecking players; fans ask for the stadium's repair budget and timeline.

incidents.title: Ex-coaches thrive abroad: Saintfiet's Gambia soar, Djordjevic's World Cup claim
incidents.summary: Tom Saintfiet's Gambia jump 25 places in the FIFA ranking while Bangladesh sit 186th, and ex-coach Zoran Djordjevic claims Bangladesh would be playing the World Cup had BFF kept him.

incidents.title: Shah Alam Tutul accused of cheating rural boys with false club promises
incidents.summary: A post warns Shah Alam Tutul cheats people of money with false promises of club and league chances for rural boys, with fraud cases against him in Fenchuganj and Moulvibazar.

incidents.title: Cabrera's 'tall and strong' selection criterion row
incidents.summary: Fans split over Cabrera's reported view that only physically strong and tall players get national-team priority, citing 158cm Chanathip Songkrasin against defenders of the height rule.

incidents.title: Kings humbled by Shadhinota; Oscar's tactics under fire
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings lose to Shadhinota as Oscar Bruzon's tactics, memorised XI and out-of-position picks are attacked; fans demand the coaching panel change.

incidents.title: Referees need police protection after Federation Cup and league rows
incidents.summary: In the league's first match the referee leaves under police protocol, BFF are sarcastically thanked for showing referees so much respect, and the league committee chief is accused of taking part in a Kings-Baridhara match.

incidents.title: Kings buy the league's best and bench them
incidents.summary: The Kings buy the league's best performers and bench them — Elita, Mahdi, Nawab, Morsalin, Mithu, Matin — while the national coach himself complains Matin cannot keep form on the bench; fans warn the benched stars' careers are being ruined.

incidents.title: Ahmed Shayek: defends Salahuddin, then attacks Jamal and draws fan fury

entities.name: Ahmed Shayek
entities.role: Bashundhara Kings media and marketing manager

incidents.summary: Kings media manager Ahmed Shayek's old defence of Salahuddin is re-read, then fans attack him for tagging a foreigner to insult captain Jamal Bhuyan and for earlier calling Saif's president bald.

incidents.title: Sports minister speaks against BFF's hypocrisy
incidents.summary: A post reports the honourable sports state minister spoke against BFF's hypocrisy.

incidents.title: BCL fixing an open secret; Azimpur coach resigns over a thrown match
incidents.summary: BCL fixing is called an open secret, with Saif and the Kings said to have won promotion through fixed matches; Azimpur FC's coach resigns over unethical acts after a defender deliberately releases the ball, and BFF form an anti-betting unit.

incidents.title: Saif's refereeing protests escalate: letter to AFC/CAS, Cruciani fined
incidents.summary: Saif Sporting repeatedly suffer wrong decisions, write to the federation, threaten the AFC and CAS, and see coach Andres Cruciani fined 50,000 taka for adverse comments on refereeing.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan 'kicked the referee' row: journalist Sadman Sakib's false report
incidents.summary: Channel 24 journalist Sadman Sakib reports Jamal Bhuyan kicked the referee; fans say video clearly shows he did not, and the row feeds into Salahuddin's claims on referees' honorarium.

incidents.title: Danilo throws an opponent down and tries to strangle him
incidents.summary: A fan reports Danilo brutally threw an opponent to the ground and tried to strangle him.

incidents.title: Kings Arena opening marred by offside and penalty rows favouring the Kings
incidents.summary: The Kings Arena's first matches bring three wrong offside calls, a fake penalty and a corner taken outside the circle, with fans saying the referee saved Bashundhara as in the Muktijoddha match and teams play against 14 men.

incidents.title: Kings' paid fans: biryani and jersey handouts at the Arena
incidents.summary: Fans attack Bashundhara Kings' paid supporters: biryani and jersey handouts at the Arena, a Mohammedan fan beaten at the ground, and the handouts defended as the only club effort to bring supporters back.

incidents.title: BFF Elite Academy fielding rented players; expat Soumya Osman fails U16 trials
incidents.summary: The BFF Elite Academy is accused of fielding rented players from BKSP in the Championship League, while Norway expatriate Soumya Osman fails selection at the U-16 trials and returns to Norway.

incidents.title: Oscar Bruzon's 'lords' rant and the syndicate charge
incidents.summary: Oscar Bruzon's Facebook status fuming at Bangladesh fans says local players are lords and foreign locals must be auto-choice; fans say his viral statement shows he is involved with the syndicate keeping Elita, Mahdi and Nawab out.

incidents.title: Ex-FIFA referee Monsur Azad: referees fear whistling against big clubs
incidents.summary: Ex-FIFA referee Monsur Azad admits referees fear whistling against big clubs, with a colleague warned his FIFA badge would not survive whistling against Mohammedan.

incidents.title: Mohammedan's low-quality foreigners: a commission syndicate?
incidents.summary: A fan asks authorities to investigate whether Sean Lane and James McAlloon run a commission syndicate behind low-quality foreigners Ugo, Aaron and Jasmin at Mohammedan.

incidents.title: Cabrera's first squad (15 Mar): the 'lord XI' row erupts
incidents.summary: Cabrera's 15 March squad keeps Jibon, Biplu, Rimon, Jony, Sohel and Suman while in-form Faisal Fahim, Mahdi, Sohel Rana and others are ignored; fans call it a fair of lords picked by the syndicate, not the coach.

incidents.title: Abahani's 2011 Super Cup prize money still unpaid a decade on
incidents.summary: After becoming BFF president Kazi Salahuddin surprised everyone with the crore-taka Super Cup, but ten years on Dhaka Abahani still have not received the prize money from the 2011 edition.

incidents.title: Edgar Bernhardt wins FIFA ruling: Abahani must pay within 45 days or face ban
incidents.summary: Edgar Bernhardt complains to FIFA about unpaid remuneration after leaving Abahani; on 2 March FIFA's DRC rules in his favour, ordering Abahani to pay within 45 days or face a registration ban.

incidents.title: The origin-player campaign: Hamza, Elita and Solomon King as neighbours naturalise dozens
incidents.summary: A year-long campaign demands origin players: Sri Lanka's coach urges BFF to test and bring them, Malaysia and Vietnam naturalise dozens, Sri Lanka's Aspire-backed project calls up 15 to 20, while BFF say Hamza must first prove himself in the BPL and wait for the coach to speak on Elita.

incidents.title: Salahuddin's World Cup promise mocked as the trophy tours Dhaka
incidents.summary: Salahuddin's promise that Bangladesh will play the World Cup is mocked for months: the Brazil ambassador's eight-year claim, the Italy comparison, the trophy tour to Dhaka, and sarcastic thanks for Bangladesh 'making it' to Qatar 2022.

incidents.title: Muktijoddha cannot pay salaries: locals owed 1.7 crore
incidents.summary: A club with 30 domestic footballers, two foreign coaches and four foreign players cannot pay salaries, with locals owed about 1.7 crore taka and foreigners paid only two months.

incidents.title: Riadul Rafi dropped for rejecting a corporate club's offer
incidents.summary: The new syndicate, friend of the corporate club's head coach, dropped Riadul Rafi from the national team for signing for his old club after rejecting a corporate club's offer.

incidents.title: Zico's foreign-offer saga: MLS and Al Hilal claims mocked as fake
incidents.summary: Goalkeeper Anisur Rahman Zico's claimed offers from MLS, the Costa Rican league and Saudi's Al Hilal are mocked as false, with fans saying he only got an offer from an American divisional team and Topu Barman used the same blackmail to double his salary.

incidents.title: Sheikh Russel demand referees Alamgir and Bituraj be banned
incidents.summary: Sheikh Russel demand controversial referees Alamgir Sarkar and Bituraj Barua be banned, questioning how Salam Murshedy can chair both the league and referees committees.

incidents.title: Cabrera under fire after the Maldives defeat and Mongolia draw
incidents.summary: After the Maldives defeat and Mongolia draw, Cabrera is called the lowest-quality Bangladesh coach yet, accused of being Oscar's man, and his record without a pure number nine and winless run are dissected; by June fans joke he looks like Guardiola but coaches like Pochettino.

incidents.title: Maldives defeat and Mongolia draw: the 'lord XI' blamed
incidents.summary: Bangladesh lose 2-0 to Maldives and draw Mongolia as fans blame the Kings' lord XI, wrong-position picks, Jamal's substitution for Biplu and Suman Reza's open-post misses, and demand a second squad of Elita, Fahim, Nawab and Emon.

incidents.title: Saif Sporting Club's MD and general secretary resign
incidents.summary: Saif Sporting Club managing director Nasiruddin Chowdhury and general secretary Mahbubur Rahman Sumon resign; a month later fans still cannot learn with what resentment Chowdhury left the club he planted.

incidents.title: Jamie Day told Salahuddin the harsh truth about the national team
incidents.summary: A post says Jamie Day last year frankly told BFF boss Salahuddin the harsh truth about the national team.

incidents.title: Local players learn football at 15-16 on khep grounds: the education gap
incidents.summary: Bangladeshi local footballers mostly learned football in neighbourhood and khep grounds from age 15-16, leaving big gaps in football education that show in international matches.

incidents.title: T Sports and BFF's shambolic broadcasts: no sound, IPL instead, VGA cameras
incidents.summary: Fans beg for match links as T Sports is busy with the IPL, BFF's own live has comments off and no sound, old VGA cameras are used in the top league while UEFA cameras serve the Championship League, and commentators are accused of halal-ising Kings fouls.

incidents.title: Journalist Ehtesham Sabuj's cheap behaviour at the FIFA Congress
incidents.summary: A post slams journalist Ehtesham Sabuj for cheap behaviour at the FIFA Congress, asking top journalists if they know the 188th-ranked country.

incidents.title: Fahad handball penalty row
incidents.summary: A fan argues Fahad's clearance clearly hit his hand, a penalty under FIFA's new rule, and that Jewel's touch made Rimon dive successfully.

incidents.title: Azimpur players crammed 25 to two rooms in a tin shed by the railway
incidents.summary: Azimpur Club's 25 players are crammed into two rooms of 15 and 14 beds in a tin shed beside the railway line, where players tell trains apart by their horns.

incidents.title: Airtel Rising Stars lost after Man Utd trip; same feared for Brazil 12
incidents.summary: BFF lost the twelve Airtel Rising Stars footballers sent to Manchester United for training in 2012, and fans fear the same for the twelve now being sent to Brazil.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan vs Sadman Sakib: captaincy stripped, media smear war
incidents.summary: Jamal Bhuyan loses Saif's captaincy and is then sent to Muktijoddha as fans say the syndicate eloped the armband; Channel 24's Sadman Sakib is accused of misleading propaganda after Jamal rejected a magazine photoshoot deal, and Jamal is barred from the Kings Arena.

incidents.title: Fans' racist mocking of Nuha Marang defended
incidents.summary: A post says Bangladeshi people are quite racist, and those mocking Nuha Marang should look at Robson Robinho's pre-Bangladesh profile, since Nuha's is better.

incidents.title: Offside denies expat Bishal Das a goal
incidents.summary: A fan asks offside or onside, saying if the call had not been given, expatriate Bishal Das would have scored after many days on the field from a great through pass.

incidents.title: Kings' AFC Cup failure: 4-0 to Mohun Bagan and another group exit
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings exit the AFC Cup group stage again after a 4-0 defeat to ATK Mohun Bagan in Kolkata, with Bishwanath's errors, Oscar's defensive tactics and makeshift centre-backs blamed; Imrul Hasan's target had already slid from winning the Cup to just crossing the group.

incidents.title: $1000 ITC fees and cut-money from contracts
incidents.summary: A fan asks whether football is a medium to earn 1000 dollars, saying someone asks 1000 dollars to manage an ITC and someone takes cut-money from players' contracts.

incidents.title: Mohammedan: failed club, no venue, academy or gym
incidents.summary: A long post says Mohammedan as a club is somewhat failed, still holding an 80s-90s analogue football philosophy without a home venue, modern academy, training ground or gymnasium.

incidents.title: Asian Cup qualifiers squad: expatriates frozen out as the 'lord XI' stays
incidents.summary: The June Asian Cup qualifiers squad is announced without Elita — the league's top local scorer with FIFA and AFC clearance — while the lord XI stays; fans threaten street protests, note BFF will name the Kings squad only after the AFC Cup, and ask why Indonesia can naturalise while BFF stalls.

incidents.title: Samuel Hudson's jersey number written in marker pen at Saif
incidents.summary: Saif won but expatriate Samuel Elhaz Hudson sat on the bench with his jersey number missing from the kit and written in marker pen.

incidents.title: Saif youth players abandoned: one quits over treatment costs, Momin's ACL
incidents.summary: A talented Saif youth left-back quits football because he cannot afford treatment, and youth player Momin gets little help even after posting on his own ID for ACL injury costs.

incidents.title: Kings' 'Gayebana Academy' satire: enrol your child, pre-book a senior seat
incidents.summary: A satirical post says admission is open at the Bashundhara Kings Gayebana Academy, founded by Imrul Hasan and run by Oscar, where enrolling your child pre-books a seat in the senior team.

incidents.title: Police FC wronged by Kings in three straight matches
incidents.summary: A Police FC member says Kings wronged Police in three straight matches, and accuses T Sports of cutting the clip to show only Danilson charging at the Kings dugout after abusive words came from it.

incidents.title: Jibon dropped from national team for joining camp late
incidents.summary: Nabib Newaz Jibon was dropped from the national team for joining the camp late, and Saif's Sajjad Hossain was called up in his place.

incidents.title: Arefin Zeesan smeared by Kings brokers; admin defended and blamed in turn
incidents.summary: Group admin Arefin Zeesan is defended against personal attacks in the Kings fans group, accused of being marketed by the brokers attacking him, and then blamed himself for local players' poor international performances.

incidents.title: Indonesia friendly 0-0: Cabrera's defensive draw, lord XI blamed
incidents.summary: Bangladesh draw 0-0 with Indonesia playing for a draw with shoot-it-to-the-moon tactics; fans say Zico saved the team, the lord XI do not belong, and Rimon at right-back and Bishwanath at left centre-back expose the syndicate picks.

incidents.title: University football ignored by BFF
incidents.summary: A post says universities also have many talented footballers but BFF has no concern about university football.

incidents.title: Local journalists' award: nominations never published, winner pre-decided
incidents.summary: A fan mocks a local journalists' award, saying the best of the best got the winner's tag though nominations were never published and the winner was decided before nominations were announced.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu tournament poster has no Bangladeshi footballer
incidents.summary: A fan is upset that a football tournament named after Bangabandhu has no Bangladeshi footballer on its big promotional poster.

incidents.title: Saif trial commission: fan blocked after asking the price
incidents.summary: A fan asked Saif's new official page how much commission a trial costs, was told commission-eaters are gone, was then blocked, and saw Shahidul and Roni — accused of demanding money from Hudson — at the club.

incidents.title: Asian Cup qualifiers: Bahrain and Turkmenistan defeats, Malaysia looming
incidents.summary: Bangladesh lose 2-0 to Bahrain and 2-1 to Turkmenistan in the Asian Cup qualifiers, have not scored in four matches, and slip to 192nd; fans blame the same lord picks, Rimon's errors and the missing number nine, while Elita is held up as the finisher Bangladesh lack.

incidents.title: How is Rimon Hossain's age only 16?
incidents.summary: A fan asks if anyone can explain how Rimon Hossain's age is only 16.

incidents.title: Oscar's nephew in the national team
incidents.summary: A fan tells Uncle Oscar to please keep his nephew with him and not send him to the national team anymore.

incidents.title: Photographers could pass information to gamblers, recalling Arambagh
incidents.summary: A post says official photographers using devices on the field could pass information to gamblers, recalling the Arambagh incident, and asks when the federation will act.

incidents.title: Mohammedan goal cancelled by the referee's wrong decision
incidents.summary: A post says Mohammedan midfielder Shahed Hossain's goal was cancelled due to the referee's wrong decision.

incidents.title: Jamie Day mocked for a fourth-tier job — but it is still ahead of the BPL
incidents.summary: A post argues Jamie Day is not to be mocked for becoming assistant coach in the English fourth tier, which is still ahead of the BPL.

incidents.title: Even Myanmar has better stadiums and a better league
incidents.summary: A post says Bangladesh football officials should be ashamed, since even neighbouring Myanmar, a weak economy, has good-quality stadiums and probably a better-quality league.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal sack unbeaten Juan Manuel; Afusi mocked in turn
incidents.summary: Sheikh Jamal sacked Juan Manuel Martinez despite 5 wins and 6 draws in 11 unbeaten matches, while replacement Joseph Afusi has 3 wins and 3 defeats in 6; fans call Juan 1000 percent better and mock Afusi's substitutions.

incidents.title: ATK hold U13/U15/U18 trials while BFF only talks of an U18 league
incidents.summary: A post says ATK Mohun Bagan hold trials for U13, U15 and U18 teams while BFF, stuck in the so-called golden past, only talks big about an U18 league.

incidents.title: Five-year Qatar deal: only in words, or actually implemented?
incidents.summary: A fan asks whether the five-year deal with Qatar is only in words or BFF has actually implemented it.

incidents.title: One man's power spans SAFF 2009-2026, yet the region failed except India
incidents.summary: A fan notes one man's power spans the whole of SAFF, as SAFF president from 2009 to 2026, yet under him the SAFF region has completely failed except India.

incidents.title: No stretcher-bearers in the royal BPL: Juventus men pull the stretcher
incidents.summary: A fan mocks the royal BPL, saying even Juventus footballers have to pull the stretcher there.

incidents.title: Shahidul's Federation Cup fan attack recalled months later
incidents.summary: Comparing photos months apart, a fan recalls goalkeeper Shahidul Sohel inciting Abahani supporters against Saif supporters in the Federation Cup, with Saif jerseys stripped and flags torn.

incidents.title: Academies must start at seven or eight; Pioneer League shrinking
incidents.summary: A long post praises the BFF Elite Academy's training but says academies should start at age seven or eight, doubts BFF's two new academies will last, and notes the Pioneer League is shrinking.

incidents.title: Paid fans asked if they are ashamed to be called fans
incidents.summary: A fan asks whether paid fans are not ashamed to be called fans, and whether they are really fans at all.

incidents.title: Syndicate in age-level selection: U20 trials skip BPL-playing Muktijoddha youngsters
incidents.summary: A fan asks whether there is a syndicate even in age-level team selection, noting three young Muktijoddha players who played BPL matches as substitutes were not called for U-20 trials.

incidents.title: Pioneer League final: a dive wins a penalty, awarded instantly

entities.name: Zara Green Voice Kishore Bangla Club

incidents.summary: A fan analyses photos from the Pioneer League final, saying the Barishal attacker clearly tripped while the penalty appeal was dive and drama, and criticises the referee for awarding it instantly.

incidents.title: Saintfiet on Africa's top-five shortlist after Bangladesh failure

entities.name: Tom Saintfiet
entities.role: former Bangladesh coach, Gambia head coach

incidents.summary: Former Bangladesh coach Tom Saintfiet is on Africa's top five coaches shortlist alongside Carlos Queiroz and Aliou Cisse, after a Bangladesh record of 0-5 to Maldives and 0-0 and 1-3 to Bhutan.

incidents.title: Imrul Hasan may resign as BFF vice-president
incidents.summary: Citing Khelajog, a fan says Bashundhara president Imrul Hasan may resign as BFF vice-president, and wonders whether he erred by standing in Salahuddin's panel.

incidents.title: Imtiaz Nakib: the most neglected footballer, nine years a squad man, never a regular
incidents.summary: In a Kaler Kantho interview, Imtiaz Ahmed Nakib says he was the most neglected footballer in the national team, playing nine or ten years without ever being dropped from the squad yet never playing regularly in the XI.

incidents.title: Muktijoddha organisers have no emotion for football
incidents.summary: A fan accuses Muktijoddha's organisers of having no emotion for football and selling consciousness while the club rots.

incidents.title: Advance money for a running player: Mohammedan man takes Abahani cash before facing them
incidents.summary: A fan says clubs giving or taking advance money for a running player is wrong, since a Mohammedan player who takes money from Abahani before playing them will go soft, and calls for a federation law.

incidents.title: Hill-tracts talent Prenchu Mro left out while expatriates get the attention

entities.name: Prenchu Mro
entities.role: indigenous footballer from the hill tracts

incidents.summary: A fan regrets that expatriate players get so much attention while local talents and indigenous hill-tracts footballers like Prenchu Mro are left out.

incidents.title: Kings threaten BFF: 'Born to destroy remainings of Bangladesh Football'
incidents.summary: Fans are stunned that a club threatens a federation, saying the Bashundhara Group-owned team even threatened BFF for a player's sake.

incidents.title: A 10-lakh player gets 20-30 lakh and joins the syndicate
incidents.summary: A fan says a player worth ten lakh who gets twenty or thirty lakh in Bangladesh has no reason to go abroad, and is also joining hands with the syndicate to strengthen his own footing.

incidents.title: Journalist blamed as age exposé stops a boy playing U15
incidents.summary: A journalist shares a personal story: a young footballer blames him on Messenger because his reporting exposed the boy's real age and stopped him playing in the U-15 team.

incidents.title: Fortis trials a sham: fans spend thousands, barely play
incidents.summary: Trialists report spending 3,500 to 5,000 taka to reach Fortis trials, sitting from 9am to 5:30pm and being sent away unwatched, with a goalkeeper getting seven to eight minutes and not a single ball.

incidents.title: Mitul Marma left out of the U20 SAFF squad
incidents.summary: A fan asks why goalkeeper Mitul Marma, who has played the BPL for over three years, debuted for the national team at 18 and attended many national camps, was not taken in the U-20 SAFF squad.

incidents.title: Historic clubs disappearing: Brothers, Arambagh, Farashganj, Wanderers
incidents.summary: Fans ask what happened to Brothers Union, Arambagh, Farashganj, Wanderers, NoFeL and Beanibazar, list traditional clubs about to disappear, and note Arambagh cannot play after a FIFA registration ban over an unpaid Brazilian coach.

incidents.title: SAFF squad (Aug 24): Nawab, Elita, Mahdi frozen out again as Cabrera promises a surprise
incidents.summary: Cabrera's August squad for the SAFF Championship keeps the memorised picks — Biplu, Jony, Ibrahim, Suman — while Nawab, Elita and Mahdi are absent again despite league form; Cabrera says better midfielders than Nawab are in the team, and fans call the promised surprise a joke.

incidents.title: Saif Sporting quit football, blaming BFF's unprofessionalism
incidents.summary: Saif Sporting Club suddenly announce they will no longer run a football club; fans blame BFF's corruption and unprofessionalism, say it was about the election and players being taken rather than money, and note unpaid players left in trouble.

incidents.title: Muktijoddha players unpaid and stranded at the club after saving the team
incidents.summary: Five days after the season ended, Muktijoddha's players are still lying at the club with no money or news, though they saved the team and finished ninth.

incidents.title: BFF should apologise to the U20s for failing to give them improved facilities
incidents.summary: After the SAFF U-20 final defeat to India, a fan tells the U-20 players not to apologise to spectators and says BFF should apologise to them for failing to give improved facilities.

incidents.title: Reasat Khaton, Freiburg youth, rejected from the 2013-14 camp while Jamal was taken
incidents.summary: A fan regrets that Reasat Khaton, the first Bangladeshi to play at Europe's highest club level with SC Freiburg's youth teams, was rejected from the 2013-14 camp while Jamal was taken.

incidents.title: Tahmid, France fifth tier, cannot get into the Bangladesh U20 team
incidents.summary: A fan asks why Tahmid, playing in France's fifth tier and promoted to the senior team, cannot get into the Bangladesh U-20 team when Morocco and Algeria pick U-23 players from Spain's lower tiers.

incidents.title: FIFA bans India (AIFF); fans recall Bangladesh's 2002 ban
incidents.summary: Fans break the news that FIFA banned the All India Football Federation indefinitely for third-party interference, and recall FIFA banning Bangladesh on 11 January 2002 for the same reason.

incidents.title: Maruful Haque to join Sheikh Jamal, not a lower-mid club
incidents.summary: Coach Maruful Haque is reported to join Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi Club in September; a fan complains he should have gone to a lower-mid club rather than the visionless Sheikh Jamal.

incidents.title: Mohammedan's legal notice threatens fan pages
incidents.summary: Mohammedan issue a legal notice against fan pages, called shameless, anti-football and dangerous by fans who say the management threatens young supporters and strangles the club's road to popularity.

incidents.title: UEFA-gifted bus worse than local long-distance buses
incidents.summary: A fan mocks the bus UEFA gave as worse than good long-distance buses in the country, unacceptable for national team players, and wonders whether Salahuddin and Salam will rent the buses out.

incidents.title: AFC sends BFF fixed-match footage; Baridhara relegated for spot-fixing
incidents.summary: AFC send BFF footage of fixed matches with a FIFA ban feared, while players expelled for match-fixing still play in BFF tournaments; Uttar Baridhara are relegated two years for spot-fixing with a 10 lakh fine, and Saif youth manager Iskandar Mirza is banned for life.

incidents.title: Ekattor TV always shields one side, now the Kings
incidents.summary: A fan accuses Ekattor TV of always shielding one side, now Bashundhara Kings, citing its Cabrera report claiming Kings recognised Mahdi after playing him six matches at 31 minutes average.

incidents.title: Foreign referees 'wouldn't know big from small teams', says league chairman
incidents.summary: Quoting the league committee chairman on foreign referees, a fan notes referees brought from abroad would not know which is a big team and which is a small team.

incidents.title: Japan-based Sumaiya left out of the women's SAFF squad — syndicate here too?
incidents.summary: A fan asks why Japan's Sumaiya, of Bangladeshi origin, who plays in foreign leagues alongside Sabina, is not in the SAFF Championship squad, and whether there is a syndicate here too.

incidents.title: Kamalapur turf injures stars: Fernandes, Topu, Rahbar, Faisal ACLs
incidents.summary: A third-division player leaving for Saudi Arabia begs the federation to stop playing at Kamalapur, recounting how Fernandes, Topu, Rahbar and Police FC's Faisal suffered ACL injuries there.

incidents.title: Paul Smalley: two years, no passing or position sense; Yemen U17 teach a lesson
incidents.summary: Paul Smalley is criticised for training the kids for two years yet teaching no ball passing or position sense; Yemen U17 then beat Bangladesh U17 4-0 and fans say the Smalley approach is not working.

incidents.title: Cabrera yet to win a match
incidents.summary: A fan says even though many wove dreams with the arrival of Spanish coach Javier Cabrera, Bangladesh has not won any match under him so far.

incidents.title: Women's SAFF champions return: no open-top bus, theft, delayed rewards
incidents.summary: Bangladesh's women win the SAFF Championship but return to no open-top bus — BFF cut a BRTC bus roof instead — a dark unlit BFF building, theft from Sabina, Sanjida and Krishna, and dilly-dallying over rewards, while one player's family feared losing their homestead.

incidents.title: Salahuddin: making a real academy is not that easy
incidents.summary: Quoting Kazi Salahuddin, a fan reports him saying making an academy is not that easy, that real academies cannot be made by just building a brick building and putting footballers in one or two rooms.

incidents.title: Nepal 3-1: the most shameful defeat in history, lord defence blamed
incidents.summary: Bangladesh lose 3-1 to Nepal in the most shameful defeat in history, 2-0 down in 27 minutes, as fans blame a makeshift centre-back, benched Tariq Kazi and a lord defence that cannot pass or receive; the Cambodia win days earlier is dismissed as poor quality.

incidents.title: Why was Jamie Day removed if Cabrera plays his squad?
incidents.summary: A fan asks why Jamie Day was removed if this is Jamie Day's team and Cabrera is playing with his squad, and what the benefit was; later posts recall Day's warning and that calling up expatriates became his doom.

incidents.title: India host FIFA U17 World Cups and build academies while Bangladesh talk
incidents.summary: A fan contrasts India hosting the FIFA U-17 boys and girls World Cups and probably the 2027 AFC Asian Cup, building international stadiums and academies, with Bangladesh's inaction.

incidents.title: Low-quality locals worth 5-6 lakh; Tariq and Nawab underpaid for their quality
incidents.summary: A fan argues low-quality local Bangladeshi footballers should not be worth more than five or six lakh taka, while expatriates Tariq Kazi and Obaidur Nawab do not get pay according to their quality.

incidents.title: Fearless journalists like Riasad Azim badly needed to free BFF from the syndicate
incidents.summary: A fan says fearless sports journalists like Riasad Azim are badly needed in the country's football to free BFF from the syndicate.

incidents.title: Camera misses a free-kick goal; T Sports shows kabaddi, not the BPL
incidents.summary: Broadcast failures pile up: a camera shows the surroundings while a free-kick goal is scored, a cameraman writes Abahani as Abahoni, and T Sports is abused for broadcasting university football and Indian Pro Kabaddi but not Bangladesh's top-level tournament.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan owed two months' salary by Saif
incidents.summary: Jamal Bhuyan is owed two months' salary by Saif, and if the arrears are not paid within a short time, Jamal will file a written complaint with BFF.

incidents.title: Salahuddin made Bangladesh play the 2022 World Cup — and will find origin players the same way
incidents.summary: A fan sarcastically says just as Salahuddin and gang made Bangladesh play in the 2022 World Cup, exactly like that they will also find and bring origin players.

incidents.title: Teams will spend more on five foreigners than on all local footballers
incidents.summary: A fan says in the coming season some teams will spend more on five foreigners than the total spent on local footballers.

incidents.title: Jamie Day went to FIFA; BFF fined crores over his contract
incidents.summary: After BFF's relationship with Jamie Day broke over the contract, Jamie went to FIFA for his owed money, and Channel 24 reported FIFA fined BFF crores of taka.

incidents.title: Soumya Osman gave a trial and left
incidents.summary: A fan doubts expatriates will be given a chance, recalling that Soumya Osman of Norway's first-division youth team gave a trial and left.

incidents.title: Azampur and troubled Muktijoddha sign five foreigners each
incidents.summary: A fan asks why league newcomers Azampur FC and financially troubled Muktijoddha signed five foreigners each, while Sheikh Russel and Chittagong Abahani did not.

incidents.title: Bishwanath, the syndicate's victim, deserves a Kings XI place
incidents.summary: A fan says this time the syndicate's victim is national team regular Bishwanath Ghosh, and wants to see him in Bashundhara Kings' XI, kicking the syndicate in the face.

incidents.title: Independence Cup final: Sheikh Russel 'hand' the match to Kings
incidents.summary: Fans call the Independence Cup final a daylight robbery: Sheikh Russel hand the match to Bashundhara after 120 minutes, the script changing in the dugout, with both clubs from the same stable.

incidents.title: Barrister Sumon Academy has its own bus; top-tier clubs do not
incidents.summary: A fan says Barrister Sumon Football Academy has its own bus too, and alas, many top-tier clubs in Bangladesh do not have their own transport bus.

incidents.title: Bangladesh was supposed to play the 2022 World Cup; Salahuddin showed the dream
incidents.summary: Amid the World Cup frenzy, a fan says Bangladesh was supposed to play in the 2022 Qatar World Cup, and Kazi Salahuddin showed that dream, yet Bangladesh sits at 192nd.

incidents.title: Nawab's Nawabi ending: no bench place at his new club
incidents.summary: A fan says it is amazing to think that Nawab's Nawabi is ending, since he went to such a club where he does not even get a place on the bench.

incidents.title: Remove Salahuddin campaign builds
incidents.summary: Fans mock and demand the removal of BFF president Kazi Salahuddin, debate his successors, and note his anger at critics.

incidents.title: Kings reportedly bid to bring Neymar for arena opening
incidents.summary: Report that Bashundhara Kings bid to bring Neymar for the Kings Arena opening; fans suggest exhibition matches.

incidents.title: Expatriate players frozen out; campaign to call up Kingsley, Nawab, Hamza, Samit and Sullivan
incidents.summary: Fans allege a syndicate freezes expatriate and overlooked players out of the national team and campaign for Kingsley, Nawab, Hamza, Samit and Sullivan to be picked.

incidents.title: Argentina visit and Super Clasico plan unravels
incidents.summary: BFF's plan to bring Argentina for a Super Clasico-style friendly collapses after a meeting is cancelled over media leaks; fans balk at the 70-100 crore cost.

incidents.title: Kings players' Argentina offers; club to decide
incidents.summary: Two Bashundhara Kings players confirm offers from Argentine clubs but say they will follow the club's decision on any move.

incidents.title: Chittagong Abahani winless; Titu departs, fans appeal to Bruzon
incidents.summary: Chittagong Abahani go winless for seven rounds, coach Saiful Bari Titu departs, and fans appeal to Oscar Bruzon to save the club from relegation.

incidents.title: Fans ask why local coaches fail while foreigners dominate
incidents.summary: Fan asks why local coaches never succeed while foreign coaches dominate the league every year.

incidents.title: Nawab frozen out: best performer yet to play a match
incidents.summary: Fan laments that Nawab, one of last season's best performers, has not played a single match this season.

incidents.title: FIFA freezes BFF funds over Jamie Day's unpaid $86,000
incidents.summary: FIFA freezes BFF development funds after the federation fails to pay former coach Jamie Day $86,000 in owed salary.

incidents.title: BFF will not send women's team to Olympic qualifiers in Myanmar
incidents.summary: Fans are shocked BFF will not send South Asia's best women's team to Olympic qualifying in Myanmar, citing a financial crisis while paying a technical director $15,000 a month and planning to spend 100 crore on Argentina; the U-20 goalkeeper coach earlier got no champion's medal while officials took medals.

incidents.title: Unpaid wages and commission demands in the BPL
incidents.summary: Fans demand the downfall of club managements delaying players' salaries to earn bank interest, and urge players to expose coaches and managers demanding commissions.

incidents.title: Domestic refereeing slammed; fans demand VAR and foreign referees
incidents.summary: Fans back a Nepali referee for Kings-Abahani, demand VAR, and call league refereeing a circus after a headbutt goes unbooked.

incidents.title: Historic clubs in crisis: Muktijoddha broke, Saif folded
incidents.summary: Muktijoddha face a financial crisis with a vanished sponsor and unaccounted crowdfunding, while folded Saif Sporting Club's players star elsewhere.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan's Sol de Mayo move blocked by Sheikh Russel
incidents.summary: Captain Jamal Bhuyan signs for Argentine club Sol de Mayo but Sheikh Russel block the move over release and fee questions; the move collapses, though Jamal hopes to play the return leg later.

incidents.title: Mohammedan sack Manik, appoint Alfaz as interim coach
incidents.summary: Mohammedan sack coach Shafiqul Islam Manik and appoint Mohammad Alfaz as interim coach; ultras appeal for him to be given full freedom.

incidents.title: Yeasin Arafat dropped from tri-nation squad; syndicate scapegoating alleged
incidents.summary: Fans are shocked Yeasin Arafat is left out of the 27-man tri-nation squad, calling him the syndicate's scapegoat.

incidents.title: Sufil kept out while Jibon, Suman and Jewel favoured
incidents.summary: Fans use Sufil's statistics to argue a syndicate around Jibon kept the in-form forward out of the national team.

incidents.title: Barrister Suman's academy accused of age fraud
incidents.summary: Fan questions Barrister Suman's football academy, alleging age fraud and borrowed players.

incidents.title: Malawi friendly lacked FIFA recognition
incidents.summary: Bangladesh's Saudi-camp friendly against Malawi goes ahead without FIFA recognition, confusing fans; Bishwanath Ghosh's late goal earns a 1-1 draw.

incidents.title: Cabrera under fire after Seychelles loss; sack calls grow
incidents.summary: After the Seychelles loss fans demand BFF sack Javier Cabrera, citing six losses in ten matches and no prior head-coach experience, while others defend his tactics.

incidents.title: Argentina visit revived, then Argentina go to China instead
incidents.summary: Reports revive the Argentina visit for two matches at Kings Arena, but Argentina end up touring China instead.

incidents.title: Seychelles tri-nation series: historic win, then shock loss to part-timers
incidents.summary: Elita Kingsley finally debuts and Tariq Kazi scores in a historic win over Seychelles, but Bangladesh then lose the return to the part-time side and Bishwanath Ghosh storms onto the pitch in a brawl the referee reports.

incidents.title: BFF lost track of two historic trophies
incidents.summary: Fan reports BFF has lost track of two historic trophies, the 1995 Myanmar four-nation title and the 2003 SAFF title.

incidents.title: FIFA bans BFF general secretary Shohag for fraud; probe widens to BFF finances
incidents.summary: FIFA bans BFF general secretary Abu Nayeem Shohag for two years and fines him CHF 10,000 for falsified documents; a FIFA probe details fraud in purchases, parliament orders a probe, the High Court orders the ACC to investigate BFF officials, and a 20-crore government-fund misappropriation allegation follows.

incidents.title: Topu Barman dropped from Kings XI after Argentina offer
incidents.summary: Fan claims Topu Barman was dropped from the Kings XI after his Argentina offer as part of a conspiracy.

incidents.title: Kings' bussed-in fans and empty galleries
incidents.summary: Fans allege Kings supporters were bussed in from Gazipur with money and jerseys, then mock the empty galleries at the third-place match (paid/forced attendance).

incidents.title: Calls to naturalise Diabate and recruit diaspora players
incidents.summary: Fans urge Mohammedan to secure a Bangladeshi passport for Diabate after five seasons, debate naturalising him or loaning Hamza and Samit, and compare Bangladesh with Pakistan's nine origin players; Zidan Mia's father says he will play if BFF approaches.

incidents.title: BFF bars Sylhet coach from course for criticising federation
incidents.summary: BFF bars a Sylhet coach from a goalkeeping course for writing negatively about the federation (federation suppressing criticism).

incidents.title: Paul Smalley technical-director row
incidents.summary: BFF technical director Paul Smalley leaves citing no working environment, is accused of selling coaching certificates for commission, then wants to return on a new deal while coaches question his record.

incidents.title: Journalists demand Salahuddin's resignation; campaign continues
incidents.summary: After Salahuddin's obscene remark about journalists' parents, the journalists' union demands his resignation, he sues sports journalists, a High Court order bars calling him a thief until FIFA's probe ends, and fans keep the #SalauddinOut campaign going through the SAFF run.

incidents.title: Premier League balls are very poor quality
incidents.summary: Fan says the Premier League needs better-quality balls, complaining the current ones are very poor.

incidents.title: BFF officials' Qatar World Cup trip questioned
incidents.summary: Fan questions whether BFF officials' Qatar World Cup trip was official or personal, who paid, and raises ticket-trading allegations.

incidents.title: Mohammedan's Federation Cup triumph: semi upset and classic final
incidents.summary: Mohammedan beat Bashundhara Kings 2-1 to reach the Federation Cup final after 14 years, then beat Abahani 4-4 (4-3 on penalties) in a classic Dhaka Derby final as Diabate scored all four goals, ending a nine-year title drought under coach Alfaz Ahmed.

incidents.title: Jafar Iqbal: Bishwanath escaped punishment after injuring him
incidents.summary: Jafar Iqbal claims Bishwanath Ghosh escaped punishment after badly injuring him.

incidents.title: Kings' continental record under scrutiny ahead of ACL playoff
incidents.summary: Fans mock Kings' reliance on Robson ahead of a third straight continental failure, then preview the ACL playoff against AGMK Olmaliq and the qualifier against Sharjah.

incidents.title: BFF finally pays Jamie Day with a bank loan
incidents.summary: Fan reports BFF finally paid Jamie Day's dues with a bank loan, fearing FIFA would freeze its funds.

incidents.title: SAFF squad row: Elita Kingsley dropped, Sumon Reza picked
incidents.summary: Fans erupt as the SAFF squad drops league top scorer Elita Kingsley while goalless Sumon Reza is picked, blaming a syndicate and club influence; Cabrera says the squad was picked on ability and Sumon's ability is greater.

incidents.title: Federation Cup final refereeing row; fixing claims

entities.name: Satyajit Das Rupu
entities.role: Abahani manager and BFF executive member

incidents.summary: Fans demand foreign referees and live broadcast for the Federation Cup final, allege Abahani matches involve referee influence and that the Abahani-Sheikh Russel match was fixed, and claim controversial referees were appointed despite Mohammedan's written objection.

incidents.title: Kings Arena pitch slammed
incidents.summary: Fan slams the poor pitch at Bashundhara Kings Arena, saying the club's own players keep slipping.

incidents.title: Women's football turmoil: Choton quits, Shopna retires, players leave camp
incidents.summary: Women's coach Golam Rabbani Choton prepares to quit, striker Sirat Jahan Shopna suddenly retires, Akhi Khatun leaves camp and staff refuse to work as women's football falls apart.

incidents.title: Dorielton kicked and headbutted Morsalin three times
incidents.summary: Fan notes Dorielton kicked and headbutted Sheikh Morsalin three times in the derby.

incidents.title: Fans urge BFF to bring Hamza Choudhury now
incidents.summary: Fan says now is the time for BFF to bring Hamza Choudhury to Bangladesh, with his Leicester season over.

incidents.title: Federation Cup winners Mohammedan denied AFC Cup for lack of licence
incidents.summary: Despite winning the Federation Cup, Mohammedan will not play in the AFC Cup for lack of a club licence, while Abahani take the playoff spot; fans note legacy clubs lack the ability and will for ACL licensing.

incidents.title: Ex-goalkeeper Mohammad Mohsin ill and neglected
incidents.summary: Legendary former goalkeeper Mohammad Mohsin is seriously ill and in hardship; teammates rally to help while fans ask what BFF and Salahuddin are for when the cricket board arranges his treatment.

incidents.title: Overage players in U-17 tournaments
incidents.summary: Fans expose overage players in the U-17 third division and the Bangabandhu Gold Cup in Habiganj, blaming age fraud for destroying grassroots football.

incidents.title: Mohammedan's unbeaten runners-up finishes blamed on off-field influence
incidents.summary: Fan recalls Mohammedan twice finishing unbeaten runners-up in the BPL, suggesting off-field influence mattered more than play.

incidents.title: Cambodia friendly win exposes dire performance
incidents.summary: Bangladesh beat Cambodia 1-0 but fans call the display the worst they can recall, unable to complete three passes, and blame the syndicate for the state of the team.

incidents.title: Elita omission row continues through SAFF; Sajid carried, Sumon goalless
incidents.summary: During the SAFF campaign fans keep attacking Elita Kingsley's omission, mock Sumon Reza's goal drought, allege Sajid was signed by a powerful club and carried in the team, and blame a syndicate of favoured players.

incidents.title: SAFF 2023: Bangladesh reach semi-final after 14 years
incidents.summary: Bangladesh lose the SAFF opener to Lebanon amid errors, then beat Maldives 3-1 and Bhutan 3-1 to reach the semi-final after 14 years, with Morsalin, Rakib and Tariq Kazi starring; fans debate Cabrera's tactics and the striker crisis throughout.

incidents.title: Poor ground of a BPL team mocked
incidents.summary: Fan mocks the poor ground of a team playing in Bangladesh's Premier League.

incidents.title: Ekattor TV accused of pressuring players before matches
incidents.summary: Fan condemns Ekattor TV for putting mental pressure on the players before the match (media pressure on players).

incidents.title: Tariq Kazi injured for Bhutan decider; fans demand Mithu, not Bishwanath
incidents.summary: With Tariq Kazi injured for the Bhutan decider, fans argue Mehedi Mithu should partner Topu at centre-back instead of shifting Bishwanath Ghosh inside.

incidents.title: Expatriate recruitment: Hamza, Samit and the others
incidents.summary: A running debate over bringing British-Bangladeshi players home: fans hope Hamza Choudhury gives up the England dream, discuss FIFA eligibility for Hamza, Samit Shome and Quinn Sullivan, and ask why BFF's approach to Leicester stalls.

incidents.title: SAFF semi-final refereeing row vs Kuwait
incidents.summary: Fans accuse the referee of favouring Kuwait in the SAFF semi-final, citing fouls given only one way, inflated added time and a call for fans to judge the official.

incidents.title: Syndicate selection row after the SAFF semi-final
incidents.summary: After the SAFF semi-final exit, fans accuse a syndicate of fixing the squad: undeserving players picked, deserving players such as Fahad, Elita and Shahriar Emon left out, Mehedi Mithu the latest victim, and the coach denied freedom to choose.

incidents.title: Zico shouts at staff over Sohel; calls for Sohel to retire
incidents.summary: Goalkeeper Zico is reported shouting at the coaching staff to substitute senior Sohel Rana during the Kuwait semi-final, prompting calls for Sohel to retire and debate over seniors scolding juniors.

incidents.title: Emiliano Martinez visit: national team players snubbed
incidents.summary: During Emiliano Martinez's Dhaka visit, captain Jamal Bhuyan and the national team are kept from meeting him by the event organisers while YouTubers get access; Martinez later signs a jersey for Jamal after hearing of it in Kolkata. (Other: organisers snubbing the national team.)

incidents.title: No system to develop players
incidents.summary: Fans lament Bangladesh has no academy culture or system to nurture talent, with the SAFF run papering over the lack of basic skills and development.

incidents.title: BFF cannot secure four-nation tournaments
incidents.summary: Fans ask why BFF cannot get Bangladesh into four-nation tournaments like Thailand's King's Cup.

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings hoarding players and dominating the league
incidents.summary: Fans attack Bashundhara Kings' model: buying players at inflated prices and benching them, developing no new talent, signing a falling line of foreigners, and a broker gang pushing 'league-proven' signings, while a pool-system cap is proposed to stop corporate clubs winning every title.

incidents.title: FC Uttara accused of match-fixing
incidents.summary: FC Uttara are accused of the most match-fixing in the league, with the coach and players allegedly involved, and fans ask whether federation officials are part of the business.

incidents.title: Women's team coaching turmoil
incidents.summary: The women's team is hit by coaching rows: a dispute over fitness coach Ivan draws a show-cause order from Salahuddin, Saiful Bari Titu will not coach the U17 qualifiers, fans allege a conspiracy against Titu, and later demand Golam Choton's return.

incidents.title: Paid and biased media coverage
incidents.summary: Fans accuse sections of the media of paid, biased reporting: Ekattor TV is called Bashundhara's PR arm, a journalist's analysis of Jamal is mocked, Somoy TV is criticised for a baseless refereeing claim, and a paid report is alleged to shield people and blame the foreign coach. (Other: media misreporting/bias.)

incidents.title: Syndicate figures named; coach blocked from work
incidents.summary: A post names figures in the alleged syndicate around Jamal Bhuyan's club situation, and goalkeeper coach Biplab Bhattacharjee says syndicate people are blocking him from work and he may have to leave the country.

incidents.title: U23 squad selection row
incidents.summary: The U23 team is attacked as a rubbish selection: deserving league performers benched for personal picks, a player denied a call-up for fitness becoming captain, and BFF accused of neglecting the U23 Asian Cup and Asian Games squads.

incidents.title: Kings Arena crowds are factory staff, not fans
incidents.summary: A fan claims Kings Arena crowds are mostly factory and office staff and that Bashundhara Kings have no real fanbase. (Other: alleged paid/factory crowds.)

incidents.title: Oscar Bruzon's Asian record under fire
incidents.summary: A running attack on Oscar Bruzon's record with Bashundhara Kings: three AFC Cup group-stage exits, two group runners-up finishes spun as success, weak foreign signings, and the claim that neither Kings nor Abahani can succeed in Asia without escaping the syndicate system and coaches like Bruzon.

incidents.title: National team jerseys unavailable in shops
incidents.summary: Fans cannot buy a Bangladesh national team jersey anywhere in Kishoreganj, and later note Abahani jerseys cannot be found even in Dhaka. (Other: merchandise unavailability.)

incidents.title: Elita Kingsley's national-team exile and club limbo
incidents.summary: Fans demand naturalised striker Elita Kingsley be picked for the World Cup qualifiers, note the squad is announced without him, report him joining Mohammedan and then having no BPL team while in Nigeria, and blame BFF's disinterest as Bangladesh keeps playing without a proper number nine.

incidents.title: Sufil denied playing time, Rupu blamed
incidents.summary: Fans argue Mahbubur Rahman Sufil was unfairly denied playing time, blaming Satyajit Das Rupu after Sufil was left out of the away match in Laos.

incidents.title: Broadcast quality complaints, early season
incidents.summary: Fans lament poor camera coverage of a Robiul Hasan free-kick goal, the Abahani vs Eagles match not being shown on TV or T Sports digital, and a lineup graphic giving nobody's position properly.

incidents.title: Empty stadiums and poor district grounds
incidents.summary: Fans complain TV broadcasts show empty galleries and district stadiums are in a poor state, while league matches on Fridays and Saturdays still draw poor crowds.

incidents.title: Foreign players dominating domestic football
incidents.summary: Coach Maruf's warning that foreigners dominate every position so locals cannot learn to score is echoed in calls to cap foreigners at two in cup starting XIs, and in claims illegal foreign footballers live untaxed and deal drugs.

incidents.title: Abahani's troubled AFC Cup build-up
incidents.summary: Abahani lose star Daniel Colindres weeks before the AFC Cup qualifiers and sign a player from India's fifth tier, then Brazilian signings Bruno Matos and Jonathan miss the Mohun Bagan match over a contract issue, while Bagan are said to panic over Abahani's foreign lineup.

incidents.title: Youth development and Elite Academy failure
incidents.summary: Age-group football collapses: the U16 team is far behind India and Nepal, the U19 team loses to India and Bhutan, the Elite Academy is mocked as an academy in name only, no age-group league is held, and fans blame syndicate coaches and a system where only Elite Academy players get picked.

incidents.title: Women players in unauthorised khep matches
incidents.summary: Reports claim most members of the women's national team play unauthorised local 'khep' matches during holidays.

incidents.title: BFF always seeks easy opponents
incidents.summary: Fans criticise BFF for always seeking easy opponents instead of arranging Afghanistan for better preparation.

incidents.title: Relegation blackmail by bottom clubs
incidents.summary: Fans condemn the culture of second-from-bottom clubs blackmailing BFF every season to avoid relegation, backed by hustlers and yellow journalists.

incidents.title: Army team's Durand Cup defeats
incidents.summary: The Bangladesh Army team lose heavily to Mohun Bagan in the Durand Cup despite fielding mostly Premier League and national team players, exposing the gap with Indian football. (Other: heavy defeat exposing the quality gap.)

incidents.title: Mirajul Islam left out of the U19 team
incidents.summary: Fans ask why Mirajul Islam is not in the U19 team, then question how he can be listed for the Nepal Super League, Europe and the BPL at once, and note again that he is not in the team.

incidents.title: Mohammedan's decline
incidents.summary: Mohammedan's house is breaking again, losing experienced players every season, with fans saying the club has lost itself and its foreign recruits for next season are disappointing.

incidents.title: Clubs hide squads and signings
incidents.summary: Fans complain neither Abahani nor Bashundhara disclosed their squads or signings a week before their matches, with club social accounts used for TikTok and politics.

incidents.title: Deepak Roy overlooked for the squad
incidents.summary: Fans question why Sheikh Russel's Deepak Roy, a good young performer last season, was not picked for the squad.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan's Argentina transfer saga
incidents.summary: Argentine media confirm Jamal Bhuyan is in Argentina, fans question why he denied the Sol de Mayo deal on social media, and criticise his misleading post claiming a family vacation. (Other: transfer saga and misleading posts.)

incidents.title: Players taking money from several clubs a season
incidents.summary: Fans describe how players commonly take money from two or three clubs each season, citing players who signed for Abahani after taking Mohammedan money.

incidents.title: Matin Mia overlooked
incidents.summary: Fans express sorrow for Matin Mia and ask who is to blame for his fragile career, and later ask why the coach did not play the speed star against Afghanistan.

incidents.title: Black-money whitening claims against clubs
incidents.summary: A fan ends his time as a Kings supporter suspecting the club came to football to whiten black money, and another argues much club investment is black money being whitened.

incidents.title: Kings lose ACL playoff to Sharjah
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings lose the ACL playoff to Sharjah: fans mock Bruzon bringing on a centre-back, lifeless last 15 minutes down two goals, and question whether dropping to the AFC Cup group stage is a promotion or a demotion.

incidents.title: Tariq Kazi left out of the squad
incidents.summary: Fans ask why Tariq Kazi was not even in the squad despite training with Kings, and criticise Bishwanath Ghosh's defending.

incidents.title: MA Aziz Stadium hosts no internationals
incidents.summary: Fans lament the big MA Aziz Stadium hosts no international matches and urge it be made fully ready.

incidents.title: Squad selection rows, August to October
incidents.summary: A running selection row: coaches are asked what talent they cannot announce a squad without, Abahani's unworthy players are said to reach the national squad, Emon is blocked from age-group and national teams, Saad plays left-back over Yasin Arafat, and the October squad omits Emon, Jafor and Mithu while memorised substitutions and the midfield syndicate keep creative players out.

incidents.title: Army Stadium neglected
incidents.summary: Fans complain the Bangladesh Army Stadium looks neglected for lack of goodwill despite the Army having plenty of money.

incidents.title: Nawbab's Qatar move exposes selection injustice
incidents.summary: Obaidur Rahman Nawbab signs for Qatar second-tier side Lusail SC and scores a brace, and fans say Bangladesh let a winger go: Oscar played him out of position and benched him, he was called injured yet signed abroad, and giving him one national-team chance would not have been bad.

incidents.title: Broadcast complaints, mid-season
incidents.summary: Fans complain T Sports replays every missed chance three times while play continues, commentators sound like they are sobbing, the Maldives match broadcast is poor, expatriates cannot watch on YouTube from the UAE, and they worry whether expatriates can watch the next match.

incidents.title: Kings Arena transport and ticket facilities
incidents.summary: Fans praise Kings Arena as a ground but flag transport problems, unclear shuttle schedules, no ticket booth around the ground and no transport after the match.

incidents.title: Ordinary supporters shut out of match tickets
incidents.summary: Ordinary supporters cannot get tickets for the Afghanistan match while complimentary tickets go to pre-decided people, and on a later match day fans cannot even learn where to get tickets. (Other: ticket distribution favouring insiders.)

incidents.title: Player picked through a syndicate's blessing
incidents.summary: Fans attack a player who got a national team chance through hard shooting and a special syndicate's blessing despite no stamina, football sense or special talent.

incidents.title: Player ignored in national and Olympic teams
incidents.summary: Fans ask why a player is ignored in the national team and the Olympic team.

incidents.title: Kings lose to Maziya in the AFC Cup
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings lose to Maziya despite dominating possession: fans mock the 'mission is group runners-up' line, urge trust in magician Bruzon, blame foreigner quality and Rakib's repeated position changes, and suggest a statue for three group runners-up finishes.

incidents.title: Rahmat Mia's right-back place questioned
incidents.summary: Fans sarcastically call Rahmat Mia man of the match for long throws that never worked, and ask whether Bangladesh has any good right-back alternative to him.

incidents.title: Women's Asian Games campaign
incidents.summary: BFF does not publish the women's team's 8-0 Asian Games loss to Japan, fans contrast Nepal losing 2-0 to Vietnam with Bangladesh conceding six a year after beating Nepal to win the SAFF, and criticise the team's long throws and tactics.

incidents.title: Mohammedan denied the AFC Cup over a licence
incidents.summary: A traditional BPL club that won last season's Federation Cup could not play the AFC Cup for lack of a club licence, home venue or even a full practice ground.

incidents.title: Five Kings players' Maldives liquor scandal
incidents.summary: Five Bashundhara Kings players are temporarily banned after allegedly bringing 64 bottles of illegal foreign liquor back from the AFC Cup match against Maziya in the Maldives; BFF's boss says no one involved deserves the national team, the five miss the Maldives World Cup pre-qualifiers, Zico's absence is felt, and Topu and Zico are later called back to camp as fans argue they should never be picked again.

incidents.title: Saad Uddin made a defender instead of a winger
incidents.summary: Fans ask why Saad Uddin was made a defender instead of a winger.

incidents.title: Palestine flags snatched at the Maldives match
incidents.summary: A match commissioner has Palestine flags and banners snatched from spectators and players Fahim and Bishwanath, with a BFF official citing a 10,000-dollar fine. (Other: suppression of spectators' flags.)

incidents.title: BFF fails to find a national team sponsor
incidents.summary: Fans blame BFF's organisational failure for big industrial institutions not sponsoring the national team, and criticise BFF for casually asking in the media for a sponsor instead of approaching corporates or hiring a marketing team.

incidents.title: Kings' India trip: visas, venue and hospitality row
incidents.summary: Mohun Bagan move the venue from Kolkata to Odisha and Kings get no Indian visas despite applying a month earlier, Bagan give no transport or cooperation despite AFC instructions, and fans later blame the clubs' foolishness for the mental torture from visas onward. (Other: cross-border hosting row.)

incidents.title: The hidden hand behind Cabrera's team
incidents.summary: Fans argue the real hero behind the team's change is a hidden figure who draws the blueprint, not head coach Javier Cabrera.

incidents.title: Stadium and venue crisis
incidents.summary: Fans blame clubs' unprofessionalism for a venue crisis every season, argue BFF should get two football stadiums from the sports minister, note every district has cricket stadiums yet football leagues lack grounds, and lament no government initiative for football.

incidents.title: BPL's commercial value falls
incidents.summary: Fans ask why the Bangladesh Premier League's value fell from 22.7 million to 20 million and why corporate institutions do not take clubs.

incidents.title: BFF's Australia junket
incidents.summary: Fans report BFF is sending about 22 extra people to Australia beyond the national team and official staff, including district federation officials and relatives.

incidents.title: November squad: Emon, Jafor and Matin overlooked
incidents.summary: Fans criticise the November squad: Rafi is preferred over Rahmat Mia, Suman's inclusion over Motin Mia is incomprehensible, Shakil and Murad are picked over centre-backs Mithu, Rafi and Badshah, and Emon, Jafor, Dipok and Motin suffer stepmotherly treatment.

incidents.title: Khep-match double standard
incidents.summary: Fans criticise the double standard where Elita Kingsley was slammed for playing in the Chattogram league but Suman Reza faces silence for playing khep matches as a national team regular.

incidents.title: Nawbab still ignored despite Qatar form
incidents.summary: Fans criticise team management for ignoring a player in an Asian Cup-winning country's second tier while Suman Reza sits in the squad without a club match, argue Nawbab is a better finisher than Fahim and Rakib, and ask whether anyone from BFF even keeps track of him as he keeps performing in Qatar.

incidents.title: Women's league collapse
incidents.summary: Only three clubs register for the Women's Football League 2023-24 after a 20-lakh-taka pay-order rule kills interest, several old teams may not play, women footballers are defended for doing advertisements since BFF pays only 8-12 thousand taka a month, and Bashundhara Kings withdraw from the league.

incidents.title: Australia 7-0: blame falls on Salahuddin and BFF
incidents.summary: Bangladesh lose 7-0 away to Australia and fans blame Salahuddin and the syndicate, question Hasan Murad's selection, say 7-0 is not acceptable even away, and argue the collapse comes from picking players without league performance and a grassroots system that does not exist.

incidents.title: Broadcast: commentator's height obsession
incidents.summary: Fans complain the commentator keeps harping on height during the Australia match, asking how Japan and Korea play in the World Cup if height were everything.

incidents.title: Shrabon Azad's goalkeeper selection questioned
incidents.summary: Fans ask why Mehedi Hasan Shrabon must be played when Ashraful Rana and Shahidul Sohel are not in the squad, why he got a national chance so quickly over Mitul Marma, and warn not to forget his blunders while celebrating wins.

incidents.title: Kings Arena ticket black market
incidents.summary: A fan describes a ticket ordeal at Kings Arena where the counter was empty and a badge-wearing person offered two 300-taka tickets for 1000 taka, and another alleges fake tickets are printed and complimentary tickets sold to black marketeers. (Other: ticket black market.)

incidents.title: Mohammedan has no ground of its own
incidents.summary: Fans criticise an 87-year-old renowned club for having no own practice ground or stadium while treating Dhuokhola ground as its property and driving locals out.

incidents.title: AFC Cup exit and Bruzon's record relitigated
incidents.summary: After the AFC Cup exit, fans relitigate Oscar Bruzon's record: seven international tournament failures from the 2018 AFC Cup to 2023-24, a marking decision that cost a goal with ten men, Kings missing the most chances of any West Zone club, and the claim that Bangladesh's club football is finished.

incidents.title: BKSP banned in identity-fraud row
incidents.summary: BKSP's football team is banned from domestic competitions after BFF's disciplinary committee finds fraud, with players appearing under other names for Chokbazar Kings; fans ask why only BKSP is punished, who hides the mastermind Chokbazar Kings, and who the godfather is behind it.

incidents.title: Kings vs Odisha: Gofurov red card and refereeing row
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings' decisive AFC Cup match against Odisha turns on Gofurov's red card: fans call the refereeing biased, recall Sushant Tripura's 2021 red card against Mohun Bagan, note Bruzon protesting with both hands raised, and vent anti-India anger as Kings miss the knockout round.

incidents.title: Federation Cup's lopsided format
incidents.summary: Fans criticise the funny Federation Cup format where ten teams are divided into three groups and eight still reach the quarter-final.

incidents.title: Brokers and agencies manipulating football
incidents.summary: Fans accuse new-era brokers of opening a page pretending to want good for Bangladesh football while promoting their agency's players, and argue propaganda against Elita Kingsley deprived the national team while agency favourite Mfon Udoh is now unemployed after signing for Kings only for the AFC Cup.

incidents.title: Kings supporters' violence
incidents.summary: Fans complain Bashundhara supporters' behaviour is very bad, saying the biryani force attacked Abahani supporters, and accuse Bashundhara of deploying a terrorist force on the field with the club president saying such things happen.

incidents.title: Sufil's decline continues
incidents.summary: Fans ask why Sufil has fallen from Arambagh superstar to sitting on the Kings bench and now the Brothers bench, and note he scored for Brothers Union while blaming the syndicate for his low game time.

incidents.title: T Sports nepotism and poor broadcast quality
incidents.summary: Fans allege T Sports' policy is nepotistic and favours Kings, Sheikh Jamal and Sheikh Russel matches, and complain 80 percent of matches are outside Dhaka with broadcast quality so low they do not feel like watching.

incidents.title: Abahani's Gopalganj ground neglect
incidents.summary: Fans criticise Abahani for not modernising Gopalganj ground, their home venue and a blessing for fans, and ask how to explain such unprofessionalism from a club like Abahani.

incidents.title: BPL's digital presence collapses as its page is mass-reported and shut down
incidents.summary: The Bangladesh Premier League page was hit by mass unwanted reports and left unpublished, with its Twitter inactive, website under maintenance and fan voting for player of the week stopped.

incidents.title: Kings fan threatens boycott if Robson Robinho is sold
incidents.summary: A Bashundhara Kings fan threatens to boycott the club if Robson Robinho is sold and Sadiku brought in instead.

incidents.title: Fans lament Bangladesh falling behind India and regional rivals
incidents.summary: Fans lament that Australia, Indonesia and Malaysia can progress while Bangladesh cannot, praising India's Asian Cup defending and blaming Bangladesh's lack of planning, league quality and BFF intent.

incidents.title: FIFA fines BFF 30,250 Swiss francs over World Cup qualifier breaches
incidents.summary: FIFA's disciplinary committee fined BFF about Tk 40 lakh for pitch invasions, fireworks and conduct breaches in three World Cup qualifiers.

incidents.title: BPL broadcasting called abysmal as the new league committee is questioned
incidents.summary: Fans complain the competition identity is unclear and BPL broadcasting remains abysmal in 2024, blaming Professional League Committee chief Imrul Hasan and Bashundhara Group despite their TV channel.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Stadium renovation: Tk 156 crore spent in three years with no progress
incidents.summary: Fans report the Bangabandhu National Stadium renovation has cost Tk 156-159 crore over three years with no visible progress, contrasting India building eight stadiums and four academies for about Tk 1,100 crore.

incidents.title: Cabrera's staff accused of watching only televised matches
incidents.summary: A fan questions whether anyone on the coaching staff watches matches beyond the televised ones that Cabrera and Hasan Al Mamun attend.

incidents.title: Expatriate Max Rahman says he was frozen out after showing interest at 16
incidents.summary: Max Rahman says he was ready to join Bangladesh at 16 under Jamie Day but lost contact and has still received no call-up despite always showing interest.

incidents.title: Women's coach Titu's 'not Rohingya' remark to motivate the players
incidents.summary: Women's coach Titu motivated the girls with the line that this country let them stay and they are not Rohingya, aiming to keep the trophy at home. (Other: divisive remark by a national-team coach.)

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings accused of benefiting from favourable refereeing
incidents.summary: Fans accuse referees of favouring Bashundhara Kings: 13 minutes added so Kings could equalise, a scuffle ignored in the Kings-Rahmatganj match, a deliberate foul ignored against Chattogram Abahani, and Kings writing to BFF naming referees they do not want.

incidents.title: Corrupt BFF and Bashundhara monopoly blamed for the national team's lag
incidents.summary: A fan argues the biggest reason Bangladesh's national team lags India despite club success is a corrupt BFF and a national-team syndicate now monopolised by Bashundhara.

incidents.title: U-19 women's SAFF final descends into chaos as India walk off
incidents.summary: The U-19 women's SAFF final ended in chaos as India walked off after a disputed sudden-death shootout, skipped most of the prize ceremony, and fans later asked sarcastically whether India could be handed the win by toss.

incidents.title: BPL broadcast and commentary mocked by fans
